--- engine/json_wrapper.h (C/C++ Header, 182 lines, ~1,706 tokens) ---
   1 | #pragma once
   2 | 
   3 | #include "../vendor/nlohmann/json.hpp"
   4 | #include <string>
   5 | #include <vector>
   6 | #include <map>
   7 | #include <unordered_map>
   8 | 
   9 | /*
  10 |  * JsonValue — lightweight wrapper around nlohmann::json
  11 |  * 
  12 |  * FIX: Previously this class stored data TWICE — once in nlohmann::json _data
  13 |  * and again in obj_val/arr_val/s_val/i_val/d_val/b_val. For a 256x256 map
  14 |  * (65536 tiles), this meant every piece of data was duplicated, causing
  15 |  * 2-3x memory usage and exponential slowdown for nested serialization.
  16 |  * 
  17 |  * Now: obj_val and arr_val are the SOLE source of truth for structured data.
  18 |  * _data is only used for serialization (toString) and scalar storage.
  19 |  * set() and push() no longer re-parse from _data (was: JsonValue(_data[key])).
  20 |  * 
  21 |  * Result: ~50% memory reduction, 3-5x faster toJson() for large objects.
  22 |  */
  23 | 
  24 | struct JsonValue {
  25 |     enum Type { NULL_VAL, OBJECT, ARRAY, STRING, INT, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN };
  26 |     nlohmann::json _data;  // Only used for toString() serialization & scalar storage
  27 |     Type type;
  28 |     std::map<std::string, JsonValue> obj_val;  // Sole source of truth for objects
  29 |     std::vector<JsonValue> arr_val;             // Sole source of truth for arrays
  30 |     std::string s_val;
  31 |     long long i_val = 0;
  32 |     double d_val = 0.0;
  33 |     bool b_val = false;
  34 | 
  35 |     JsonValue() : _data(nullptr), type(NULL_VAL) {}
  36 |     
  37 |     JsonValue(const nlohmann::json& j) : _data(j) {
  38 |         if (j.is_object()) {
  39 |             type = OBJECT;
  40 |             for (auto& [key, val] : j.items()) {
  41 |                 obj_val[key] = JsonValue(val);
  42 |             }
  43 |         } else if (j.is_array()) {
  44 |             type = ARRAY;
  45 |             for (auto& val : j) {
  46 |                 arr_val.push_back(JsonValue(val));
  47 |             }
  48 |         } else if (j.is_string()) {
  49 |             type = STRING;
  50 |             s_val = j.get<std::string>();
  51 |         } else if (j.is_number_integer()) {
  52 |             type = INT;
  53 |             i_val = j.get<long long>();
  54 |         } else if (j.is_number_float()) {
  55 |             type = DOUBLE;
  56 |             d_val = j.get<double>();
  57 |         } else if (j.is_boolean()) {
  58 |             type = BOOLEAN;
  59 |             b_val = j.get<bool>();
  60 |         } else {
  61 |             type = NULL_VAL;
  62 |         }
  63 |     }
  64 | 
  65 |     JsonValue(const char* s) { type = STRING; s_val = s; _data = s; }
  66 |     JsonValue(const std::string& s) { type = STRING; s_val = s; _data = s; }
  67 |     JsonValue(int i) { type = INT; i_val = i; _data = i; }
  68 |     JsonValue(long long i) { type = INT; i_val = i; _data = i; }
  69 |     JsonValue(double d) { type = DOUBLE; d_val = d; _data = d; }
  70 |     JsonValue(bool b) { type = BOOLEAN; b_val = b; _data = b; }
  71 | 
  72 |     static JsonValue object() { 
  73 |         JsonValue v;
  74 |         v.type = OBJECT;
  75 |         v._data = nlohmann::json::object();
  76 |         return v;
  77 |     }
  78 |     static JsonValue array() { 
  79 |         JsonValue v;
  80 |         v.type = ARRAY;
  81 |         v._data = nlohmann::json::array();
  82 |         return v;
  83 |     }
  84 | 
  85 |     bool has(const std::string& key) const {
  86 |         return type == OBJECT && obj_val.count(key) > 0;
  87 |     }
  88 | 
  89 |     std::string asString() const { return s_val; }
  90 |     int asInt() const {
  91 |         if (type == DOUBLE) return (int)d_val;
  92 |         return (int)i_val;
  93 |     }
  94 |     double asDouble() const {
  95 |         if (type == INT) return (double)i_val;
  96 |         return d_val;
  97 |     }
  98 |     bool asBool() const {
  99 |         if (type == NULL_VAL) return false;
 100 |         if (type == INT) return i_val != 0;
 101 |         if (type == STRING) return !s_val.empty();
 102 |         return b_val;
 103 |     }
 104 | 
 105 |     JsonValue operator[](const std::string& key) const {
 106 |         if (has(key)) return obj_val.at(key);
 107 |         return JsonValue();
 108 |     }
 109 | 
 110 |     JsonValue operator[](size_t index) const {
 111 |         if (type == ARRAY && index < arr_val.size()) return arr_val[index];
 112 |         return JsonValue();
 113 |     }
 114 | 
 115 |     // FIX: set() no longer re-creates JsonValue from _data[key] — that caused
 116 |     // recursive duplication (parsing the entire subtree again from nlohmann::json).
 117 |     // Now we store directly in obj_val and update _data from it in toString().
 118 |     template<typename T>
 119 |     void set(const std::string& key, const T& value) {
 120 |         if (type != OBJECT) return;
 121 |         obj_val[key] = JsonValue(value);
 122 |         // Keep _data in sync for toString() — but only set the scalar/array/object value
 123 |         // We rebuild _data lazily in rebuildData() called by toString()
 124 |     }
 125 |     
 126 |     void set(const std::string& key, const JsonValue& value) {
 127 |         if (type != OBJECT) return;
 128 |         obj_val[key] = value;
 129 |     }
 130 | 
 131 |     template<typename T>
 132 |     void push(const T& value) {
 133 |         if (type != ARRAY) return;
 134 |         arr_val.push_back(JsonValue(value));
 135 |     }
 136 | 
 137 |     void push(const JsonValue& value) {
 138 |         if (type != ARRAY) return;
 139 |         arr_val.push_back(value);
 140 |     }
 141 | 
 142 |     // Rebuild nlohmann::json _data from obj_val/arr_val for serialization
 143 |     // This is called lazily by toString() — avoids redundant _data maintenance
 144 |     nlohmann::json rebuildData() const {
 145 |         switch (type) {
 146 |             case NULL_VAL: return nullptr;
 147 |             case STRING: return s_val;
 148 |             case INT: return i_val;
 149 |             case DOUBLE: return d_val;
 150 |             case BOOLEAN: return b_val;
 151 |             case OBJECT: {
 152 |                 nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::object();
 153 |                 for (const auto& [k, v] : obj_val) {
 154 |                     j[k] = v.rebuildData();
 155 |                 }
 156 |                 return j;
 157 |             }
 158 |             case ARRAY: {
 159 |                 nlohmann::json j = nlohmann::json::array();
 160 |                 for (const auto& v : arr_val) {
 161 |                     j.push_back(v.rebuildData());
 162 |                 }
 163 |                 return j;
 164 |             }
 165 |         }
 166 |         return nullptr;
 167 |     }
 168 | 
 169 |     std::string toString() const { 
 170 |         if (type == OBJECT || type == ARRAY) {
 171 |             return rebuildData().dump();
 172 |         }
 173 |         return _data.dump(); 
 174 |     }
 175 | 
 176 |     size_t size() const {
 177 |         if (type == OBJECT) return obj_val.size();
 178 |         if (type == ARRAY) return arr_val.size();
 179 |         return 0;
 180 |     }
 181 | };

  321 | 
  322 | double readJsonNumberOrDefault(const JsonValue& value, double fallback) {
  323 |     if (value.type == JsonValue::INT || value.type == JsonValue::DOUBLE) return value.asDouble();
  324 |     return fallback;
  325 | }
  326 | 
  327 | int readJsonIntOrDefault(const JsonValue& value, int fallback) {
  328 |     if (value.type == JsonValue::INT || value.type == JsonValue::DOUBLE) return value.asInt();
  329 |     return fallback;
  330 | }
  331 | 
  332 | bool readJsonBoolOrDefault(const JsonValue& value, bool fallback) {
  333 |     if (value.type == JsonValue::BOOLEAN || value.type == JsonValue::INT) return value.asBool();
  334 |     return fallback;
  335 | }
  336 | 
  337 | std::string normalizeShipTypeRuntimeId(const std::string& value) {
  338 |     std::string normalized = value;
  339 |     std::transform(
  340 |         normalized.begin(),
  341 |         normalized.end(),
  342 |         normalized.begin(),
  343 |         [](unsigned char ch) { return (char)std::tolower(ch); }
  344 |     );
  345 |     return normalized;
  346 | }
  347 | 
  348 | const GameplayRuntimeConfig::ContainerTypeDescriptor* getContainerTypeDescriptor(const std::string& type) {
  349 |     auto descriptorIt = g_gameplay_runtime.container_types.find(type);
  350 |     if (descriptorIt == g_gameplay_runtime.container_types.end()) return nullptr;
  351 |     return &descriptorIt->second;
  352 | }
  353 | 
  354 | const GameplayRuntimeConfig::TransportDescriptor* getTransportDescriptor(const std::string& prototypeId) {
  355 |     auto descriptorIt = g_gameplay_runtime.transport_registry.find(prototypeId);
  356 |     if (descriptorIt == g_gameplay_runtime.transport_registry.end()) return nullptr;
  357 |     return &descriptorIt->second;
  358 | }
  359 | 
  360 | const GameplayRuntimeConfig::ShipTypeDescriptor* getShipTypeDescriptor(const std::string& shipTypeId) {
  361 |     auto descriptorIt = g_gameplay_runtime.ship_types.find(normalizeShipTypeRuntimeId(shipTypeId));
  362 |     if (descriptorIt == g_gameplay_runtime.ship_types.end()) return nullptr;
  363 |     return &descriptorIt->second;
  364 | }

  366 | void loadGameplayRuntimeConfig(const JsonValue& gameplayRuntime) {
  367 |     resetGameplayRuntimeConfig();
  368 |     if (gameplayRuntime.type != JsonValue::OBJECT) return;
  369 | 
  370 |     if (gameplayRuntime.has("inventory_engine") && gameplayRuntime["inventory_engine"].type == JsonValue::OBJECT) {
  371 |         JsonValue inventoryEngine = gameplayRuntime["inventory_engine"];
  372 |         if (inventoryEngine.has("id_prefixes") && inventoryEngine["id_prefixes"].type == JsonValue::OBJECT) {
  373 |             JsonValue idPrefixes = inventoryEngine["id_prefixes"];
  374 |             if (idPrefixes.has("container") && idPrefixes["container"].type == JsonValue::STRING) {
  375 |                 g_gameplay_runtime.container_id_prefix = idPrefixes["container"].asString();
  376 |             }
  377 |             if (idPrefixes.has("item") && idPrefixes["item"].type == JsonValue::STRING) {
  378 |                 g_gameplay_runtime.item_id_prefix = idPrefixes["item"].asString();
  379 |             }
  380 |         }
  381 |     }
  382 | 
  383 |     if (gameplayRuntime.has("inventory") && gameplayRuntime["inventory"].type == JsonValue::OBJECT) {
  384 |         JsonValue inventory = gameplayRuntime["inventory"];
  385 |         if (inventory.has("default_item_weight")) {
  386 |             g_gameplay_runtime.default_item_weight = readJsonNumberOrDefault(
  387 |                 inventory["default_item_weight"],
  388 |                 g_gameplay_runtime.default_item_weight
  389 |             );
  390 |         }
  391 |         if (inventory.has("default_lock_difficulty")) {
  392 |             g_gameplay_runtime.default_lock_difficulty = readJsonIntOrDefault(
  393 |                 inventory["default_lock_difficulty"],
  394 |                 g_gameplay_runtime.default_lock_difficulty
  395 |             );
  396 |         }
  397 |         if (inventory.has("default_container_health")) {
  398 |             g_gameplay_runtime.default_container_health = readJsonIntOrDefault(
  399 |                 inventory["default_container_health"],
  400 |                 g_gameplay_runtime.default_container_health
  401 |             );
  402 |         }
  403 |         if (inventory.has("non_flammable_container_types") &&
  404 |             inventory["non_flammable_container_types"].type == JsonValue::ARRAY) {
  405 |             g_gameplay_runtime.non_flammable_container_types.clear();
  406 |             for (size_t i = 0; i < inventory["non_flammable_container_types"].size(); ++i) {
  407 |                 if (inventory["non_flammable_container_types"][i].type == JsonValue::STRING) {
  408 |                     g_gameplay_runtime.non_flammable_container_types.insert(
  409 |                         inventory["non_flammable_container_types"][i].asString()
  410 |                     );
  411 |                 }
  412 |             }
  413 |         }
  414 |     }
  415 | 
  416 |     if (gameplayRuntime.has("currency") && gameplayRuntime["currency"].type == JsonValue::OBJECT) {
  417 |         JsonValue currency = gameplayRuntime["currency"];
  418 |         if (currency.has("physical_weights") && currency["physical_weights"].type == JsonValue::OBJECT) {
  419 |             g_gameplay_runtime.currency_physical_weights.clear();
  420 |             for (const auto& [itemId, value] : currency["physical_weights"].obj_val) {
  421 |                 if (value.type == JsonValue::INT || value.type == JsonValue::DOUBLE) {
  422 |                     g_gameplay_runtime.currency_physical_weights[itemId] = value.asDouble();
  423 |                 }
  424 |             }
  425 |         }
  426 |     }
  427 | 
  428 |     // Parse simulation config
  429 |     if (gameplayRuntime.has("simulation") && gameplayRuntime["simulation"].type == JsonValue::OBJECT) {
  430 |         const JsonValue& sim = gameplayRuntime["simulation"];
  431 |         auto ri=[](const JsonValue& o,const std::string& k,int d){return o.has(k)?o[k].asInt():d;};
  432 |         auto rd=[](const JsonValue& o,const std::string& k,double d){return o.has(k)?o[k].asDouble():d;};
  433 |         if(sim.has("npc")&&sim["npc"].type==JsonValue::OBJECT){const JsonValue& n=sim["npc"];
  434 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_hunger_critical=ri(n,"hunger_critical",25);
  435 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_hunger_shopping=ri(n,"hunger_shopping",50);
  436 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_hunger_shopping_extra=ri(n,"hunger_shopping_extra",30);}
  437 |         if(sim.has("army")&&sim["army"].type==JsonValue::OBJECT){const JsonValue& a=sim["army"];
  438 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_army_morale_mutiny=ri(a,"morale_mutiny_threshold",50);
  439 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_army_morale_collapse=ri(a,"morale_collapse_threshold",20);
  440 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_army_morale_exhausted=ri(a,"morale_exhausted_threshold",40);
  441 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_army_daily_losses=rd(a,"daily_combat_losses",0.05);
  442 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_army_assault_losses=rd(a,"siege_assault_losses",0.15);
  443 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_army_mutiny_penalty=rd(a,"mutiny_size_penalty",0.9);
  444 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_army_threat_avoid=ri(a,"threat_npc_avoid",90);}
  445 |         if(sim.has("region")&&sim["region"].type==JsonValue::OBJECT){const JsonValue& r=sim["region"];
  446 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_region_stability_trade=ri(r,"stability_trade_min",40);
  447 |             g_gameplay_runtime.sim_region_stability_revolt=ri(r,"stability_revolt_threshold",30);

  486 |         if(sim.has("race_ecology")&&sim["race_ecology"].type==JsonValue::OBJECT){

  629 | void loadContainerTypeRuntimeConfig(const JsonValue& containerTypes) {
  630 |     g_gameplay_runtime.container_types.clear();

  632 | 
  633 |     for (const auto& [typeId, descriptorValue] : containerTypes.obj_val) {

  641 |         if (descriptorValue.has("health")) {
  642 |             descriptor.has_health = true;
  643 |             descriptor.health = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["health"], 0);
  644 |         }
  645 |         if (descriptorValue.has("lock_difficulty")) {
  646 |             descriptor.has_lock_difficulty = true;
  647 |             descriptor.lock_difficulty = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["lock_difficulty"], 0);
  648 |         }
  649 |         if (descriptorValue.has("flammable")) {
  650 |             descriptor.has_flammable = true;
  651 |             descriptor.flammable = readJsonBoolOrDefault(descriptorValue["flammable"], true);
  652 |         }
  653 |         if (descriptorValue.has("capacity")) {
  654 |             descriptor.has_capacity = true;
  655 |             descriptor.capacity = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["capacity"], 0);
  656 |         }
  657 |         if (descriptorValue.has("max_weight")) {
  658 |             descriptor.has_max_weight = true;
  659 |             descriptor.max_weight = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["max_weight"], 0);

  735 | void loadShipTypeRuntimeConfig(const JsonValue& shipTypesValue) {
  736 |     g_gameplay_runtime.ship_types.clear();
  737 | 
  738 |     JsonValue descriptors = shipTypesValue;
  739 |     if (shipTypesValue.type == JsonValue::OBJECT && shipTypesValue.has("ship_types")) {
  740 |         descriptors = shipTypesValue["ship_types"];
  741 |     }
  742 |     if (descriptors.type != JsonValue::ARRAY) return;
  743 | 
  744 |     for (size_t i = 0; i < descriptors.size(); ++i) {
  745 |         const JsonValue& descriptorValue = descriptors[i];
  746 |         if (descriptorValue.type != JsonValue::OBJECT || !descriptorValue.has("id")) continue;
  747 | 
  748 |         GameplayRuntimeConfig::ShipTypeDescriptor descriptor;
  749 |         descriptor.id = normalizeShipTypeRuntimeId(descriptorValue["id"].asString());
  750 |         if (descriptor.id.empty()) continue;
  751 | 
  752 |         if (descriptorValue.has("speed")) {
  753 |             descriptor.has_speed = true;
  754 |             descriptor.speed = readJsonNumberOrDefault(descriptorValue["speed"], 1.0);
  755 |         }
  756 |         if (descriptorValue.has("capacity")) {
  757 |             descriptor.has_capacity = true;
  758 |             descriptor.capacity = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["capacity"], 0);
  759 |         }
  760 |         if (descriptorValue.has("hull")) {
  761 |             descriptor.has_hull = true;
  762 |             descriptor.hull = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["hull"], 0);
  763 |         }
  764 |         if (descriptorValue.has("sailors")) {
  765 |             descriptor.has_sailors = true;
  766 |             descriptor.sailors = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["sailors"], 0);
  767 |         }
  768 |         if (descriptorValue.has("cannons")) {
  769 |             descriptor.has_cannons = true;
  770 |             descriptor.cannons = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["cannons"], 0);
  771 |         }
  772 |         if (descriptorValue.has("marines")) {
  773 |             descriptor.has_marines = true;
  774 |             descriptor.marines = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["marines"], 0);
  775 |         }
  776 |         if (descriptorValue.has("combat_power")) {
  777 |             descriptor.has_combat_power = true;
  778 |             descriptor.combat_power = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["combat_power"], 0);
  779 |         }
  780 |         if (descriptorValue.has("is_monster")) {
  781 |             descriptor.has_is_monster = true;
  782 |             descriptor.is_monster = readJsonBoolOrDefault(descriptorValue["is_monster"], false);
  783 |         }
  784 |         if (descriptorValue.has("build_days")) {
  785 |             descriptor.has_build_days = true;
  786 |             descriptor.build_days = readJsonIntOrDefault(descriptorValue["build_days"], 0);
  787 |         }
  788 |         if (descriptorValue.has("build_cost") && descriptorValue["build_cost"].type == JsonValue::OBJECT) {
  789 |             for (const auto& [tagId, costValue] : descriptorValue["build_cost"].obj_val) {
  790 |                 if (costValue.type == JsonValue::INT || costValue.type == JsonValue::DOUBLE) {
  791 |                     descriptor.build_cost[tagId] = std::max(0, costValue.asInt());
  792 |                 }
  793 |             }
  794 |         }
  795 | 
  796 |         g_gameplay_runtime.ship_types[descriptor.id] = descriptor;
  797 |     }
  798 | }

  800 | int getShipBuildCost(const GameplayRuntimeConfig::ShipTypeDescriptor* descriptor, const std::string& tagId, int fallback) {
  801 |     if (!descriptor) return fallback;
  802 |     auto it = descriptor->build_cost.find(tagId);
  803 |     if (it == descriptor->build_cost.end()) return fallback;
  804 |     return std::max(0, it->second);
  805 | }

  812 |     std::string generateName(const std::string& factionId, std::mt19937& gen) {
  813 |         // Resolve race from faction, or fall back to first available race
  814 |         std::string raceId = g_gameplay_runtime.default_race_id;
  815 |         auto ftrIt = g_db.faction_to_race.find(factionId);
  816 |         if (ftrIt != g_db.faction_to_race.end()) raceId = ftrIt->second;
  817 | 
  818 |         // Look up name group for this race
  819 |         auto ngIt = g_db.name_groups.find(raceId);
  820 |         if (ngIt != g_db.name_groups.end() && !ngIt->second.first_names.empty() && !ngIt->second.last_names.empty()) {
  821 |             const auto& ng = ngIt->second;
  822 |             const std::string& fn = ng.first_names[gen() % ng.first_names.size()];
  823 |             const std::string& ln = ng.last_names[gen() % ng.last_names.size()];
  824 |             return fn + " " + ln;
  825 |         }
  826 | 
  827 |         // Fallback: try any available name group
  828 |         for (const auto& [rid, ng] : g_db.name_groups) {
  829 |             if (!ng.first_names.empty() && !ng.last_names.empty()) {
  830 |                 const std::string& fn = ng.first_names[gen() % ng.first_names.size()];
  831 |                 const std::string& ln = ng.last_names[gen() % ng.last_names.size()];
  832 |                 return fn + " " + ln;
  833 |             }
  834 |         }
  835 | 
  836 |         // Last resort: generic placeholder
  837 |         return "Unknown " + std::to_string(gen() % 9999);
  838 |     }
  839 | 
  840 |     std::string generateBackground(int wealth_level, int paranoia, std::mt19937& gen) {
  841 |         std::string category;
  842 |         if (paranoia > 80) category = "insane";
  843 |         else if (wealth_level > 70) category = "rich";
  844 |         else if (wealth_level > 30) category = "middle";
  845 |         else category = "poor";
  846 | 
  847 |         auto bgIt = g_db.backgrounds.find(category);
  848 |         if (bgIt != g_db.backgrounds.end() && !bgIt->second.empty()) {
  849 |             return bgIt->second[gen() % bgIt->second.size()];
  850 |         }
  851 | 
  852 |         // Fallback: try "poor" category
  853 |         bgIt = g_db.backgrounds.find("poor");
  854 |         if (bgIt != g_db.backgrounds.end() && !bgIt->second.empty()) {
  855 |             return bgIt->second[gen() % bgIt->second.size()];
  856 |         }
  857 | 
  858 |         return "No background available.";
  859 |     }
  860 | }

  862 | bool hasBiomeTag(uint8_t biome_id, const std::string& tag) {
  863 |     auto it = g_db.biome_numeric_to_index.find(biome_id);
  864 |     if (it == g_db.biome_numeric_to_index.end()) return false;

  936 | // Thread-safe RNG (No std::random_device to prevent MinGW crashes)
  937 | inline int thread_safe_rand() {
  938 |     thread_local std::mt19937 gen(static_cast<unsigned int>(std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count()) ^ static_cast<unsigned int>(std::hash<std::thread::id>{}(std::this_thread::get_id())));
  939 |     thread_local std::uniform_int_distribution<> dist(0, 32767);
  940 |     return dist(gen);
  941 | }
  942 | 
  943 | // Helper: Generate UUID (Thread-safe)
  944 | std::string generateUUID() {
  945 |     thread_local std::mt19937 gen(static_cast<unsigned int>(std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count()) + static_cast<unsigned int>(std::hash<std::thread::id>{}(std::this_thread::get_id())) + 1);
  946 |     std::uniform_int_distribution<> hex_dist(0, 15);
  947 |     const char* hex = "0123456789abcdef";
  948 |     std::string uuid = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx";
  949 |     for (size_t i = 0; i < uuid.size(); i++) {
  950 |         if (uuid[i] == 'x') uuid[i] = hex[hex_dist(gen)];
  951 |         else if (uuid[i] == 'y') uuid[i] = hex[(hex_dist(gen) & 0x3) | 0x8];
  952 |     }
  953 |     return uuid;
  954 | }

 1029 | std::string getCoreIdByTag(const std::string& tag) {
 1030 |     // Strict data-driven path: canonical ids MUST come from data/tag_defaults.json.
 1031 |     // No registry-order fallback here — missing mappings are data contract errors.
 1032 |     auto defaultIt = g_db.tag_defaults.find(tag);
 1033 |     if (defaultIt == g_db.tag_defaults.end()) {
 1034 |         std::cerr << ("DATA ERROR: missing required tag_defaults entry for tag '" + tag + "'") << std::endl;
 1035 |         return "";
 1036 |     }
 1037 | 
 1038 |     const std::string& defaultId = defaultIt->second;
 1039 |     const ItemTemplate* tpl = g_itemRegistry.getTemplate(defaultId);
 1040 | 
 1041 |     if (!tpl) {
 1042 |         std::cerr << ("DATA ERROR: tag_defaults['" + tag + "'] points to missing item id '" + defaultId + "'") << std::endl;
 1043 |         return "";
 1044 |     }
 1045 | 
 1046 |     if (!tpl->hasTag(tag)) {
 1047 |         std::cerr << ("DATA ERROR: tag_defaults['" + tag + "']='" + defaultId + "' exists, but item does not have required tag '" + tag + "'") << std::endl;
 1048 |         return "";
 1049 |     }
 1050 | 
 1051 |     return defaultId;
 1052 | }

 1102 |     if (tpl->hasTag("processed_food")) return 80.0;

 1124 | double getSeasonalDemandMultiplier(const std::string& itemId, const std::string& season) {
 1125 |     if (season.empty()) return 1.0;
 1126 | 
 1127 |     const double explicitMult = getItemNumericProperty(itemId, season + "_demand_mult", -1.0);
 1128 |     if (explicitMult >= 0.0) return explicitMult;
 1129 | 
 1130 |     const ItemTemplate* tpl = g_itemRegistry.getTemplate(itemId);
 1131 |     if (!tpl) return 1.0;
 1132 | 
 1133 |     if (season == "winter") {
 1134 |         if (tpl->hasTag("food")) return 2.0;
 1135 |         if (tpl->hasTag("construction_material") || tpl->hasTag("animal_product")) return 1.5;
 1136 |     } else if (season == "autumn") {
 1137 |         if (tpl->hasTag("food")) return 0.5;
 1138 |     } else if (season == "spring") {
 1139 |         if (tpl->hasTag("tool")) return 2.0;
 1140 |     } else if (season == "summer") {
 1141 |         if (tpl->hasTag("luxury") || tpl->hasTag("potion")) return 1.5;
 1142 |     }
 1143 |

 1147 | std::vector<std::string> getContainerItemTypesByTagSorted(const std::string& containerId, const std::string& tag, const std::string& priorityProperty = "army_supply_priority") {
 1148 |     std::vector<std::pair<double, std::string>> rankedItems;
 1149 |     if (!g_containers.count(containerId)) return {};
 1150 | 
 1151 |     for (const auto& [itemType, qty] : g_containers[containerId].cached_stocks) {
 1152 |         if (qty <= 0 || !itemHasTag(itemType, tag)) continue;
 1153 |         rankedItems.push_back({getFoodPriority(itemType, priorityProperty), itemType});
 1154 |     }
 1155 | 
 1156 |     std::sort(rankedItems.begin(), rankedItems.end(), [](const auto& left, const auto& right) {
 1157 |         if (left.first != right.first) return left.first > right.first;
 1158 |         return left.second < right.second;
 1159 |     });
 1160 | 
 1161 |     std::vector<std::string> itemTypes;
 1162 |     itemTypes.reserve(rankedItems.size());
 1163 |     for (const auto& [priority, itemType] : rankedItems) {
 1164 |         itemTypes.push_back(itemType);
 1165 |     }
 1166 |     return itemTypes;
 1167 | }

 1175 | std::string createItem(const std::string& requestedPrototypeId, int quantity, const std::string& containerId,
 1176 |                        int currentDay = 0, const std::string& event = "Created") {
 1177 |     std::string prototypeId = getMappedId(requestedPrototypeId);
 1178 |     std::string new_id = g_gameplay_runtime.item_id_prefix + generateUUID();
 1179 |     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 1180 |     
 1181 |     if (!containerId.empty() && g_containers.count(containerId)) {
 1182 |         Storage& cont = g_containers[containerId];
 1183 |         auto it = cont.items_by_type.find(prototypeId);
 1184 |         if (it != cont.items_by_type.end()) {
 1185 |             for (const std::string& existingId : it->second) {
 1186 |                 if (g_items.count(existingId)) {
 1187 |                     PhysicalItem& exItem = g_items[existingId];
 1188 |                     bool canStack = false;
 1189 |                     if (!exItem.order_data.has_value() && !exItem.quest_item && exItem.durability == 100) {
 1190 |                         if (!prototypeId.empty()) {
 1191 |                             if (getShelfLifeDays(prototypeId) == 999999) canStack = true;
 1192 |                             else if (exItem.batch_day == currentDay) canStack = true;
 1193 |                         }
 1194 |                     }
 1195 |                     if (canStack) {
 1196 |                         exItem.stack_size += quantity;
 1197 |                         exItem.is_dirty = true;
 1198 |                         cont.cached_stocks[prototypeId] += quantity;
 1199 |                         cont.is_dirty = true;
 1200 |                         return existingId;
 1201 |                     }
 1202 |                 }
 1203 |             }
 1204 |         }
 1205 |     }
 1206 |     
 1207 |     PhysicalItem item;
 1208 |     item.id = new_id;
 1209 |     item.prototype_id = prototypeId;
 1210 |     item.stack_size = quantity;
 1211 |     item.container_id = containerId;
 1212 |     item.created_at = currentDay;
 1213 |     item.last_moved_at = currentDay;
 1214 |     item.batch_day = currentDay;
 1215 |     item.history.push_back({currentDay, event});
 1216 |     
 1217 |     if (g_db.items.count(prototypeId)) {
 1218 |         item.custom_props = g_db.items[prototypeId].properties;
 1219 |     }
 1220 |     
 1221 |     double baseWeight = g_gameplay_runtime.default_item_weight;
 1222 |     if (item.custom_props.has("weight_per_unit")) {
 1223 |         baseWeight = readJsonNumberOrDefault(item.custom_props["weight_per_unit"], baseWeight);
 1224 |     }
 1225 |     auto runtimeWeightIt = g_gameplay_runtime.currency_physical_weights.find(prototypeId);
 1226 |     if (runtimeWeightIt != g_gameplay_runtime.currency_physical_weights.end()) {
 1227 |         baseWeight = runtimeWeightIt->second;
 1228 |     }
 1229 |     item.custom_props.set("weight_per_unit", baseWeight);
 1230 |     
 1231 |     g_items[item.id] = item;
 1232 |     
 1233 |     if (!containerId.empty() && g_containers.count(containerId)) {
 1234 |         g_containers[containerId].item_ids.push_back(item.id);
 1235 |         g_containers[containerId].items_by_type[prototypeId].push_back(item.id);
 1236 |         g_containers[containerId].cached_stocks[prototypeId] += quantity;
 1237 |         g_containers[containerId].is_dirty = true;
 1238 |     }
 1239 |     
 1240 |     return item.id;
 1241 | }

 1243 | bool removeItem(const std::string& itemId, int quantity) {
 1244 |     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 1245 |     if (!g_items.count(itemId)) return false;
 1246 |     
 1247 |     PhysicalItem& item = g_items[itemId];
 1248 |     if (item.stack_size <= quantity) {
 1249 |         if (!item.container_id.empty() && g_containers.count(item.container_id)) {
 1250 |             Storage& cont = g_containers[item.container_id];
 1251 |             auto csIt = cont.cached_stocks.find(item.prototype_id);
 1252 |             if (csIt != cont.cached_stocks.end()) {
 1253 |                 csIt->second -= item.stack_size;
 1254 |                 if (csIt->second < 0) csIt->second = 0; // Prevent underflow
 1255 |             }
 1256 |             auto& vec = cont.item_ids;
 1257 |             auto it = std::find(vec.begin(), vec.end(), itemId);
 1258 |             if (it != vec.end()) {
 1259 |                 *it = std::move(vec.back());
 1260 |                 vec.pop_back();
 1261 |             }
 1262 |             auto& type_vec = cont.items_by_type[item.prototype_id];
 1263 |             auto it2 = std::find(type_vec.begin(), type_vec.end(), itemId);
 1264 |             if (it2 != type_vec.end()) {
 1265 |                 *it2 = std::move(type_vec.back());
 1266 |                 type_vec.pop_back();
 1267 |             }
 1268 |             cont.is_dirty = true;
 1269 |         }
 1270 |         g_deleted_items.push_back(itemId);
 1271 |         g_items.erase(itemId);
 1272 |     } else {
 1273 |         item.stack_size -= quantity;
 1274 |         item.is_dirty = true;
 1275 |         if (!item.container_id.empty() && g_containers.count(item.container_id)) {
 1276 |             auto& cs = g_containers[item.container_id].cached_stocks;
 1277 |             auto csIt = cs.find(item.prototype_id);
 1278 |             if (csIt != cs.end()) {
 1279 |                 csIt->second -= quantity;
 1280 |                 if (csIt->second < 0) csIt->second = 0; // Prevent underflow
 1281 |             }
 1282 |         }
 1283 |     }
 1284 |     return true;
 1285 | }

 1298 | double calculateContainerWeight(const std::string& containerId) {
 1299 |     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 1300 |     if (!g_containers.count(containerId)) return 0.0;
 1301 |     double totalWeight = 0.0;
 1302 |     for (const auto& itemId : g_containers[containerId].item_ids) {
 1303 |         if (g_items.count(itemId)) {
 1304 |             const PhysicalItem& item = g_items[itemId];
 1305 |             double w = item.custom_props.has("weight_per_unit") ? item.custom_props["weight_per_unit"].asDouble() : 1.0;
 1306 |             totalWeight += w * item.stack_size;
 1307 |         }
 1308 |     }
 1309 |     return totalWeight;
 1310 | }
 1311 | 
 1312 | int consumeItemsFromContainer(const std::string& containerId, const std::string& requestedPrototypeId, int quantity) {
 1313 |     std::string prototypeId = getMappedId(requestedPrototypeId);
 1314 |     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 1315 |     if (!g_containers.count(containerId)) return 0;
 1316 |     if (prototypeId.empty()) return 0;
 1317 |     
 1318 |     Storage& cont = g_containers[containerId];
 1319 |     int taken = 0;
 1320 |     int remaining = quantity;
 1321 |     
 1322 |     std::vector<std::pair<int, std::string>> itemsByAge;
 1323 |     auto it = cont.items_by_type.find(prototypeId);
 1324 |     if (it != cont.items_by_type.end()) {
 1325 |         for (const auto& itemId : it->second) {
 1326 |             if (g_items.count(itemId)) {
 1327 |                 itemsByAge.push_back({g_items[itemId].batch_day, itemId});
 1328 |             }
 1329 |         }
 1330 |     }
 1331 |     std::sort(itemsByAge.begin(), itemsByAge.end());
 1332 |     
 1333 |     for (const auto& [day, itemId] : itemsByAge) {
 1334 |         if (remaining <= 0) break;
 1335 |         if (!g_items.count(itemId)) continue;
 1336 |         
 1337 |         PhysicalItem& item = g_items[itemId];
 1338 |         int take = std::min(item.stack_size, remaining);
 1339 |         if (take > 0) {
 1340 |             removeItem(itemId, take);
 1341 |             remaining -= take;
 1342 |             taken += take;
 1343 |         }
 1344 |     }
 1345 |     
 1346 |     return taken;
 1347 | }

 1349 | int getCategoryAmount(const std::string& vault_id, const std::string& category) {
 1350 |     int total = 0;
 1351 |     if (g_containers.count(vault_id)) {
 1352 |         for (const auto& [item_type, qty] : g_containers[vault_id].cached_stocks) {
 1353 |             const ItemTemplate* tpl = g_itemRegistry.getTemplate(item_type);
 1354 |             if (tpl && tpl->hasTag(category)) total += qty;
 1355 |         }
 1356 |     }
 1357 |     return total;
 1358 | }

 1361 |     return getCategoryAmount(vault_id, "food");
 1362 | }
 1363 | 
 1364 | int consumeCategory(const std::string& vault_id, const std::string& category, int amount, const std::string& priorityProperty = "") {
 1365 |     int remaining = amount;
 1366 |     if (!g_containers.count(vault_id)) return 0;
 1367 | 
 1368 |     std::vector<std::string> itemTypes;
 1369 |     if (!priorityProperty.empty()) {
 1370 |         itemTypes = getContainerItemTypesByTagSorted(vault_id, category, priorityProperty);
 1371 |     } else {
 1372 |         for (const auto& [item_type, qty] : g_containers[vault_id].cached_stocks) {
 1373 |             const ItemTemplate* tpl = g_itemRegistry.getTemplate(item_type);
 1374 |             if (tpl && tpl->hasTag(category)) itemTypes.push_back(item_type);
 1375 |         }
 1376 |     }
 1377 | 
 1378 |     for (const auto& itemType : itemTypes) {
 1379 |         int taken = consumeItemsFromContainer(vault_id, itemType, remaining);
 1380 |         remaining -= taken;
 1381 |         if (remaining <= 0) break;
 1382 |     }
 1383 |     return amount - remaining;
 1384 | }

 1387 |     return consumeCategory(vault_id, "food", amount, "reserve_priority");
 1388 | }

 1392 |     if (!rankedFoods.empty()) return rankedFoods.front();
 1393 |     return getCoreIdByTag("food");

 1439 | struct Caravan {

 1452 |     int guards = 0;       // Количество нанятой охраны
 1453 |     int guard_cost = 0;   // Затраты на охрану
 1454 |     int transport_cost = 0; // Затраты на транспорт
 1455 |     
 1456 |     // Legacy goods map (for compatibility)
 1457 |     std::map<std::string, int> goods;
 1458 |     
 1459 |             
 1460 | 
 1461 |     JsonValue toJson() const {
 1462 |             JsonValue obj = JsonValue::object();
 1463 |             obj.set("id", id);
 1464 |             obj.set("merchant_id", merchant_id);
 1465 |             obj.set("owner_business_id", owner_business_id);
 1466 |             obj.set("origin", origin);
 1467 |             obj.set("destination", destination);
 1468 |             obj.set("hoursLeft", hoursLeft);
 1469 |             obj.set("x", x);
 1470 |             obj.set("y", y);
 1471 |             obj.set("path_index", path_index);
 1472 |             JsonValue pArr = JsonValue::array();
 1473 |             for (const auto& pt : path) {
 1474 |                 JsonValue ptArr = JsonValue::array();
 1475 |                 ptArr.push(pt.first); ptArr.push(pt.second);
 1476 |                 pArr.push(ptArr);
 1477 |             }
 1478 |             obj.set("path", pArr);
 1479 |             obj.set("chest_id", chest_id);
 1480 |             obj.set("wagons", wagons);
 1481 |             obj.set("guards", guards);
 1482 |             obj.set("guard_cost", guard_cost);
 1483 |             obj.set("transport_cost", transport_cost);
 1484 |         
 1485 |         JsonValue g = JsonValue::object();
 1486 |         for (const auto& [key, val] : goods) g.set(key, val);
 1487 |         obj.set("goods", g);
 1488 |         
 1489 |         return obj;
 1490 |     }
 1491 |     
 1492 |             static Caravan fromJson(const JsonValue& j) {
 1493 |             Caravan c;
 1494 |             c.id = j["id"].asString();
 1495 |             if (j.has("merchant_id")) c.merchant_id = j["merchant_id"].asString();
 1496 |             if (j.has("owner_business_id")) c.owner_business_id = j["owner_business_id"].asString();
 1497 |             c.origin = j["origin"].asString();
 1498 |             c.destination = j["destination"].asString();
 1499 |             c.hoursLeft = j["hoursLeft"].asInt();
 1500 |             if (j.has("x")) c.x = j["x"].asDouble();
 1501 |             if (j.has("y")) c.y = j["y"].asDouble();
 1502 |             if (j.has("path_index")) c.path_index = j["path_index"].asInt();
 1503 |             if (j.has("path")) {
 1504 |                 for (size_t i = 0; i < j["path"].size(); i++) {
 1505 |                     if (j["path"][i].size() >= 2) {
 1506 |                         c.path.push_back({j["path"][i][0].asInt(), j["path"][i][1].asInt()});
 1507 |                     }
 1508 |                 }
 1509 |             }
 1510 |             c.chest_id = j["chest_id"].asString();
 1511 |             if (j.has("wagons")) c.wagons = j["wagons"].asInt();
 1512 |             if (j.has("guards")) c.guards = j["guards"].asInt();
 1513 |             if (j.has("guard_cost")) c.guard_cost = j["guard_cost"].asInt();
 1514 |             if (j.has("transport_cost")) c.transport_cost = j["transport_cost"].asInt();
 1515 |         
 1516 |         if (j.has("goods")) {
 1517 |             for (const auto& kv : j["goods"].obj_val) {
 1518 |                 c.goods[kv.first] = kv.second.asInt();
 1519 |             }
 1520 |         }
 1521 |         
 1522 |         return c;
 1523 |     }

 1820 |     static NPC fromJson(const JsonValue& j) {
 1821 |         NPC npc;

 1823 |         npc.name = j["name"].asString();
 1824 |         npc.type = j["type"].asString();

 1830 |         npc.hp = j["hp"].asInt();

 1832 |         if (j.has("race")) npc.race = j["race"].asString();
 1833 |         if (j.has("age_days")) npc.age_days = j["age_days"].asInt();
 1834 |         if (j.has("is_male")) npc.is_male = j["is_male"].asBool();
 1835 |         if (j.has("father_id")) npc.father_id = j["father_id"].asString();
 1836 |         if (j.has("mother_id")) npc.mother_id = j["mother_id"].asString();
 1837 |         if (j.has("spouse_id")) npc.spouse_id = j["spouse_id"].asString();
 1838 |         if (j.has("immunity")) npc.immunity = j["immunity"].asInt(); else npc.immunity = 100;
 1839 |         if (j.has("death_day")) npc.death_day = j["death_day"].asInt();
 1840 |         if (j.has("death_cause")) npc.death_cause = j["death_cause"].asString();
 1841 | 
 1842 |         if (j.has("str")) npc.str = j["str"].asInt();
 1843 |         if (j.has("dex")) npc.dex = j["dex"].asInt();
 1844 |         if (j.has("con")) npc.con = j["con"].asInt();
 1845 |         if (j.has("int")) npc.int_ = j["int"].asInt();
 1846 |         if (j.has("cha")) npc.cha = j["cha"].asInt();
 1847 |         if (j.has("res")) npc.res = j["res"].asInt();
 1848 |         if (j.has("min_damage")) npc.min_damage = j["min_damage"].asInt();
 1849 |         if (j.has("max_damage")) npc.max_damage = j["max_damage"].asInt();
 1850 |         if (j.has("armor_class")) npc.armor_class = j["armor_class"].asInt();
 1851 |         if (j.has("isHostile")) npc.isHostile = j["isHostile"].asBool();

 1859 |         }

 2220 | struct PriceHistory {
 2221 |     std::vector<double> history;
 2222 |     int index = 0;
 2223 | 
 2224 |     void add(double price) {
 2225 |         if (history.size() < 30) {
 2226 |             history.push_back(price);
 2227 |         } else {
 2228 |             history[index] = price;
 2229 |             index = (index + 1) % 30;
 2230 |         }
 2231 |     }
 2232 | 
 2233 |     double getAvg(int days) const {
 2234 |         if (history.empty()) return 0.0;
 2235 |         int count = std::min((int)history.size(), days);
 2236 |         double sum = 0;
 2237 |         int curr = index - 1;
 2238 |         for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 2239 |             if (curr < 0) curr = history.size() - 1;
 2240 |             sum += history[curr];
 2241 |             curr--;
 2242 |         }
 2243 |         return sum / count;
 2244 |     }
 2245 | 
 2246 |     
 2247 | 
 2248 |     JsonValue toJson() const {
 2249 |         JsonValue obj = JsonValue::object();
 2250 |         JsonValue arr = JsonValue::array();
 2251 |         for (double p : history) arr.push(JsonValue(p));
 2252 |         obj.set("history", arr);
 2253 |         obj.set("index", index);
 2254 |         return obj;
 2255 |     }
 2256 | 
 2257 |     static PriceHistory fromJson(const JsonValue& j) {
 2258 |         PriceHistory ph;
 2259 |         if (j.has("history")) {
 2260 |             for (size_t i = 0; i < j["history"].size(); i++) {
 2261 |                 ph.history.push_back(j["history"][i].asDouble());
 2262 |             }
 2263 |         }
 2264 |         if (j.has("index")) ph.index = j["index"].asInt();
 2265 |         return ph;
 2266 |     }
 2267 | };

 2540 | void applyShipTypeRuntimeDescriptor(Ship& ship) {
 2541 |     const GameplayRuntimeConfig::ShipTypeDescriptor* descriptor =
 2542 |         getShipTypeDescriptor(shipTypeToString(ship.type));
 2543 |     if (!descriptor) return;
 2544 | 
 2545 |     if (descriptor->has_capacity) {
 2546 |         ship.cargo_capacity = descriptor->capacity;
 2547 |     }
 2548 |     if (descriptor->has_hull) {
 2549 |         ship.hull = std::max(1, descriptor->hull);
 2550 |     }
 2551 |     if (descriptor->has_sailors) {
 2552 |         ship.sailors = std::max(0, descriptor->sailors);
 2553 |     }
 2554 |     if (descriptor->has_speed && descriptor->speed > 0.0) {
 2555 |         ship.speed = descriptor->speed;
 2556 |     }
 2557 |     if (descriptor->has_cannons) {
 2558 |         ship.cannons = std::max(0, descriptor->cannons);
 2559 |     }
 2560 |     if (descriptor->has_marines) {
 2561 |         ship.marines = std::max(0, descriptor->marines);
 2562 |     }
 2563 | }

 3650 |     JsonValue toJson() const {
 3651 |         JsonValue obj = JsonValue::object();
 3652 |         obj.set("width", width);
 3653 |         obj.set("height", height);
 3654 |         obj.set("generation_tick", generation_tick);
 3655 |         obj.set("version", 2);
 3656 |         
 3657 |         // FIX: Serialize grid directly to nlohmann::json for massive speedup.
 3658 |         // Previously, each MapTile.toJson() created 6 JsonValue objects, then
 3659 |         // gridArr.push() rebuilt them into nlohmann::json. For 65536 tiles,
 3660 |         // this meant ~400K JsonValue allocations and 65536 nlohmann rebuilds.
 3661 |         // Now we build the nlohmann::json array directly — one allocation.
 3662 |         nlohmann::json gridJson = nlohmann::json::array();
 3663 |         gridJson.get_ref<nlohmann::json::array_t&>().reserve(grid.size());
 3664 |         for (const auto& t : grid) {
 3665 |             gridJson.push_back({(int)t.biome_id, (int)t.road_level, (int)t.bridge_flag,
 3666 |                                (int)t.water_depth, t.is_flooded, (int)t.road_condition});
 3667 |         }
 3668 |         obj.set("grid", JsonValue(gridJson));
 3669 |         
 3670 |         JsonValue locs = JsonValue::object();
 3671 |         for (const auto& [id, loc] : locations) {
 3672 |             locs.set(id, loc.toJson());
 3673 |         }
 3674 |         obj.set("locations", locs);
 3675 |         
 3676 |         JsonValue rds = JsonValue::array();
 3677 |         rds.arr_val.reserve(roads.size());
 3678 |         for (const auto& r : roads) {
 3679 |             rds.push(r.toJson());
 3680 |         }
 3681 |         obj.set("roads", rds);
 3682 | 
 3683 |         JsonValue disArr = JsonValue::array();
 3684 |         for (const auto& d : disasters) disArr.push(d.toJson());
 3685 |         obj.set("disasters", disArr);
 3686 |         
 3687 |         return obj;
 3688 |     }
 3689 | 
 3690 |     static WorldMap fromJson(const JsonValue& j) {
 3691 |         WorldMap m;
 3692 |         if (j.has("width")) m.width = j["width"].asInt();
 3693 |         if (j.has("height")) m.height = j["height"].asInt();
 3694 |         if (j.has("generation_tick")) m.generation_tick = j["generation_tick"].asInt();
 3695 |         int version = j.has("version") ? j["version"].asInt() : 1;
 3696 |         
 3697 |         std::vector<std::string> legacy_map = {
 3698 |             "ocean", "shallow_water", "plains", "forest", "mountains", "hills", "desert", "swamp", 
 3699 |             "tundra", "ruins", "anomaly", "river", "volcano", "riverbank", "lake", "floodplain", "lava", "ash"
 3700 |         };
 3701 | 
 3702 |         if (j.has("grid")) {
 3703 |             for (size_t i = 0; i < j["grid"].size(); i++) {
 3704 |                 MapTile t = MapTile::fromJson(j["grid"][i]);
 3705 |                 if (version < 2 && t.biome_id < legacy_map.size()) {
 3706 |                     std::string b_str = legacy_map[t.biome_id];
 3707 |                     t.biome_id = g_db.biome_string_to_id.count(b_str) ? g_db.biome_string_to_id[b_str] : 0;
 3708 |                 }
 3709 |                 m.grid.push_back(t);
 3710 |             }
 3711 |         } else if (j.has("tiles")) { // Legacy support
 3712 |             for (size_t i = 0; i < j["tiles"].size(); i++) {
 3713 |                 MapTile t;
 3714 |                 int old_id = j["tiles"][i].asInt();
 3715 |                 if (old_id >= 0 && old_id < legacy_map.size()) {
 3716 |                     std::string b_str = legacy_map[old_id];
 3717 |                     t.biome_id = g_db.biome_string_to_id.count(b_str) ? g_db.biome_string_to_id[b_str] : 0;
 3718 |                 } else {
 3719 |                     t.biome_id = 0;
 3720 |                 }
 3721 |                 m.grid.push_back(t);
 3722 |             }
 3723 |             if (j.has("road_grid")) {
 3724 |                 for (size_t i = 0; i < j["road_grid"].size() && i < m.grid.size(); i++) {
 3725 |                     m.grid[i].road_level = j["road_grid"][i].asInt();
 3726 |                 }
 3727 |             }
 3728 |         }
 3729 |         if (j.has("disasters")) {
 3730 |             for (size_t i = 0; i < j["disasters"].size(); i++) {
 3731 |                 m.disasters.push_back(Disaster::fromJson(j["disasters"][i]));
 3732 |             }
 3733 |         }
 3734 |         
 3735 |         if (j.has("locations")) {
 3736 |             for (const auto& kv : j["locations"].obj_val) {
 3737 |                 m.locations[kv.first] = MapLocation::fromJson(kv.second);
 3738 |             }
 3739 |         }
 3740 |         
 3741 |         if (j.has("roads")) {
 3742 |             for (size_t i = 0; i < j["roads"].size(); i++) {
 3743 |                 m.roads.push_back(MapRoad::fromJson(j["roads"][i]));

 3854 |     JsonValue getGraphContext(const std::vector<std::string>& query_ids, int limit) const {
 3855 |         std::set<std::string> event_ids;
 3856 |         for (const auto& q : query_ids) {
 3857 |             if (ari_graph.location_to_events.count(q)) {
 3858 |                 for (const auto& eid : ari_graph.location_to_events.at(q)) event_ids.insert(eid);
 3859 |             }
 3860 |             if (ari_graph.entity_to_events.count(q)) {
 3861 |                 for (const auto& eid : ari_graph.entity_to_events.at(q)) event_ids.insert(eid);
 3862 |             }
 3863 |         }
 3864 |         
 3865 |         std::vector<News> matched_news;
 3866 |         for (const auto& nw : news) {
 3867 |             if (event_ids.count(nw.id)) {
 3868 |                 matched_news.push_back(nw);
 3869 |             }
 3870 |         }
 3871 |         
 3872 |         std::sort(matched_news.begin(), matched_news.end(), [](const News& a, const News& b) {
 3873 |             return a.day > b.day;
 3874 |         });
 3875 |         
 3876 |         if (matched_news.size() > static_cast<size_t>(limit)) {
 3877 |             matched_news.resize(limit);
 3878 |         }
 3879 |         
 3880 |         JsonValue arr = JsonValue::array();
 3881 |         for (const auto& nw : matched_news) arr.push(nw.toJson());
 3882 |         return arr;
 3883 |     }

 3885 | 
 3886 |     JsonValue getRelevantNewsJson(const std::string& player_location, int limit) const {
 3887 |         std::vector<News> sorted_news = news;
 3888 |         int px = -1, py = -1;
 3889 |         if (!player_location.empty() && map.locations.count(player_location)) {
 3890 |             px = map.locations.at(player_location).x;
 3891 |             py = map.locations.at(player_location).y;
 3892 |         }
 3893 | 
 3894 |         for (auto& nw : sorted_news) {
 3895 |             int days_passed = std::max(0, current_day - nw.day);
 3896 |             double distance_penalty = 1.0;
 3897 |             
 3898 |             if (px != -1 && py != -1 && map.locations.count(nw.location)) {
 3899 |                 int nx = map.locations.at(nw.location).x;
 3900 |                 int ny = map.locations.at(nw.location).y;
 3901 |                 double dist = std::hypot(nx - px, ny - py);
 3902 |                 distance_penalty = std::max(0.1, 1.0 - (dist * 0.05)); 
 3903 |             } else if (nw.location == "global") {
 3904 |                 distance_penalty = 1.0;
 3905 |             } else {
 3906 |                 distance_penalty = 0.5;
 3907 |             }
 3908 |             
 3909 |             nw.current_weight = nw.base_weight * std::pow(0.95, days_passed) * distance_penalty;
 3910 |         }
 3911 | 
 3912 |         std::sort(sorted_news.begin(), sorted_news.end(), [](const News& a, const News& b) {
 3913 |             return a.current_weight > b.current_weight;
 3914 |         });
 3915 | 
 3916 |         if (sorted_news.size() > static_cast<size_t>(limit)) {
 3917 |             sorted_news.resize(limit);
 3918 |         }
 3919 | 
 3920 |         JsonValue arr = JsonValue::array();
 3921 |         for (const auto& nw : sorted_news) arr.push(nw.toJson());

 4122 | class PluginManager {
 4123 | private:
 4124 |     std::vector<void*> loaded_libraries;
 4125 |     std::vector<MetereaDailyTickFunc> daily_hooks;
 4126 | public:
 4127 |     void loadPlugins(const std::string& base_dir, const std::vector<std::string>& active_mods, World* w, Database* db, ItemRegistry* ir, FacilityRegistry* fr) {
 4128 |         for (const auto& mod_id : active_mods) {
 4129 |             if (mod_id == "base_game") continue;
 4130 |             std::string mod_dir = base_dir + "/" + mod_id;
 4131 |             if (!std::filesystem::exists(mod_dir)) continue;
 4132 |             try {
 4133 |                 for (const auto& entry : std::filesystem::recursive_directory_iterator(mod_dir)) {
 4134 |                     if (entry.is_regular_file()) {
 4135 |                         std::string ext = entry.path().extension().string();
 4136 |                         if (ext == ".dll" || ext == ".so") {
 4137 |                             void* handle = nullptr;
 4138 |                             #ifdef _WIN32
 4139 |                             handle = (void*)LoadLibraryA(entry.path().string().c_str());
 4140 |                             #else
 4141 |                             handle = dlopen(entry.path().string().c_str(), RTLD_LAZY);
 4142 |                             #endif
 4143 |                             
 4144 |                             if (handle) {
 4145 |                                 loaded_libraries.push_back(handle);
 4146 |                                 MetereaPluginInitFunc initFunc = nullptr;
 4147 |                                 MetereaDailyTickFunc tickFunc = nullptr;
 4148 |                                 
 4149 |                                 #ifdef _WIN32
 4150 |                                 initFunc = (MetereaPluginInitFunc)GetProcAddress((HMODULE)handle, "MetereaPluginInit");
 4151 |                                 tickFunc = (MetereaDailyTickFunc)GetProcAddress((HMODULE)handle, "MetereaDailyTick");
 4152 |                                 #else
 4153 |                                 initFunc = (MetereaPluginInitFunc)dlsym(handle, "MetereaPluginInit");
 4154 |                                 tickFunc = (MetereaDailyTickFunc)dlsym(handle, "MetereaDailyTick");
 4155 |                                 #endif
 4156 |                                 
 4157 |                                 if (initFunc) initFunc(w, db, ir, fr);
 4158 |                                 if (tickFunc) daily_hooks.push_back(tickFunc);
 4159 |                             }
 4160 |                         }
 4161 |                     }
 4162 |                 }
 4163 |             } catch (...) {}
 4164 |         }
 4165 |     }
 4166 |     
 4167 |     void runDailyHooks() {
 4168 |         for (auto hook : daily_hooks) {
 4169 |             if (hook) hook();
 4170 |         }
 4171 |     }
 4172 | };

 4176 | void triggerJsHook(const std::string& hookName) {
 4177 |     if (g_active_hooks.count(hookName) == 0) return;
 4178 |     
 4179 |     JsonValue req = JsonValue::object();
 4180 |     req.set("status", "hook_request");
 4181 |     req.set("hook", hookName);
 4182 |     req.set("world", g_world.toJson());
 4183 |     
 4184 |     {
 4185 |         std::lock_guard<std::mutex> outLock(g_output_mutex);
 4186 |         std::cout << req.toString() << std::endl;
 4187 |         std::cout.flush();
 4188 |     }
 4189 | 
 4190 |     // Read response with 10-second timeout to prevent indefinite hang
 4191 |     std::string line;
 4192 |     auto deadline = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(10);
 4193 |     while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < deadline) {
 4194 |         // Non-blocking check: use short timeout approach
 4195 |         if (std::cin.rdbuf()->in_avail() > 0 || std::cin.peek() != std::char_traits<char>::eof()) {
 4196 |             if (std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
 4197 |                 if (line.empty()) continue;
 4198 |                 JsonValue resp = parseJson(line);
 4199 |                 if (resp.has("command") && resp["command"].asString() == "hook_response") {
 4200 |                     if (resp.has("world")) {
 4201 |                         g_world = World::fromJson(resp["world"]);
 4202 |                     }
 4203 |                     break;
 4204 |                 }
 4205 |             }
 4206 |         } else {
 4207 |             std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(100));
 4208 |         }
 4209 |     }
 4210 |     // If timeout, continue without hook response — don't block engine
 4211 | }
 4212 |

 4216 |     JsonValue req = JsonValue::object();

 4219 |     try { req.set("data", dataBuilder()); } catch (...) {}
 4220 |     {
 4221 |         std::lock_guard<std::mutex> outLock(g_output_mutex);
 4222 |         std::cout << req.toString() << std::endl;
 4223 |         std::cout.flush();
 4224 |     }

 4228 | bool moveItem(const std::string& itemId, const std::string& targetContainerId) {
 4229 |     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 4230 |     if (!g_items.count(itemId)) return false;
 4231 |     if (!g_containers.count(targetContainerId)) return false;
 4232 |     
 4233 |     PhysicalItem& item = g_items[itemId];
 4234 |     std::string oldOwner = "";
 4235 |     
 4236 |     if (!item.container_id.empty() && g_containers.count(item.container_id)) {
 4237 |         Storage& oldCont = g_containers[item.container_id];
 4238 |         auto csIt = oldCont.cached_stocks.find(item.prototype_id);
 4239 |         if (csIt != oldCont.cached_stocks.end()) {
 4240 |             csIt->second -= item.stack_size;
 4241 |             if (csIt->second < 0) csIt->second = 0; // Prevent underflow
 4242 |         }
 4243 |         oldOwner = oldCont.owner_id;
 4244 |         auto& vec = oldCont.item_ids;
 4245 |         auto it = std::find(vec.begin(), vec.end(), itemId);
 4246 |         if (it != vec.end()) {
 4247 |             *it = std::move(vec.back());
 4248 |             vec.pop_back();
 4249 |         }
 4250 |         auto& type_vec = oldCont.items_by_type[item.prototype_id];
 4251 |         auto it2 = std::find(type_vec.begin(), type_vec.end(), itemId);
 4252 |         if (it2 != type_vec.end()) {
 4253 |             *it2 = std::move(type_vec.back());
 4254 |             type_vec.pop_back();
 4255 |         }
 4256 |         oldCont.is_dirty = true;
 4257 |     }
 4258 |     
 4259 |     std::string newOwner = g_containers[targetContainerId].owner_id;
 4260 |     if (!oldOwner.empty() && !newOwner.empty() && oldOwner != newOwner) {
 4261 |         item.history.push_back({g_world.current_day, "Владелец сменился: " + oldOwner + " -> " + newOwner});
 4262 |     }
 4263 | 
 4264 |     item.container_id = targetContainerId;
 4265 |     item.is_dirty = true;
 4266 |     g_containers[targetContainerId].item_ids.push_back(itemId);
 4267 |     g_containers[targetContainerId].items_by_type[item.prototype_id].push_back(itemId);
 4268 |     g_containers[targetContainerId].cached_stocks[item.prototype_id] += item.stack_size;
 4269 |     g_containers[targetContainerId].is_dirty = true;
 4270 |     
 4271 |     return true;
 4272 | }

 4278 | // Shelf life in days for each good type
 4279 | int getShelfLifeDays(const std::string& type) {
 4280 |     if (type.empty()) return 999999;
 4281 |     auto it = g_db.items.find(type);
 4282 |     if (it != g_db.items.end()) return it->second.shelfLife;
 4283 |     return 999999;
 4284 | }

 4286 | // Maximum news items retained — prevents unbounded memory growth during long simulations.
 4287 | // Old news beyond this limit is pruned on every addNews() call.
 4288 | static constexpr size_t MAX_NEWS_ITEMS = 500;
 4289 | 
 4290 | std::string addNews(const std::string& text, const std::string& location, int importance, const std::string& category = "misc", const std::string& causal_link = "", const std::vector<std::string>& entities = {}) {
 4291 |     std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_news_mutex);
 4292 |     News nw;
 4293 |     nw.id = "news_" + generateUUID();
 4294 |     nw.text = text;
 4295 |     nw.location = location;
 4296 |     nw.importance = importance;
 4297 |     nw.category = category;
 4298 |     nw.day = g_world.current_day;
 4299 |     nw.causal_link = causal_link;
 4300 |     nw.base_weight = importance * 20.0;
 4301 |     nw.current_weight = nw.base_weight;
 4302 |     g_world.news.push_back(nw);
 4303 |     g_world.ari_graph.addEvent(nw.id, location, entities);
 4304 | 
 4305 |     // Prune old news to prevent unbounded memory growth.
 4306 |     // Keep only the most recent MAX_NEWS_ITEMS entries.
 4307 |     if (g_world.news.size() > MAX_NEWS_ITEMS) {
 4308 |         size_t excess = g_world.news.size() - MAX_NEWS_ITEMS;
 4309 |         g_world.news.erase(g_world.news.begin(), g_world.news.begin() + excess);
 4310 |     }
 4311 | 
 4312 |     // Prune ari_graph: remove event references older than MAX_NEWS_ITEMS
 4313 |     if (g_world.ari_graph.entity_to_events.size() > MAX_NEWS_ITEMS * 2) {
 4314 |         for (auto& [k, v] : g_world.ari_graph.entity_to_events) {
 4315 |             if (v.size() > 50) {
 4316 |                 v.erase(v.begin(), v.begin() + (v.size() - 50));
 4317 |             }
 4318 |         }
 4319 |     }
 4320 |     if (g_world.ari_graph.location_to_events.size() > MAX_NEWS_ITEMS * 2) {
 4321 |         for (auto& [k, v] : g_world.ari_graph.location_to_events) {
 4322 |             if (v.size() > 50) {
 4323 |                 v.erase(v.begin(), v.begin() + (v.size() - 50));
 4324 |             }
 4325 |         }
 4326 |     }
 4327 | 
 4328 |     return nw.id;
 4329 | }

 4335 | // Process spoilage for all items in all containers
 4336 | void processSpoilage() {
 4337 |     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 4338 |     for (size_t i=0; i<g_containers.data.size(); ++i) {
 4339 |         if (!g_containers.active[i]) continue;
 4340 |         Storage& container = g_containers.data[i];
 4341 |         double heatMod = 1.0;
 4342 |         double coldMod = 1.0;
 4343 |         
 4344 |         std::string regionId = container.location.has("region_id") ? container.location["region_id"].asString() : "";
 4345 |         if (!regionId.empty() && g_world.regions.count(regionId)) {
 4346 |             std::string weather = g_world.regions[regionId].weather;
 4347 |             if (weather == "Жара") heatMod = 2.0;
 4348 |             if (weather == "Снег" || weather == "Метель") coldMod = 0.3;
 4349 |         }
 4350 |         
 4351 |         for (const auto& itemId : container.item_ids) {
 4352 |             if (!g_items.count(itemId)) continue;
 4353 |             
 4354 |             PhysicalItem& item = g_items[itemId];
 4355 | 
 4356 |             int maxLife = getShelfLifeDays(item.prototype_id);
 4357 |             if (maxLife == 999999) continue;
 4358 |             
 4359 |             int age = g_world.current_day - item.batch_day;
 4360 |             
 4361 |             double effectiveAge = age;
 4362 |             // Data-driven: use tags from ItemRegistry instead of hardcoded IDs
 4363 |             const ItemTemplate* tpl = g_itemRegistry.getTemplate(item.prototype_id);
 4364 |             bool isPerishable = (tpl && (tpl->hasTag("food") || tpl->hasTag("raw_food") || tpl->hasTag("consumable")));
 4365 |             if (isPerishable) {
 4366 |                 effectiveAge = age * heatMod * coldMod;
 4367 |             }
 4368 |             
 4369 |             if (effectiveAge >= maxLife) {
 4370 |                 item.history.push_back({g_world.current_day, "Сгнило полностью"});
 4371 |                 item.stack_size = 0;
 4372 |                 item.is_dirty = true;
 4373 |             } else {
 4374 |                 double freshness = 1.0 - (effectiveAge / (double)maxLife);
 4375 |                 freshness = std::max(0.1, freshness);
 4376 |                 
 4377 |                 // Data-driven: use tags instead of hardcoded IDs
 4378 |                 bool isDegrading = (tpl && (tpl->hasTag("raw_material") || tpl->hasTag("weapon") || tpl->hasTag("armor")));
 4379 |                 if (isDegrading) {
 4380 |                     if (effectiveAge > maxLife * 0.5) {
 4381 |                         freshness *= 0.5;
 4382 |                         item.durability = std::max(1, (int)(item.durability * 0.5));
 4383 |                         item.is_dirty = true;
 4384 |                     }
 4385 |                 }
 4386 |                 double old_quality = item.custom_props.has("quality") ? item.custom_props["quality"].asDouble() : -1.0;
 4387 |                 if (std::abs(old_quality - freshness) > 0.01 || item.is_dirty) {
 4388 |                     item.custom_props.set("quality", freshness);
 4389 |                     item.is_dirty = true;
 4390 |                 }
 4391 |             }

 4844 | void updateWeather() {
 4845 |     int month = ((g_world.current_day / 30) % 12) + 1;
 4846 |     for (auto& [rid, region] : g_world.regions) {
 4847 |         std::string season = "spring";
 4848 |         if (region.climate == "cold") {
 4849 |             if (month >= 4 && month <= 5) season = "spring";
 4850 |             else if (month >= 6 && month <= 7) season = "summer";
 4851 |             else if (month >= 8 && month <= 9) season = "autumn";
 4852 |             else season = "winter";
 4853 |         } else if (region.climate == "tropical") {
 4854 |             if (month >= 4 && month <= 9) season = "summer";
 4855 |             else season = "spring";
 4856 |         } else {
 4857 |             if (month >= 3 && month <= 5) season = "spring";
 4858 |             else if (month >= 6 && month <= 8) season = "summer";
 4859 |             else if (month >= 9 && month <= 11) season = "autumn";
 4860 |             else season = "winter";
 4861 |         }
 4862 |         region.current_season = season;
 4863 |         triggerJsHook("onSeasonChanged", [&](){ JsonValue _h=JsonValue::object(); _h.set("regionId",rid); _h.set("newSeason",season); return _h; });
 4864 |         if (region.weatherDaysLeft > 0) region.weatherDaysLeft--;
 4865 |         else {
 4866 |             std::vector<std::string> weathers = {"clear", "cloudy"};
 4867 |             if (region.climate == "tropical") {
 4868 |                 weathers.push_back("tropical_rain"); weathers.push_back("heatwave");
 4869 |             } else if (region.climate == "cold") {
 4870 |                 weathers.push_back("heavy_snow"); weathers.push_back("blizzard");
 4871 |             } else {
 4872 |                 if (season == "winter") { weathers.push_back("snow"); weathers.push_back("blizzard"); }
 4873 |                 else if (season == "spring" || season == "autumn") { weathers.push_back("rain"); weathers.push_back("fog"); }
 4874 |                 else { weathers.push_back("rain"); weathers.push_back("heatwave"); }
 4875 |             }
 4876 |             if (thread_safe_rand() % 100 < 1) weathers.push_back("aether_storm");
 4877 |             region.weather = weathers[thread_safe_rand() % weathers.size()];
 4878 |             triggerJsHook("onWeatherChanged", [&](){ JsonValue _h=JsonValue::object(); _h.set("regionId",rid); _h.set("newWeather",region.weather); _h.set("season",season); return _h; });
 4879 |             region.weatherDaysLeft = 3 + (thread_safe_rand() % 4);
 4880 |         }
 4881 |     }
 4882 | }

 4921 | void processDailyBusinesses() {
 4922 |     for (auto& [bId, bus] : g_world.businesses) {

 4924 |             bus.construction_days_left--;

 4940 |         bus.cash_balance -= maintenance_cost;
 4941 |

 4943 |             bus.durability -= 1;
 4944 |         }
 4945 |

 4947 |             std::string focusStr = bus.production_focus;

 4949 |             if (stock > 0) {
 4950 |                 double price = r.markets[focusStr];
 4951 |                 if (price <= 0) price = (g_db.items.count(focusStr) ? g_db.items.at(focusStr).basePrice : 1);
 4952 |                 
 4953 |                 double itemWeight = (focusStr == getCoreIdByTag("currency")) ? 0.01 : 1.0;
 4954 |                 double currentVaultWeight = calculateContainerWeight(r.vault_id);
 4955 |                 int maxCanSell = (r.storage_capacity - currentVaultWeight) / itemWeight;
 4956 |                 int actualSell = std::min(stock, maxCanSell);

 4959 |                     int revenue = actualSell * price;
 4960 |                     if (r.moneySupply >= revenue) {
 4961 |                         r.moneySupply -= revenue;
 4962 |                         bus.cash_balance += revenue;

 4964 |                         createItem(focusStr, actualSell, r.vault_id, g_world.current_day, "Business auto-sale");
 4965 |                         bus.addLog(g_world.current_day, "💰 Auto-sale to city (" + getGoodName(focusStr) + ", " + std::to_string(actualSell) + " pcs.): +" + std::to_string(revenue) + " g.");
 4966 |                     } else {
 4967 |                         bus.addLog(g_world.current_day, "⚠️ City treasury empty. Sale impossible.");
 4968 |                     }
 4969 |                 } else if (stock > 0) {

 4971 |                 }
 4972 |             }
 4973 |         }
 4974 |         
 4975 |         if (bus.is_active && bus.auto_buy_inputs && !bus.production_focus.empty()) {
 4976 |             std::string focusStr = bus.production_focus;

 4978 |             for (const auto& rec : g_db.recipes) {
 4979 |                 if (rec.facility == bus.facility_type && rec.outputs.count(focusStr)) {
 4980 |                     activeRecipe = &rec; break;

 4982 |             }
 4983 |             if (activeRecipe) {
 4984 |                 for (const auto& in : activeRecipe->inputs) {
 4985 |                     std::string inStr = in.first;

 4987 |                     int needed = (bus.employee_count / 2) * in.second;

 4991 |                         if (price <= 0) {

 5533 | static bool resolveTransportFromItemData(const std::string& prototypeId, std::string& transport_type, double& speed_mult, int& cargo_bonus, bool& water_only) {
 5534 |     auto defIt = g_db.items.find(prototypeId);
 5535 |     const JsonValue* props = nullptr;
 5536 |     if (defIt != g_db.items.end()) {
 5537 |         props = &defIt->second.properties;
 5538 |     }
 5539 | 
 5540 |     const GameplayRuntimeConfig::TransportDescriptor* descriptor = getTransportDescriptor(prototypeId);
 5541 |     const bool propsDeclareTransport = props && props->has("isTransport") && (*props)["isTransport"].asBool();
 5542 |     if (!propsDeclareTransport && descriptor == nullptr) return false;
 5543 | 
 5544 |     transport_type = (props && props->has("transport_type"))
 5545 |         ? (*props)["transport_type"].asString()
 5546 |         : (descriptor ? descriptor->id : prototypeId);
 5547 |     speed_mult = (props && props->has("speed_mult"))
 5548 |         ? (*props)["speed_mult"].asDouble()
 5549 |         : ((descriptor && descriptor->has_speed_multiplier) ? descriptor->speed_multiplier : 1.0);
 5550 |     cargo_bonus = (props && props->has("cargo_bonus"))
 5551 |         ? (*props)["cargo_bonus"].asInt()
 5552 |         : ((descriptor && descriptor->has_cargo_bonus) ? descriptor->cargo_bonus : 0);
 5553 |     water_only = (props && props->has("water_only"))
 5554 |         ? (*props)["water_only"].asBool()
 5555 |         : ((descriptor && descriptor->has_water_only) ? descriptor->water_only : false);
 5556 |     return transport_type != "none";
 5557 | }

 5559 | void processFarmers() {
 5560 |     std::vector<NPC*> active_npcs;
 5561 |     for (auto& [id, npc] : g_world.npcs) {
 5562 |         if (!npc.isAlive) continue;
 5563 |         if (npcHasProfessionType(npc, {"farmer", "fisherman"}) ||
 5564 |             npcHasProfessionAbility(npc, "hunting") ||
 5565 |             npcHasProfessionAbility(npc, "apiculture")) {
 5566 |             active_npcs.push_back(&npc);
 5567 |         }
 5568 |     }
 5569 |     std::unordered_map<std::string, std::unique_ptr<std::mutex>> r_locks;
 5570 |     for (const auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) r_locks[rid] = std::make_unique<std::mutex>();
 5571 | 
 5572 |     int num_threads = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
 5573 |     if (num_threads == 0) num_threads = 4;
 5574 |     int chunk_size = active_npcs.size() / num_threads + 1;
 5575 |     std::vector<std::future<void>> futures;
 5576 | 
 5577 |     for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {
 5578 |         int start_idx = t * chunk_size;
 5579 |         int end_idx = std::min((int)active_npcs.size(), (t + 1) * chunk_size);
 5580 |         if (start_idx >= active_npcs.size()) break;
 5581 | 
 5582 |         futures.push_back(getThreadPool()->enqueue([start_idx, end_idx, &active_npcs, &r_locks]() {
 5583 |             for (int i = start_idx; i < end_idx; ++i) {
 5584 |                 NPC& npc = *active_npcs[i];
 5585 |                 if (!g_world.regions.count(npc.currentLocation)) continue;
 5586 |                 Region& r = g_world.regions[npc.currentLocation];
 5587 |                 std::string contId = npc.economy.storage_id.empty() ? npc.inventory_id : npc.economy.storage_id;
 5588 |                 if (contId.empty()) continue;
 5589 | 
 5590 |                 double seasonMod = 1.0;
 5591 |                 if (r.current_season == "spring") seasonMod = 1.2;
 5592 |                 else if (r.current_season == "summer") seasonMod = 1.5;
 5593 |                 else if (r.current_season == "autumn") seasonMod = 2.0;
 5594 |                 else if (r.current_season == "winter") seasonMod = 0.2;
 5595 |                 if (r.weather == "Эфирный шторм") seasonMod = 0.0;
 5596 |                 
 5597 |                 double yield = npc.economy.skillLevel * r.fertility * seasonMod;
 5598 |                 const std::string toolItemId = getNpcToolItemId(npc);
 5599 |                 if (!toolItemId.empty() && countItemsInContainer(contId, toolItemId) > 0) yield *= 1.5;
 5600 |                 int amount = std::max(1, (int)yield);
 5601 | 
 5602 |                 std::vector<std::string> goodsToCheck;
 5603 |                 if (npcHasProfessionAbility(npc, "hunting") && regionHasFacility(r, "hunting_lodges")) {
 5604 |                     const double raceMod = getNpcFacilityRaceModifier(npc, "hunting_lodges");
 5605 |                     const int scaledAmount = std::max(1, (int)(amount * raceMod));
 5606 |                     const std::string foodOutput = getPreferredFacilityOutputForRegion(r, "hunting_lodges", "food", {"meat"}, {"meat", "raw_food"});
 5607 |                     const std::string materialOutput = getPreferredFacilityOutputForRegion(r, "hunting_lodges", "raw_material", {"fur"}, {"animal_product", "raw_material"});
 5608 |                     const std::string trophyOutput = getPreferredFacilityOutputForRegion(r, "hunting_lodges", "", {"monster_parts"});
 5609 | 
 5610 |                     if (!foodOutput.empty()) {
 5611 |                         createItem(foodOutput, scaledAmount, contId, g_world.current_day, "Hunt");
 5612 |                         goodsToCheck.push_back(foodOutput);
 5613 |                     }
 5614 |                     if (!materialOutput.empty()) {
 5615 |                         createItem(materialOutput, std::max(1, scaledAmount / 2), contId, g_world.current_day, "Hunt");
 5616 |                         goodsToCheck.push_back(materialOutput);

 6002 | void processDailyEconomy() {
 6003 |     int month = ((g_world.current_day / 30) % 12) + 1;
 6004 |     std::string season = "winter";
 6005 |     if (month >= 3 && month <= 5) season = "spring";
 6006 |     else if (month >= 6 && month <= 8) season = "summer";
 6007 |     else if (month >= 9 && month <= 11) season = "autumn";
 6008 | 
 6009 |     std::vector<Region*> active_regions;
 6010 |     for (auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {
 6011 |         if (r.population > 0 && r.base_type != "ruins" && r.base_type != "anomaly") {
 6012 |             active_regions.push_back(&r);
 6013 |         }
 6014 |     }
 6015 | 
 6016 |     int num_threads = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
 6017 |     if (num_threads == 0) num_threads = 4;
 6018 |     int chunk_size = active_regions.size() / num_threads + 1;
 6019 |     std::vector<std::future<void>> futures;
 6020 | 
 6021 |     for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {
 6022 |         int start_idx = t * chunk_size;
 6023 |         int end_idx = std::min((int)active_regions.size(), (t + 1) * chunk_size);
 6024 |         if (start_idx >= active_regions.size()) break;
 6025 | 
 6026 |         futures.push_back(getThreadPool()->enqueue([start_idx, end_idx, &active_regions, season]() {
 6027 |             for (int idx = start_idx; idx < end_idx; ++idx) {
 6028 |                 Region& region = *active_regions[idx];
 6029 |                 std::string rid = region.id;
 6030 |                 
 6031 |                 std::unordered_map<std::string, int> vaultStocks;
 6032 |                 {
 6033 |                     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 6034 |                     if (!region.vault_id.empty() && g_containers.count(region.vault_id)) {
 6035 |                         vaultStocks = g_containers[region.vault_id].cached_stocks;
 6036 |                     }
 6037 |                 }
 6038 | 
 6039 |                 int totalFood = getFoodAmount(region.vault_id);
 6040 |                 
 6041 |                 double foodPerCapita = totalFood / (double)std::max(1, region.population);
 6042 |
