 7402 | void processMonthlyDemographics() {
 7403 |     for (auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {
 7404 |         if (r.age_pyramid.empty() || r.age_pyramid.size() < 121) {
 7405 |             r.age_pyramid.assign(121, 0.0);
 7406 |             double children = r.population * 0.20;
 7407 |             double workers = r.population * 0.60;
 7408 |             double elders = r.population * 0.20;
 7409 |             for(int i=0; i<=17; i++) r.age_pyramid[i] = children / 18.0;
 7410 |             for(int i=18; i<=65; i++) r.age_pyramid[i] = workers / 48.0;
 7411 |             for(int i=66; i<=120; i++) r.age_pyramid[i] = elders / 55.0;
 7412 |         }
 7413 | 
 7414 |         int food = getFoodAmount(r.vault_id);
 7415 |         double food_per_capita = food / (double)std::max(1, r.population);
 7416 | 
 7417 |         double famine_mult = 1.0;
 7418 |         if (food_per_capita < 0.5) famine_mult += (0.5 - food_per_capita) * 2.0;
 7419 | 
 7420 |         auto get_mortality = [](int age) -> double {
 7421 |             if (age == 0) return 0.02 / 12.0;
 7422 |             if (age <= 4) return 0.005 / 12.0;
 7423 |             if (age <= 14) return 0.002 / 12.0;
 7424 |             if (age <= 49) return 0.003 / 12.0;
 7425 |             if (age <= 64) return 0.01 / 12.0;
 7426 |             if (age <= 79) return 0.03 / 12.0;
 7427 |             return 0.10 / 12.0;
 7428 |         };
 7429 | 
 7430 |         for (int i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
 7431 |             double deaths = r.age_pyramid[i] * get_mortality(i) * famine_mult;
 7432 |             if (g_bootstrap) deaths = 0.0;
 7433 |             r.age_pyramid[i] = std::max(0.0, r.age_pyramid[i] - deaths);
 7434 |         }
 7435 | 
 7436 |         double optimalCapacity = r.storage_capacity * 2.0;
 7437 |         double birth_rate = 0.001 * std::clamp(1.0 - (r.population / optimalCapacity), 0.2, 1.0) * std::clamp(food_per_capita, 0.4, 1.0);
 7438 | 
 7439 |         double births = r.population * birth_rate;
 7440 |         r.age_pyramid[0] += births;
 7441 | 
 7442 |         // Рождение NPC-агентов (5% от статистических рождений)
 7443 |         int npc_births = (int)(births * 0.05);
 7444 |         if (npc_births > 0) {
 7445 |             std::vector<std::string> potential_parents;
 7446 |             for (const auto& [nid, npc] : g_world.npcs) {
 7447 |                 if (npc.homeLocation == rid && npc.age_days >= 18 * 360 && npc.age_days <= 50 * 360) {
 7448 |                     potential_parents.push_back(nid);
 7449 |                 }
 7450 |             }
 7451 |             for (int i = 0; i < npc_births; i++) {
 7452 |                 NPC child;
 7453 |                 child.id = "npc_" + generateUUID();

 7455 |                 child.type = "npc";
 7456 |                 child.profession = "none";
 7457 |                 child.homeLocation = rid;
 7458 |                 child.currentLocation = rid;
 7459 |                 child.currentActivity = "Играет";

 7461 |                 child.is_male = (thread_safe_rand() % 2 == 0);
 7462 |                 child.immunity = 40 + thread_safe_rand() % 60;

 7467 |                 if (potential_parents.size() >= 2) {

 7514 |

 7517 |     }
 7518 | 
 7519 |     // Фаза миграции (Социальный гомеостаз)
 7520 |     for (auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {

 7525 | 
 7526 |         for (const auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
 7527 |             if (road.condition == "blocked") continue;
 7528 |             std::string neighbor_id = "";

 7530 |             else if (road.to == rid) neighbor_id = road.from;
 7531 |

 7533 |                 Region& neighbor = g_world.regions[neighbor_id];
 7534 |

 7537 |                     if (g_world.factions[r.factionId].diplomacy.at(neighbor.factionId) == "war") atWar = true;
 7538 |                 }
 7539 |                 if (atWar) continue;

 7545 |                 }
 7546 |             }
 7547 |         }
 7548 | 
 7549 |         if (!best_target.empty()) {
 7550 |             Region& target = g_world.regions[best_target];

 7552 |             double migrants = r.population * migration_rate;
 7553 | 
 7554 |             double factor = 1.0 - (migrants / r.population);
 7555 |             for (int i = 0; i <= 120; i++) {
 7556 |                 double moving = r.age_pyramid[i] * (1.0 - factor);
 7557 |                 r.age_pyramid[i] -= moving;
 7558 |                 target.age_pyramid[i] += moving;

 7603 | void processMonthlyBusinesses() {
 7604 |     for (auto& [id, npc] : g_world.npcs) {
 7605 |         if (!npc.isAlive || npc.age_days < 18 * 360) continue;
 7606 |         if (!g_world.regions.count(npc.currentLocation)) continue;
 7607 |         
 7608 |         Region& r = g_world.regions[npc.currentLocation];
 7609 |         int monthly_payroll = 100 * r.average_wage;
 7610 |         if (npc.economy.savings < 200 + (monthly_payroll * 2)) continue;
 7611 |         
 7612 |         if ((rand() % 100) < 10) {
 7613 |             std::string best_type = "";
 7614 |             double best_profit = -999999.0;
 7615 |             std::string best_focus = "";
 7616 | 
 7617 |             for (const auto& recipe : g_db.recipes) {
 7618 |                 double cost = 0;
 7619 |                 for (const auto& in : recipe.inputs) {
 7620 |                     std::string inStr = in.first;
 7621 |                     cost += (r.markets.count(inStr) ? r.markets.at(inStr) : 0) * in.second;
 7622 |                 }
 7623 |                 double rev = 0;
 7624 |                 for (const auto& out : recipe.outputs) {
 7625 |                     std::string outStr = out.first;
 7626 |                     rev += (r.markets.count(outStr) ? r.markets.at(outStr) : 0) * out.second;
 7627 |                 }
 7628 |                 
 7629 |                 double margin = rev - cost;
 7630 |                 if (margin > best_profit) {
 7631 |                     best_profit = margin;
 7632 |                     best_type = recipe.facility;
 7633 |                     best_focus = recipe.outputs.begin()->first;
 7634 |                 }
 7635 |             }
 7636 |             
 7637 |             for (const auto& [fId, facTpl] : g_facilityRegistry.getAll()) {
 7638 |                 if (facTpl.hasTag("extractor")) {
 7639 |                     for (const auto& [res, rate] : facTpl.extraction_rates) {
 7640 |                         if (r.available_raw_resources.count(res)) {
 7641 |                             double price = r.markets.count(res) ? r.markets.at(res) : 0;
 7642 |                             if (price <= 0) price = (g_db.items.count(res) ? g_db.items.at(res).basePrice : 1);
 7643 |                             double profit = price * rate * 10.0;
 7644 |                             if (profit > best_profit) {
 7645 |                                 best_profit = profit;
 7646 |                                 best_type = fId;
 7647 |                                 best_focus = res;
 7648 |                             }
 7649 |                         }
 7650 |                     }
 7651 |                 }
 7652 |             }
 7653 |             
 7654 |             if (!best_type.empty() && best_profit > 0) {
 7655 |                 const FacilityTemplate* bestFacTpl = g_facilityRegistry.getTemplate(best_type);
 7656 |                 int build_cost = bestFacTpl ? bestFacTpl->build_cost : 500;
 7657 |

 7689 |                 }

 7691 |         }

 7694 |     std::vector<std::string> bankruptcies;

 8072 | // Simulate one hour
 8073 | void processFleets() {
 8074 |     for (auto& [rid, port] : g_world.port_facilities) port.is_blockaded = false;
 8075 | 
 8076 |     for (auto it = g_world.fleets.begin(); it != g_world.fleets.end(); ) {
 8077 |         Fleet& f = *it;
 8078 |         f.ship_ids.erase(std::remove_if(f.ship_ids.begin(), f.ship_ids.end(), [](const std::string& sid) {
 8079 |             bool found = false;
 8080 |             for (const auto& s : g_world.ships) if (s.id == sid && s.hull > 0) found = true;
 8081 |             return !found;
 8082 |         }), f.ship_ids.end());
 8083 | 
 8084 |         if (f.ship_ids.empty()) {
 8085 |             it = g_world.fleets.erase(it);
 8086 |             continue;
 8087 |         }
 8088 | 
 8089 |         if (!f.path.empty() && f.path_index < (int)f.path.size() - 1) {
 8090 |             double speed = 1.2;
 8091 |             std::string current_region = "";
 8092 |             for (const auto& [rid, loc] : g_world.map.locations) {
 8093 |                 if (std::abs(loc.x - f.x) <= 2 && std::abs(loc.y - f.y) <= 2) { current_region = rid; break; }
 8094 |             }
 8095 |             if (!current_region.empty() && g_world.regions.count(current_region)) {
 8096 |                 std::string w = g_world.regions[current_region].weather;
 8097 |                 if (w == "Эфирный шторм" || w == "Метель") speed *= 0.2;
 8098 |                 else if (w == "Дождь" || w == "Тропический ливень") speed *= 0.7;
 8099 |                 else if (w == "Туман") speed *= 0.5;
 8100 |             }
 8101 | 
 8102 |             while (speed > 0 && f.path_index < (int)f.path.size() - 1) {
 8103 |                 double target_x = f.path[f.path_index + 1].first;
 8104 |                 double target_y = f.path[f.path_index + 1].second;
 8105 |                 double dx = target_x - f.x;
 8106 |                 double dy = target_y - f.y;
 8107 |                 double dist = std::hypot(dx, dy);
 8108 |                 
 8109 |                 if (dist <= speed) {
 8110 |                     f.x = target_x; f.y = target_y;
 8111 |                     speed -= dist; f.path_index++;
 8112 |                 } else {
 8113 |                     f.x += (dx / dist) * speed; f.y += (dy / dist) * speed;
 8114 |                     speed = 0;
 8115 |                 }
 8116 |             }
 8117 |         }
 8118 | 
 8119 |         for (auto& s : g_world.ships) {
 8120 |             if (s.fleet_id == f.id) { s.x = f.x; s.y = f.y; }
 8121 |         }
 8122 | 
 8123 |         if (f.path_index >= (int)f.path.size() - 1 && f.mission == "blockade") {
 8124 |             if (g_world.port_facilities.count(f.destination)) {
 8125 |                 g_world.port_facilities[f.destination].is_blockaded = true;
 8126 |             }
 8127 |         }
 8128 |         ++it;
 8129 |     }

 8133 | void processShips() {
 8134 |     for (auto& ship : g_world.ships) {
 8135 | 
 8136 |         if (!ship.fleet_id.empty()) continue;
 8137 | 
 8138 |         if (ship.type == ShipType::SEA_MONSTER) {
 8139 |             double min_dist = 9999;
 8140 |             Ship* target = nullptr;
 8141 |             for (auto& s : g_world.ships) {
 8142 |                 if (s.id != ship.id && s.type != ShipType::SEA_MONSTER && s.hull > 0) {
 8143 |                     double d = std::hypot(s.x - ship.x, s.y - ship.y);
 8144 |                     if (d < min_dist) { min_dist = d; target = &s; }
 8145 |                 }
 8146 |             }
 8147 |             if (target) {
 8148 |                 if (min_dist <= 1.5) {
 8149 |                     if (target->cannons > 0 || target->marines > 0) {
 8150 |                         ship.hull -= (target->cannons * 10 + target->marines * 5);
 8151 |                         target->hull -= 30;
 8152 |                         addNews(locStr("engine.news.naval.sea_monster_battle"), "global", 4, "war");
 8153 |                         if (ship.hull <= 0) addNews(locStr("engine.news.naval.sea_monster_killed"), "global", 5, "war");
 8154 |                         if (ship.hull <= 0) triggerJsHook("onShipDestroyed", [&](){ JsonValue _h=JsonValue::object(); _h.set("shipId",ship.id); _h.set("cause","sea_monster"); return _h; });
 8155 |                     } else {
 8156 |                         target->hull -= 50;
 8157 |                         addNews(locStr("engine.news.naval.sea_monster_attacks_trade"), "global", 4, "disaster");
 8158 |                     }
 8159 |                 } else {
 8160 |                     double dx = target->x - ship.x;
 8161 |                     double dy = target->y - ship.y;
 8162 |                     ship.x += (dx / min_dist) * ship.speed;
 8163 |                     ship.y += (dy / min_dist) * ship.speed;
 8164 |                 }
 8165 |             }
 8166 |             continue;
 8167 |         }
 8168 |         if (ship.path.empty() || ship.path_index >= (int)ship.path.size() - 1) continue;
 8169 |         
 8170 |         double speed = ship.speed;
 8171 |         if (g_world.regions.count(ship.destination)) {
 8172 |             std::string w = g_world.regions[ship.destination].weather;
 8173 |             if (w == "Эфирный шторм" || w == "Метель") speed *= 0.2;
 8174 |             else if (w == "Дождь" || w == "Туман" || w == "Тропический ливень") speed *= 0.7;
 8175 |         }
 8176 |         
 8177 |         while (speed > 0 && ship.path_index < (int)ship.path.size() - 1) {
 8178 |             double target_x = ship.path[ship.path_index + 1].first;
 8179 |             double target_y = ship.path[ship.path_index + 1].second;
 8180 |             double dx = target_x - ship.x;
 8181 |             double dy = target_y - ship.y;
 8182 |             double dist = std::hypot(dx, dy);
 8183 |             
 8184 |             if (dist <= speed) {
 8185 |                 ship.x = target_x;
 8186 |                 ship.y = target_y;
 8187 |                 speed -= dist;
 8188 |                 ship.path_index++;
 8189 |             } else {
 8190 |                 ship.x += (dx / dist) * speed;
 8191 |                 ship.y += (dy / dist) * speed;
 8192 |                 speed = 0;
 8193 |             }
 8194 |         }
 8195 |         
 8196 |         if (ship.path_index >= (int)ship.path.size() - 1) {
 8197 |             std::string dest = ship.destination;
 8198 |             if (g_world.regions.count(dest) && g_world.port_facilities.count(dest)) {
 8199 |                 if (g_world.port_facilities[dest].is_blockaded) {
 8200 |                     addNews(locStr("engine.news.naval.blockade_trade_blocked", {{"port", g_world.regions[dest].name}}), dest, 3, "trade");
 8201 |                     ship.path.clear();
 8202 |                     ship.path_index = 0;
 8203 |                     continue;
 8204 |                 }
 8205 |                 Region& destReg = g_world.regions[dest];
 8206 |                 if (ship.type == ShipType::MERCHANT && g_containers.count(ship.chest_id)) {
 8207 |                     Storage& chest = g_containers[ship.chest_id];
 8208 |                     double totalRevenue = 0;
 8209 |                     std::map<std::string, int> deliveredGoods;
 8210 |                     std::vector<std::string> items_to_move = chest.item_ids;
 8211 |                     
 8212 |                     for (const auto& itemId : items_to_move) {
 8213 |                         if (!g_items.count(itemId)) continue;
 8214 |                         PhysicalItem& item = g_items[itemId];
 8215 |                         
 8216 |                         double price = destReg.markets[item.prototype_id];
 8217 |                         if (price <= 0) {
 8218 |                             auto it = g_db.items.find(item.prototype_id);
 8219 |                             price = (it != g_db.items.end()) ? it->second.basePrice : 1;
 8220 |                         }
 8221 |                         
 8222 |                         int affordable_qty = item.stack_size;
 8223 |                         double itemRev = item.stack_size * price;
 8224 |                         
 8225 |                         if (destReg.moneySupply < itemRev) {
 8226 |                             affordable_qty = std::floor(destReg.moneySupply / price);
 8227 |                             itemRev = affordable_qty * price;
 8228 |                         }
 8229 |

 8232 |                             totalRevenue += itemRev;

 8236 |                                 moveItem(itemId, destReg.vault_id);

 8240 |                             }
 8241 |                         }
 8242 |                     }
 8243 |

 8245 |                     destReg.moneySupply += portFee;

 8247 |                     
 8248 |                     if (g_world.factions.count(ship.owner_id)) {

 8255 |                     }

 8265 |                 }

 8282 |             if (itemDef.category == "document") continue;

 8287 |             if (inDock >= 200) continue; // Dock already has enough
 8288 |

 8290 |             if (toExport <= 0) continue;

 8298 | void processNavalTrade() {
 8299 |     std::vector<bool> dummy_has_road(g_world.map.width * g_world.map.height, false);
 8300 |     std::vector<int> dummy_path_status(g_world.map.width * g_world.map.height, 0);
 8301 | 
 8302 |     for (auto& ship : g_world.ships) {
 8303 |         if (ship.type != ShipType::MERCHANT || !ship.path.empty()) continue;
 8304 | 
 8305 |         std::string current_port = "";
 8306 |         for (const auto& [rid, port] : g_world.port_facilities) {
 8307 |             if (g_world.map.locations.count(rid)) {
 8308 |                 auto loc = g_world.map.locations[rid];
 8309 |                 if (std::abs(loc.x - ship.x) <= 1 && std::abs(loc.y - ship.y) <= 1) {
 8310 |                     current_port = rid;
 8311 |                     break;
 8312 |                 }
 8313 |             }
 8314 |         }
 8315 | 
 8316 |         if (current_port.empty() || !g_world.regions.count(current_port)) continue;
 8317 |         if (g_world.port_facilities[current_port].is_blockaded) continue;
 8318 |         Region& localReg = g_world.regions[current_port];
 8319 |         PortFacility& localPort = g_world.port_facilities[current_port];
 8320 | 
 8321 |         std::string bestDest = "";
 8322 |         std::string bestGood = "";
 8323 |         double maxProfit = 0;
 8324 |         double buyPrice = 0;
 8325 | 
 8326 |         for (const auto& [gtStr, itemDef] : g_db.items) {
 8327 |             if (itemDef.category == "document") continue;
 8328 |             int available = countItemsInContainer(localPort.dock_container_id, gtStr);
 8329 |             if (available < 50) continue;
 8330 | 
 8331 |             double localP = localReg.markets.count(gtStr) ? localReg.markets.at(gtStr) : itemDef.basePrice;
 8332 |             if (localP <= 0) localP = itemDef.basePrice;
 8333 | 
 8334 |             for (const auto& [destId, destPort] : g_world.port_facilities) {
 8335 |                 if (destId == current_port || destPort.is_blockaded || !g_world.regions.count(destId)) continue;
 8336 |                 Region& destReg = g_world.regions[destId];
 8337 |                 double destP = destReg.markets.count(gtStr) ? destReg.markets.at(gtStr) : itemDef.basePrice;
 8338 |                 if (destReg.moneySupply < destP * 50) continue;
 8339 | 
 8340 |                 double profitMargin = destP - localP;
 8341 |                 if (profitMargin > maxProfit && profitMargin > localP * 0.2) {
 8342 |                     maxProfit = profitMargin;
 8343 |                     bestDest = destId;
 8344 |                     bestGood = gtStr;
 8345 |                     buyPrice = localP;
 8346 |                 }
 8347 |             }
 8348 |         }
 8349 | 
 8350 |         if (!bestDest.empty() && !bestGood.empty()) {
 8351 |             int amountToBuy = std::min(countItemsInContainer(localPort.dock_container_id, bestGood), ship.cargo_capacity);
 8352 |             bool canLoad = false;
 8353 | 
 8354 |             if (g_world.factions.count(ship.owner_id)) {
 8355 |                 if (localReg.factionId == ship.owner_id) {
 8356 |                     canLoad = true;
 8357 |                 } else {
 8358 |                     std::string capId = g_world.factions[ship.owner_id].regions.empty() ? "" : g_world.factions[ship.owner_id].regions[0];
 8359 |                     if (!capId.empty() && g_world.regions.count(capId)) {
 8360 |                         int gold = countItemsInContainer(g_world.regions[capId].vault_id, getCoreIdByTag("currency"));
 8361 |                         int cost = amountToBuy * buyPrice;
 8362 |                         if (gold >= cost) {
 8363 |                             consumeItemsFromContainer(g_world.regions[capId].vault_id, getCoreIdByTag("currency"), cost);
 8364 |                             localReg.moneySupply += cost;
 8365 |                             canLoad = true;
 8366 |                         }
 8367 |                     }
 8368 |                 }
 8369 |             } else if (g_world.npcs.count(ship.owner_id)) {
 8370 |                 int cost = amountToBuy * buyPrice;
 8371 |                 if (g_world.npcs[ship.owner_id].economy.savings >= cost) {
 8372 |                     g_world.npcs[ship.owner_id].economy.savings -= cost;
 8373 |                     localReg.moneySupply += cost;
 8374 |                     canLoad = true;
 8375 |                 }
 8376 |             }
 8377 | 
 8378 |             if (canLoad) {
 8379 |                 consumeItemsFromContainer(localPort.dock_container_id, bestGood, amountToBuy);
 8380 |                 createItem(bestGood, amountToBuy, ship.chest_id, g_world.current_day, "Погрузка на корабль");
 8381 |                 
 8382 |                 auto loc1 = g_world.map.locations[current_port];
 8383 |                 auto loc2 = g_world.map.locations[bestDest];
 8384 |                 auto path = findPath(g_world.map, loc1.x, loc1.y, loc2.x, loc2.y, dummy_has_road, dummy_path_status, MovementType::WATER, 10);
 8385 |                 if (!path.empty()) {
 8386 |                     ship.path = path;
 8387 |                     ship.path_index = 0;
 8388 |                     ship.destination = bestDest;
 8389 |                     addNews(locStr("engine.news.naval.ship_departed", {{"ship", ship.id}, {"origin", localReg.name}, {"dest", g_world.regions[bestDest].name}, {"cargo", getGoodName(bestGood)}}), current_port, 1, "logistics");
 8390 |                 } else {
 8391 |                     // No water path found — unload cargo back to dock
 8392 |                     consumeItemsFromContainer(ship.chest_id, bestGood, amountToBuy);
 8393 |                     createItem(bestGood, amountToBuy, localPort.dock_container_id, g_world.current_day, "Разгрузка (нет пути)");
 8394 |                 }
 8395 |             }
 8396 |         }
 8397 |     }

 8776 | void globalHomeostasis() {
 8777 |     int starvingRegions = 0;
 8778 |     std::vector<double> wealthList;
 8779 |     
 8780 |     for (const auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {
 8781 |         if (r.starvation_days > 7) starvingRegions++;
 8782 |         wealthList.push_back(r.moneySupply);
 8783 |     }
 8784 |     
 8785 |     double globalStarvation = g_world.regions.empty() ? 0.0 : (double)starvingRegions / g_world.regions.size();
 8786 |     
 8787 |     int warringFactions = 0;
 8788 |     for (const auto& [fid, f] : g_world.factions) {
 8789 |         for (const auto& [tid, status] : f.diplomacy) {
 8790 |             if (status == "war") {
 8791 |                 warringFactions++;
 8792 |                 break;
 8793 |             }
 8794 |         }
 8795 |     }
 8796 |     double globalWarRate = g_world.factions.empty() ? 0.0 : (double)warringFactions / g_world.factions.size();
 8797 |     
 8798 |     double medianWealth = 0.0;
 8799 |     if (!wealthList.empty()) {
 8800 |         std::sort(wealthList.begin(), wealthList.end());
 8801 |         medianWealth = wealthList[wealthList.size() / 2];
 8802 |     }
 8803 | 
 8804 |     if (globalStarvation > 0.20) {
 8805 |         if (globalStarvation > 0.20) triggerJsHook("onFamineStarted", [&](){ JsonValue _h=JsonValue::object(); _h.set("starvationRate",globalStarvation); _h.set("day",g_world.current_day); return _h; });
 8806 |         g_world.nexusData["global_harvest_blessing"] = JsonValue(g_world.current_day + 180);
 8807 |         triggerJsHook("onGlobalEvent", [&](){ JsonValue _h=JsonValue::object(); _h.set("eventId","global_harvest_blessing"); _h.set("day",g_world.current_day); return _h; });
 8808 |         addNews(locStr("engine.news.harvest_blessing"), "global", 5, "misc");
 8809 |     }
 8810 | 
 8811 |     if (globalWarRate > 0.50) {
 8812 |         for (auto& [fid, f] : g_world.factions) {
 8813 |             f.warExhaustion += 30;
 8814 |         }
 8815 |         addNews(locStr("engine.news.war_weariness"), "global", 5, "misc");
 8816 |     }
 8817 | 
 8818 |     if (medianWealth < 5000.0) {
 8819 |         g_world.nexusData["global_gold_rush"] = JsonValue(g_world.current_day + 90);
 8820 |         addNews(locStr("engine.news.gold_rush"), "global", 5, "trade");
 8821 |     }
 8822 | }

 8825 | void hourlyTick() {
 8826 |     triggerJsHook("onBeforeHourlyTick");
 8827 |     processConsumption();
 8828 |     processCaravans();
 8829 | 
 8830 |     processFleets();
 8831 | 
 8832 |     exportGoodsToPortDocks();
 8833 |     processNavalTrade();
 8834 | 
 8835 |     processShips();
 8836 | 
 8837 |     processCouriers();
 8838 | 
 8839 |     processMerchantOrders();
 8840 |     processTrekTick();
 8841 |     
 8842 |     if (g_world.time.internalHour % 4 == 0) {
 8843 |         updateWeather();
 8844 |     }
 8845 |     
 8846 |     g_world.time.internalHour++;
 8847 |     if (g_world.time.internalHour >= 24) {
 8848 |         g_world.time.internalHour = 0;
 8849 |         dailyTick();
 8850 |         if (g_world.current_day % 7 == 0) {
 8851 |             weeklyTick();
 8852 |         }
 8853 |         if (g_world.current_day > 0 && g_world.current_day % 30 == 0) {
 8854 |             monthlyTick();
 8855 |         }
 8856 |         if (g_world.current_day > 0 && g_world.current_day % 360 == 0) {
 8857 |             globalHomeostasis();
 8858 |         }
 8859 |     }
 8860 |     triggerJsHook("onAfterHourlyTick");
 8861 | }

 8863 | // Simulate one day
 8864 | int availableManpower(const Faction& f, std::unordered_map<std::string, std::unordered_map<std::string, int>>& vaultStocks) {
 8865 |     int total = 0;
 8866 |     for (const auto& rid : f.regions) {
 8867 |         if (g_world.regions.count(rid) == 0) continue;
 8868 |         const Region& r = g_world.regions.at(rid);
 8869 |         int weapons = getCategoryAmount(g_world.regions[rid].vault_id, "weapon");
 8870 |         int food = getFoodAmount(g_world.regions[rid].vault_id);
 8871 |         // Максимальный резерв ~14% от населения
 8872 |         int possible = std::min(r.population / 7, weapons);
 8873 |         if (food < possible * 0.5) continue;
 8874 |         total += possible;
 8875 |     }
 8876 |     return total;
 8877 | }
 8878 | 
 8879 | void processRulerDiplomacy() {
 8880 |     std::unordered_map<std::string, std::unordered_map<std::string, int>> vaultStocks;
 8881 |     {
 8882 |         std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
 8883 |         for (const auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {
 8884 |             if (!r.vault_id.empty() && g_containers.count(r.vault_id)) {
 8885 |                 vaultStocks[rid] = g_containers[r.vault_id].cached_stocks;
 8886 |             } else {
 8887 |                 vaultStocks[rid] = {};
 8888 |             }
 8889 |         }
 8890 |     }
 8891 | 
 8892 |     std::vector<std::string> fKeys;
 8893 |     for (const auto& [fid, f] : g_world.factions) fKeys.push_back(fid);
 8894 | 
 8895 |     for (auto& [rId, ruler] : g_world.npcs) {
 8896 |         if (ruler.type != "ruler" || !ruler.isAlive || ruler.id.find("_heir") != std::string::npos) continue;
 8897 |         
 8898 |         if (g_world.factions.count(ruler.factionId) == 0) continue;
 8899 |         Faction& faction = g_world.factions[ruler.factionId];
 8900 | 
 8901 |         std::string goalKey = ruler.factionId + "_goal";
 8902 |         if (g_world.nexusData.count(goalKey)) {
 8903 |             ruler.gmOverride = g_world.nexusData[goalKey]["value"].asString();
 8904 |         }
 8905 | 
 8906 |         if (!ruler.gmOverride.empty()) {
 8907 |             ruler.currentGoal = "gm_override -> " + ruler.gmOverride;
 8908 |             continue;
 8909 |         }
 8910 | 
 8911 |         int totalWeapons = 0;
 8912 |         int totalFood = 0;
 8913 |         for (const auto& rid : faction.regions) {
 8914 |             if (g_world.regions.count(rid)) {
 8915 |                 totalWeapons += getCategoryAmount(g_world.regions[rid].vault_id, "weapon");
 8916 |                 totalFood += getFoodAmount(g_world.regions[rid].vault_id);
 8917 |             }
 8918 |         }
 8919 |         int security = (totalWeapons > 100 ? 50 : totalWeapons) + (faction.armies.size() * 10);
 8920 | 
 8921 |         std::string capitalRegionId = faction.regions.empty() ? "" : faction.regions[0];
 8922 |         std::string capitalVault = capitalRegionId.empty() ? "" : g_world.regions[capitalRegionId].vault_id;
 8923 |         int wealth = capitalRegionId.empty() ? 0 : vaultStocks[capitalRegionId][getCoreIdByTag("currency")];
 8924 | 
 8925 |         int power = availableManpower(faction, vaultStocks);
 8926 | 
 8927 |         // Распределяем нагрузку ИИ: правители думают раз в 3 дня, в разные дни (зависит от хэша ID)
 8928 |         int ruler_hash = std::hash<std::string>{}(ruler.id) % 3;
 8929 |         if (g_world.current_day % 3 == ruler_hash) {
 8930 |             std::set<std::string> neighbors;
 8931 |             for (const auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
 8932 |                 if (road.condition == "blocked") continue;
 8933 |                 std::string f1 = g_world.regions.count(road.from) ? g_world.regions[road.from].factionId : "";
 8934 |                 std::string f2 = g_world.regions.count(road.to) ? g_world.regions[road.to].factionId : "";
 8935 |                 if (f1 == ruler.factionId && !f2.empty() && f2 != ruler.factionId) neighbors.insert(f2);
 8936 |                 if (f2 == ruler.factionId && !f1.empty() && f1 != ruler.factionId) neighbors.insert(f1);
 8937 |             }
 8938 |             
 8939 |             int hostile_power = 0;
 8940 |             int neutral_power = 0;
 8941 |             std::string best_ally = "";
 8942 |             int best_ally_power = -1;
 8943 | 
 8944 |             for (const auto& nid : neighbors) {
 8945 |                 if (g_world.factions.count(nid)) {
 8946 |                     int nPower = availableManpower(g_world.factions[nid], vaultStocks);
 8947 |                     if (faction.diplomacy[nid] == "war") hostile_power += nPower;
 8948 |                     else {
 8949 |                         neutral_power += nPower;
 8950 |                         if (nPower > best_ally_power) {
 8951 |                             best_ally_power = nPower;
 8952 |                             best_ally = nid;
 8953 |                         }
 8954 |                     }
 8955 |                 }
 8956 |             }
 8957 | 
 8958 |             // Динамическая паранойя при окружении
 8959 |             if (hostile_power > power * 1.5) {
 8960 |                 ruler.rulerPersonality.paranoia = std::min(100, ruler.rulerPersonality.paranoia + 2);
 8961 |             } else if (hostile_power < power * 0.5) {
 8962 |                 ruler.rulerPersonality.paranoia = std::max(0, ruler.rulerPersonality.paranoia - 1);
 8963 |             }
 8964 | 
 8965 |             // Защитный союз при высокой паранойе
 8966 |             if (ruler.rulerPersonality.paranoia > 70 && !best_ally.empty() && faction.diplomacy[best_ally] != "war") {
 8967 |                 { // Лимит на поиск союзов снят
 8968 |                     ruler.currentGoal = "offer_alliance -> " + best_ally;
 8969 |                     faction.relations[best_ally] = std::min(100, faction.relations[best_ally] + 20);
 8970 |                     g_world.factions[best_ally].relations[ruler.factionId] = std::min(100, g_world.factions[best_ally].relations[ruler.factionId] + 20);
 8971 |                     addNews(locStr("engine.news.diplomacy.defensive_pact", {{"ruler", ruler.name}, {"ally", g_world.factions[best_ally].name}}), "global", 3, "diplomacy");
 8972 |                 }
 8973 |                 continue;
 8974 |             }
 8975 | 
 8976 |             std::string targetF = "";
 8977 |             if (!neighbors.empty()) {
 8978 |                 auto it = neighbors.begin();
 8979 |                 std::advance(it, rand() % neighbors.size());
 8980 |                 targetF = *it;
 8981 |             } else {
 8982 |                 targetF = fKeys[rand() % fKeys.size()];
 8983 |             }
 8984 |             
 8985 |             if (targetF == ruler.factionId || targetF.empty()) continue;
 8986 |             Faction& targetFaction = g_world.factions[targetF];
 8987 |             int targetPower = availableManpower(targetFaction, vaultStocks);
 8988 | 
 8989 |             // 1. ПОДДЕРЖКА И УСТАЛОСТЬ (Гомеостаз)
 8990 |             int avgThreat = 0;
 8991 |             for (const auto& rid : faction.regions) {
 8992 |                 if (g_world.regions.count(rid)) avgThreat += g_world.regions[rid].threat_level;
 8993 |             }
 8994 |             if (!faction.regions.empty()) avgThreat /= faction.regions.size();
 8995 |             
 8996 |             ruler.rulerPersonality.supportLevel = std::clamp(100 - avgThreat - faction.warExhaustion, 0, 100);
 8997 |             
 8998 |             if (faction.warExhaustion > 0 && (rand() % 100) < 10) faction.warExhaustion--;
 8999 |             
 9000 |             // Динамическая агрессивность
 9001 |             if (faction.warExhaustion == 0 && ruler.rulerPersonality.ambition < 90) {
 9002 |                 if ((rand() % 100) < 5) ruler.rulerPersonality.ambition++;
 9003 |             } else if (faction.warExhaustion > 50 && ruler.rulerPersonality.ambition > 20) {
 9004 |                 if ((rand() % 100) < 10) ruler.rulerPersonality.ambition--;

10205 |         void processMerchants() {
10206 |         static int last_rebuild_day = -999;
10207 |         // Ленивое кэширование: перестраиваем глобальный кэш путей не чаще раза в 14 дней.
10208 |         // Если дорога сломалась, караваны и армии сами найдут обход в реальном времени.
10209 |         if (g_path_cache_dirty && (g_world.current_day - last_rebuild_day > 14 || g_path_cache.empty())) {
10210 |             last_rebuild_day = g_world.current_day;
10211 |             g_path_cache.clear();
10212 |             std::vector<bool> has_road(g_world.map.width * g_world.map.height, false);
10213 |             std::vector<int> path_status(g_world.map.width * g_world.map.height, 0);
10214 |             for (const auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
10215 |                 if (road.condition == "blocked") {
10216 |                     for (const auto& wp : road.waypoints) path_status[wp.second * g_world.map.width + wp.first] = 2;
10217 |                 } else if (road.condition == "ruined") {
10218 |                     for (const auto& wp : road.waypoints) {
10219 |                         path_status[wp.second * g_world.map.width + wp.first] = 1;
10220 |                         has_road[wp.second * g_world.map.width + wp.first] = true;
10221 |                     }
10222 |                 } else {
10223 |                     for (const auto& wp : road.waypoints) has_road[wp.second * g_world.map.width + wp.first] = true;
10224 |                 }
10225 |             }
10226 |             for (const auto& [r1, reg1] : g_world.regions) {
10227 |                 for (const auto& [r2, reg2] : g_world.regions) {
10228 |                     if (r1 != r2 && g_world.map.locations.count(r1) && g_world.map.locations.count(r2)) {
10229 |                         auto loc1 = g_world.map.locations[r1];
10230 |                         auto loc2 = g_world.map.locations[r2];
10231 |                         g_path_cache[{r1, r2}] = findPath(g_world.map, loc1.x, loc1.y, loc2.x, loc2.y, has_road, path_status, MovementType::LAND);
10232 |                     }
10233 |                 }
10234 |             }
10235 |             g_path_cache_dirty = false;
10236 |         }
10237 | 
10238 |         // Структура для возврата результата из параллельного потока
10239 |     struct MerchantTask {
10240 |         std::string merchant_id;
10241 |         std::string origin;
10242 |         std::string bestDest;
10243 |         std::string bestGood;
10244 |         int buyPrice;
10245 |         bool execute;
10246 |     };
10247 | 
10248 |     std::vector<std::future<MerchantTask>> futures;
10249 | 
10250 |     for (auto& [npcId, merchant] : g_world.npcs) {
10251 |         if (!merchant.isAlive || merchant.economy.profession_type != "merchant") continue;
10252 |         
10253 |         // Если купец уже в пути, пропускаем (синхронное чтение безопасно)
10254 |         bool inTransit = false;
10255 |         for (const auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {
10256 |             for (const auto& c : r.caravans) {
10257 |                 if (c.merchant_id == npcId) { inTransit = true; break; }
10258 |             }
10259 |             if (inTransit) break;
10260 |         }
10261 |         if (inTransit) continue;
10262 |         if (!g_world.regions.count(merchant.currentLocation)) continue;
10263 | 
10264 |         std::string mId = npcId;
10265 |         std::string mLoc = merchant.currentLocation;
10266 |         int mSavings = merchant.economy.savings;
10267 | 
10268 |         // ЗАПУСК ТЯЖЕЛЫХ РАСЧЕТОВ (A* И АНАЛИЗ РЫНКА) В ПАРАЛЛЕЛЬНЫХ ПОТОКАХ
10269 |         futures.push_back(getThreadPool()->enqueue([mId, mLoc, mSavings]() -> MerchantTask {
10270 |             MerchantTask task = {mId, mLoc, "", "", 0, false};
10271 |             if (!g_world.regions.count(mLoc)) return task;
10272 |             
10273 |             const Region& localReg = g_world.regions.at(mLoc);
10274 |             double maxProfit = 0;
10275 | 
10276 |             for (const auto& [gtStr, itemDef] : g_db.items) {
10277 |                 if (itemDef.category == "document") continue;
10278 |                 double localP = localReg.markets.count(gtStr) ? localReg.markets.at(gtStr) : itemDef.basePrice;
10279 |                 if (localP <= 0) localP = itemDef.basePrice;
10280 | 
10281 |                                                         for (const auto& [destId, destReg] : g_world.regions) {
10282 |                     if (destId == mLoc) continue;
10283 |                     double destP = destReg.markets.count(gtStr) ? destReg.markets.at(gtStr) : itemDef.basePrice;
10284 |                     
10285 |                     if (destReg.moneySupply < destP * 50) continue;
10286 |                     
10287 |                     double profitMargin = destP - localP;
10288 |                     
10289 |                     if (profitMargin > maxProfit && profitMargin > localP * 0.3) {
10290 |                         task.bestGood = gtStr;
10291 |                         // ИСПОЛЬЗУЕМ КЭШИРОВАННЫЕ МАРШРУТЫ (O(1) вместо O(N^2))
10292 |                         if (g_path_cache.count({mLoc, destId})) {
10293 |                             auto path = g_path_cache.at({mLoc, destId});
10294 |                             if (!path.empty()) {
10295 |                                 maxProfit = profitMargin;
10296 |                                 task.bestDest = destId;
10297 |                                 task.bestGood = gtStr;
10298 |                                 task.buyPrice = localP;
10299 |                                 task.execute = true;
10300 |                             }
10301 |                         }
10302 |                     }
10303 |                 }
10304 |             }
10305 |             return task;
10306 |         }));
10307 |     }
10308 | 
10309 |     // СИНХРОННОЕ ПРИМЕНЕНИЕ РЕЗУЛЬТАТОВ (Избегаем Data Races при изменении инвентарей)
10310 |     for (auto& f : futures) {
10311 |         MerchantTask task = f.get(); // Дожидаемся завершения потока
10312 |         if (task.execute && g_world.npcs.count(task.merchant_id) && g_world.regions.count(task.origin)) {
10313 |             NPC& merchant = g_world.npcs[task.merchant_id];
10314 |             Region& localReg = g_world.regions[task.origin];
10315 |             
10316 |             int availableGoods = countItemsInContainer(localReg.vault_id, task.bestGood);
10317 |             int safePrice = std::max(1, task.buyPrice);
10318 |             int maxAffordable = merchant.economy.savings / safePrice;
10319 |             const std::string vehicleId = getCoreIdByTag("vehicle");
10320 |             int vehiclesOwned = vehicleId.empty() ? 0 : countItemsInContainer(merchant.inventory_id, vehicleId);
10321 |             int maxCarryable = (g_db.items[task.bestGood].category == "vehicle") ? (1 + rand() % 3) : (50 + vehiclesOwned * 500);
10322 |             int amountToBuy = std::min({availableGoods, maxAffordable, maxCarryable});
10323 | 
10324 |             if (amountToBuy > 0) {
10325 |                 int cost = amountToBuy * safePrice;
10326 |                 merchant.economy.savings -= cost;
10327 |                 localReg.moneySupply += cost;
10328 |                 consumeItemsFromContainer(localReg.vault_id, task.bestGood, amountToBuy);
10329 | 
10330 |                 std::string chestId = createContainer("caravan_chest", merchant.id, 999999, 1000, merchant.currentLocation);
10331 |                 createItem(task.bestGood, amountToBuy, chestId, g_world.current_day, locStr("engine.reason.merchant_goods"));
10332 | 
10333 |                 int guardsHired = 0;
10334 |                 int maxGuardsWanted = merchant.economy.savings / 20; // Лимит в 5 охранников снят
10335 |                 
10336 |                 for (auto& [mercId, merc] : g_world.npcs) {
10337 |                     if (guardsHired >= maxGuardsWanted) break;
10338 |                     if (merc.isAlive && merc.economy.profession_type == "mercenary" && merc.currentLocation == merchant.currentLocation && merc.currentActivity != locStr("engine.npc.guarding_caravan")) {
10339 |                         merc.currentActivity = locStr("engine.npc.guarding_caravan");
10340 |                         merc.travelDestination = task.bestDest;
10341 |                         merc.travelHoursLeft = 24 + (rand() % 48);
10342 |                         merchant.economy.savings -= 20;
10343 |                         merc.economy.savings += 20;
10344 |                         guardsHired++;
10345 |                     }
10346 |                 }
10347 |                 
10348 |                 int abstractGuards = 0;
10349 |                 if (guardsHired < maxGuardsWanted) {
10350 |                     abstractGuards = maxGuardsWanted - guardsHired;
10351 |                     merchant.economy.savings -= abstractGuards * 20;
10352 |                 }
10353 |                 int totalGuards = guardsHired + abstractGuards;
10354 | 
10355 |                 Caravan caravan;
10356 |                 caravan.id = "caravan_" + generateUUID();
10357 |                 caravan.merchant_id = merchant.id;
10358 |                 caravan.origin = merchant.currentLocation;
10359 |                 caravan.destination = task.bestDest;
10360 |                 caravan.chest_id = chestId;
10361 |                 caravan.wagons = (g_db.items[task.bestGood].category == "vehicle") ? amountToBuy : (1 + (amountToBuy / 50));
10362 |                 caravan.guards = totalGuards;
10363 |                 caravan.guard_cost = totalGuards * 20;
10364 |                 caravan.hoursLeft = 24 + (rand() % 48);
10365 |                 
10366 |                 if (g_path_cache.count({merchant.currentLocation, task.bestDest})) {
10367 |                     caravan.path = g_path_cache[{merchant.currentLocation, task.bestDest}];
10368 |                     if (!caravan.path.empty()) {
10369 |                         caravan.x = caravan.path[0].first;
10370 |                         caravan.y = caravan.path[0].second;
10371 |                     }
10372 |                 }
10373 |                 
10374 |                 localReg.caravans.push_back(caravan);
10375 |                 std::string destName = g_world.regions.count(task.bestDest) ? g_world.regions[task.bestDest].name : task.bestDest;
10376 |                 merchant.currentActivity = locStr("engine.npc.traveling_to", {{"dest", destName}});
10377 | 
10378 |                 addNews(locStr("engine.news.merchant_caravan_sent", {{"merchant", merchant.name}, {"origin", localReg.name}, {"dest", destName}}), task.origin, 1, "trade");
10379 |             }
10380 |         }
10381 |     }

10386 | 
10387 | void processDailyThreat() {
10388 |     for (auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {
10389 |         int delta = 0;
10390 |         
10391 |         // 1. Безработица
10392 |         int totalJobs = 0;
10393 |         for (const auto& [fid, fac] : r.facilities) {
10394 |             totalJobs += fac.level * g_gameplay_runtime.sim_fac_market_jobs;
10395 |         }
10396 |         int employed = std::min(r.population, totalJobs);
10397 |         double unemploymentRate = r.population > 0 ? (r.population - employed) / (double)r.population : 0.0;
10398 |         if (unemploymentRate > 0.3) delta += 1 + (int)((unemploymentRate - 0.3) * 5);
10399 | 
10400 |         // 2. Голод
10401 |         int food = getFoodAmount(r.vault_id);
10402 |         double foodPerCapita = food / (double)std::max(1, r.population);
10403 |         if (foodPerCapita < 0.8) delta += 5;
10404 |         if (foodPerCapita < 0.3) delta += 10;
10405 | 
10406 |         // 3. Война / налеты
10407 |         if (g_world.factions.count(r.factionId)) {
10408 |             const auto& f = g_world.factions[r.factionId];
10409 |             for (const auto& [otherFid, relation] : f.diplomacy) {
10410 |                 if (relation == "war" && g_world.factions.count(otherFid)) {
10411 |                     delta += 3;
10412 |                 }
10413 |             }
10414 |         }
10415 | 
10416 |         r.threat_level = std::max(0, std::min(100, r.threat_level + delta));
10417 | 
10418 |         // 3.5 Спавн Эпических Монстров и Блокировка Дорог
10419 |         bool global_dragon_exists = g_world.nexusData.count("global_dragon_active") && g_world.nexusData["global_dragon_active"].asBool();
10420 |         if (r.threat_level >= 100 && !g_world.nexusData.count(rid + "_dragon_spawned") && !global_dragon_exists) {
10421 |             g_world.nexusData[rid + "_dragon_spawned"] = JsonValue(true);
10422 |             g_world.nexusData["global_dragon_active"] = JsonValue(true);
10423 |             
10424 |             int blockX = -1, blockY = -1;
10425 |             for (const auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
10426 |                 if (road.from == rid || road.to == rid) {
10427 |                     if (road.waypoints.size() > 15) {
10428 |                         int wpIdx = (road.from == rid) ? 10 : road.waypoints.size() - 11;
10429 |                         blockX = road.waypoints[wpIdx].first;
10430 |                         blockY = road.waypoints[wpIdx].second;
10431 |                         break;
10432 |                     }
10433 |                 }
10434 |             }
10435 |             if (blockX == -1 && g_world.map.locations.count(rid)) {
10436 |                 blockX = g_world.map.locations[rid].x;
10437 |                 blockY = g_world.map.locations[rid].y;
10438 |             }
10439 |             
10440 |             if (blockX != -1) {
10441 |                 g_world.nexusData[rid + "_dragon_x"] = JsonValue(blockX);
10442 |                 g_world.nexusData[rid + "_dragon_y"] = JsonValue(blockY);
10443 |                 int radius = 6;
10444 |                 
10445 |                 std::vector<MapRoad> new_roads;
10446 |                 for (auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
10447 |                     if (road.condition == "ruined" || road.condition == "blocked") {
10448 |                         new_roads.push_back(road);
10449 |                         continue;
10450 |                     }
10451 |                     MapRoad current_segment;
10452 |                     current_segment.from = road.from;
10453 |                     current_segment.to = road.to;
10454 |                     current_segment.condition = road.condition;
10455 |                     bool in_ruin = false;
10456 |                     for (size_t i = 0; i < road.waypoints.size(); ++i) {
10457 |                         auto wp = road.waypoints[i];
10458 |                         bool inside = std::hypot(wp.first - blockX, wp.second - blockY) <= radius;
10459 |                         if (inside && !in_ruin) {
10460 |                             if (!current_segment.waypoints.empty()) {
10461 |                                 current_segment.waypoints.push_back(wp);
10462 |                                 new_roads.push_back(current_segment);
10463 |                             }
10464 |                             current_segment.waypoints.clear();
10465 |                             current_segment.condition = "ruined";
10466 |                             current_segment.waypoints.push_back(wp);
10467 |                             in_ruin = true;
10468 |                         } else if (!inside && in_ruin) {
10469 |                             if (!current_segment.waypoints.empty()) {
10470 |                                 current_segment.waypoints.push_back(wp);
10471 |                                 new_roads.push_back(current_segment);
10472 |                             }
10473 |                             current_segment.waypoints.clear();
10474 |                             current_segment.condition = road.condition;
10475 |                             current_segment.waypoints.push_back(wp);
10476 |                             in_ruin = false;
10477 |                         } else {
10478 |                             current_segment.waypoints.push_back(wp);
10479 |                         }
10480 |                     }
10481 |                     if (!current_segment.waypoints.empty()) new_roads.push_back(current_segment);
10482 |                 }
10483 |                 g_world.map.roads = new_roads;
10484 |                 
10485 |                 for (int y = std::max(0, blockY - radius); y <= std::min(g_world.map.height - 1, blockY + radius); ++y) {
10486 |                     for (int x = std::max(0, blockX - radius); x <= std::min(g_world.map.width - 1, blockX + radius); ++x) {
10487 |                         if (std::hypot(x - blockX, y - blockY) <= radius) {
10488 |                             g_world.map.grid[y * g_world.map.width + x].biome_id = g_db.biome_string_to_id.count("volcano") ? g_db.biome_string_to_id["volcano"] : 0;
10489 |                         }
10490 |                     }
10491 |                 }
10492 |                 g_world.map.generation_tick = g_world.tick;
10493 |                 g_path_cache_dirty = true;
10494 |             }
10495 |             addNews(locStr("engine.news.dragon_settled", {{"region", r.name}}), rid, 5, "disaster");
10496 |         }
10497 |         
10498 |         // Разблокировка дорог, если угроза спала (например, игрок убил дракона и снизил threat_level)
10499 |         if (r.threat_level < g_gameplay_runtime.sim_region_threat_dragon && g_world.nexusData.count(rid + "_dragon_spawned")) {
10500 |             int blockX = g_world.nexusData.count(rid + "_dragon_x") ? g_world.nexusData[rid + "_dragon_x"].asInt() : -1;
10501 |             int blockY = g_world.nexusData.count(rid + "_dragon_y") ? g_world.nexusData[rid + "_dragon_y"].asInt() : -1;
10502 |             int radius = 6;
10503 | 
10504 |             g_world.nexusData.erase(rid + "_dragon_spawned");
10505 |             g_world.nexusData.erase(rid + "_dragon_x");
10506 |             g_world.nexusData.erase(rid + "_dragon_y");
10507 |             g_world.nexusData.erase("global_dragon_active");
10508 |             
10509 |             addNews(locStr("engine.news.dragon_liberated", {{"region", r.name}}), rid, 4, "trade");
10510 |             
10511 |             if (blockX != -1) {
10512 |                 for (auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
10513 |                     if (road.condition == "ruined" || road.condition == "blocked") {
10514 |                         bool inside = true;
10515 |                         for (auto wp : road.waypoints) {
10516 |                             if (std::hypot(wp.first - blockX, wp.second - blockY) > radius + 2) {
10517 |                                 inside = false;
10518 |                                 break;
10519 |                             }
10520 |                         }
10521 |                         if (inside) {
10522 |                             road.condition = "paved"; // Восстанавливаем дорогу
10523 |                             g_path_cache_dirty = true;
10524 |                         }
10525 |                     }
10526 |                 }
10527 |                 for (int y = std::max(0, blockY - radius); y <= std::min(g_world.map.height - 1, blockY + radius); ++y) {
10528 |                     for (int x = std::max(0, blockX - radius); x <= std::min(g_world.map.width - 1, blockX + radius); ++x) {
10529 |                         if (std::hypot(x - blockX, y - blockY) <= radius) {
10530 |                             uint8_t b_id = g_world.map.grid[y * g_world.map.width + x].biome_id;
10531 |                             std::string b_str = getBiomeStringId(b_id);
10532 |                             if (b_str == "volcano") {
10533 |                                 g_world.map.grid[y * g_world.map.width + x].biome_id = g_db.biome_string_to_id.count("plains") ? g_db.biome_string_to_id["plains"] : 0;
10534 |                             }
10535 |                         }
10536 |                     }
10537 |                 }
10538 |                 g_world.map.generation_tick = g_world.tick;
10539 |             }
10540 |         }
10541 | 
10542 |         // 4. Автоматическое снижение угрозы при благополучии
10543 |         if (unemploymentRate < 0.3 && foodPerCapita > 0.8) {
10544 |             r.threat_level = std::max(0, r.threat_level - (1 + rand() % 2));
10545 |         }
10546 |         
10547 |         // Уникальная логика типов локаций
10548 |         if (r.base_type == "fort") {
10549 |             r.threat_level = std::max(0, r.threat_level - 2); // Форты подавляют угрозу
10550 |         } else if (r.base_type == "anomaly") {
10551 |             r.dread = std::min(100, r.dread + 2); // Аномалии генерируют ужас
10552 |         } else if (r.base_type == "ruins" || r.population == 0) {
10553 |             r.threat_level = std::max(80, r.threat_level); // Руины всегда опасны
10554 |         }
10555 |

10828 | void processDiplomacy() {
10829 |     for (auto& [fid, f] : g_world.factions) {
10830 |         // T3: 5.1 Casus Belli & 3.1 War Exhaustion

10832 |             f.daysInCurrentWar++;
10833 |             double weGain = 1.0;
10834 |             
10835 |             if (f.currentCasusBelli == CasusBelli::NONE) {
10836 |                 weGain += 2.0;
10837 |                 if (f.daysInCurrentWar == 1) {
10838 |                     for (auto& [nid, nfac] : g_world.factions) {
10839 |                         if (nid != fid && f.diplomacy[nid] != "war") {
10840 |                             f.relations[nid] = std::max(-100, f.relations[nid] - 20);
10841 |                             nfac.relations[fid] = std::max(-100, nfac.relations[fid] - 20);
10842 |                         }
10843 |                     }
10844 |                     addNews(locStr("engine.news.war.unprovoked_aggression", {{"faction", f.name}}), "global", 5, "diplomacy");

10849 |             for (const auto& [cid, cfac] : g_world.factions) {

10851 |                     if (coal.targetFactionId == fid) targetedByCoalition = true;

12002 | void processRoadDegradation() {
12003 |     for (auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
12004 |         if (road.condition == "ruined") continue;
12005 |         if (road.type == "tunnel") continue;
12006 |         
12007 |         int deg = 1;
12008 |         if (road.type == "dirt") deg = 2;
12009 |         if (road.type == "bridge") deg = 3;
12010 |         
12011 |         road.integrity -= deg;
12012 |         if (road.integrity <= 0) {
12013 |             road.integrity = 0;
12014 |             road.condition = "ruined";
12015 |             g_path_cache_dirty = true;
12016 |             addNews(locStr("engine.news.road_ruined", {{"from", road.from}, {"to", road.to}}), road.from, 2, "logistics");
12017 |         }
12018 |     }
12019 | 
12020 |     for (auto& [fid, f] : g_world.factions) {
12021 |         std::string capId = f.regions.empty() ? "" : f.regions[0];
12022 |         if (capId.empty() || !g_world.regions.count(capId)) continue;
12023 |         int gold = countItemsInContainer(g_world.regions[capId].vault_id, getCoreIdByTag("currency"));
12024 |         
12025 |         for (auto& road : g_world.map.roads) {
12026 |             bool from_match = g_world.regions.count(road.from) && g_world.regions[road.from].factionId == fid;
12027 |             bool to_match = g_world.regions.count(road.to) && g_world.regions[road.to].factionId == fid;
12028 |             if (road.integrity < 50 && (from_match || to_match)) {
12029 |                 int cost = (100 - road.integrity) * 10;
12030 |                 if (road.type == "sea_route") cost = (100 - road.integrity) * 5;
12031 |                 if (gold >= cost) {
12032 |                     consumeItemsFromContainer(g_world.regions[capId].vault_id, getCoreIdByTag("currency"), cost);
12033 |                     gold -= cost;
12034 |                     road.integrity = 100;
12035 |                     if (road.condition == "ruined") {
12036 |                         road.condition = road.type == "paved" ? "paved" : (road.type == "sea_route" ? "water" : "dirt");
12037 |                         g_path_cache_dirty = true;
12038 |                         std::string msg = (road.type == "sea_route") ? locStr("engine.news.sea_route_restored") : locStr("engine.news.road_restored");
12039 |                         addNews(locStr("engine.news.infrastructure_restored", {{"faction", f.name}, {"msg", msg}, {"from", road.from}, {"to", road.to}}), road.from, 2, "logistics");

12060 |     for (auto& [fid, f] : g_world.factions) {
