12236 | 
12237 | class PerlinNoise {
12238 |     std::vector<int> p;
12239 |     double fade(double t) { return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10); }
12240 |     double lerp(double t, double a, double b) { return a + t * (b - a); }
12241 |     double grad(int hash, double x, double y, double z) {
12242 |         int h = hash & 15;
12243 |         double u = h < 8 ? x : y;
12244 |         double v = h < 4 ? y : h == 12 || h == 14 ? x : z;
12245 |         return ((h & 1) == 0 ? u : -u) + ((h & 2) == 0 ? v : -v);
12246 |     }
12247 | public:
12248 |     PerlinNoise(unsigned int seed) {
12249 |         p.resize(256);
12250 |         std::iota(p.begin(), p.end(), 0);
12251 |         std::default_random_engine engine(seed);
12252 |         std::shuffle(p.begin(), p.end(), engine);
12253 |         p.insert(p.end(), p.begin(), p.end());
12254 |     }
12255 |     double noise(double x, double y, double z) {
12256 |         int X = (int)floor(x) & 255;
12257 |         int Y = (int)floor(y) & 255;
12258 |         int Z = (int)floor(z) & 255;
12259 |         x -= floor(x); y -= floor(y); z -= floor(z);
12260 |         double u = fade(x), v = fade(y), w = fade(z);
12261 |         int A = p[X]+Y, AA = p[A]+Z, AB = p[A+1]+Z;
12262 |         int B = p[X+1]+Y, BA = p[B]+Z, BB = p[B+1]+Z;
12263 |         return lerp(w, lerp(v, lerp(u, grad(p[AA], x, y, z),
12264 |                                        grad(p[BA], x-1, y, z)),
12265 |                                lerp(u, grad(p[AB], x, y-1, z),
12266 |                                        grad(p[BB], x-1, y-1, z))),
12267 |                        lerp(v, lerp(u, grad(p[AA+1], x, y, z-1),
12268 |                                        grad(p[BA+1], x-1, y, z-1)),
12269 |                                lerp(u, grad(p[AB+1], x, y-1, z-1),
12270 |                                        grad(p[BB+1], x-1, y-1, z-1))));
12271 |     }
12272 |     double fbm(double x, double y, int octaves, double persistence, double lacunarity) {
12273 |         double total = 0;
12274 |         double frequency = 1;
12275 |         double amplitude = 1;
12276 |         double maxValue = 0;
12277 |         for(int i=0; i<octaves; i++) {
12278 |             total += noise(x * frequency, y * frequency, 0) * amplitude;
12279 |             maxValue += amplitude;
12280 |             amplitude *= persistence;
12281 |             frequency *= lacunarity;
12282 |         }
12283 |         return total / maxValue;
12284 |     }
12285 | };
12286 | 
12287 | void generateWorldMapTerrain(WorldMap& map, int seed) {
12288 |     auto& cfg = g_db.world_config;
12289 |     map.grid.resize(map.width * map.height);
12290 |     std::vector<double> elevation(map.width * map.height);
12291 | 
12292 |     // ====================================================================
12293 |     // PASS 1: Elevation + Biome assignment (data-driven continent generation)
12294 |     // ====================================================================
12295 |     int num_threads = std::thread::hardware_concurrency();
12296 |     if (num_threads == 0) num_threads = 4;
12297 |     std::vector<std::future<void>> futures;
12298 |     int chunk_size = map.height / num_threads;
12299 | 
12300 |     for (int t = 0; t < num_threads; ++t) {
12301 |         int start_y = t * chunk_size;
12302 |         int end_y = (t == num_threads - 1) ? map.height : (t + 1) * chunk_size;
12303 | 
12304 |         futures.push_back(getThreadPool()->enqueue([start_y, end_y, &map, &elevation, seed, &cfg]() {
12305 |             PerlinNoise perlin(seed);
12306 |             PerlinNoise detail_noise(seed + 10);  // Higher-freq detail layer
12307 |             PerlinNoise temp_noise(seed + 1);
12308 |             PerlinNoise moist_noise(seed + 2);
12309 | 
12310 |             for (int y = start_y; y < end_y; ++y) {
12311 |                 for (int x = 0; x < map.width; ++x) {
12312 |                     double nx = (double)x / map.width;
12313 |                     double ny = (double)y / map.height;
12314 | 
12315 |                     // Low frequency = large landforms (continent, not islands)
12316 |                     double e = perlin.fbm(nx * cfg.continent.noise_frequency,
12317 |                                           ny * cfg.continent.noise_frequency,
12318 |                                           cfg.continent.noise_octaves, 0.5, 2.0);
12319 | 
12320 |                     // Shift elevation up for more land area
12321 |                     e = e + cfg.continent.elevation_shift;
12322 | 
12323 |                     // Edge falloff: push map edges below sea level to create continent shape
12324 |                     double dx = nx - 0.5;
12325 |                     double dy = ny - 0.5;
12326 |                     double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 2.0;
12327 |                     double falloff = 1.0 - std::pow(std::min(dist * cfg.continent.edge_falloff_range, 1.0),
12328 |                                                      cfg.continent.edge_falloff_power);
12329 |                     e = e * falloff + (1.0 - falloff) * cfg.continent.edge_ocean_elevation;
12330 | 
12331 |                     // Add terrain detail (mountains, hills) within the continent
12332 |                     // Only apply where there's land — don't raise ocean tiles
12333 |                     if (e > -0.05) {
12334 |                         double detail = detail_noise.fbm(nx * 3.0, ny * 3.0, 5, 0.55, 2.0);
12335 |                         // Scale detail by distance from coast (more variation inland)
12336 |                         double land_factor = std::clamp((e + 0.05) / 0.3, 0.0, 1.0);
12337 |                         e += detail * 0.35 * land_factor;
12338 |                     }
12339 | 
12340 |                     // Clamp elevation to valid range for biome matching
12341 |                     e = std::clamp(e, -1.0, 1.0);
12342 | 
12343 |                     elevation[y * map.width + x] = e;
12344 | 
12345 |                     double dist_to_equator = std::abs(y - map.height / 2.0) / (map.height / 2.0);
12346 |                     double base_t = 0.7 - dist_to_equator * 0.5;
12347 |                     double t_noise = temp_noise.fbm(nx * 3.0, ny * 3.0, 3, 0.5, 2.0) * 0.15;
12348 |                     double temperature = std::clamp(base_t + t_noise, 0.0, 1.0);
12349 | 
12350 |                     double m = moist_noise.fbm(nx * 5.0, ny * 5.0, 4, 0.5, 2.0) + 0.5;
12351 | 
12352 |                     uint8_t selected_biome = 0;
12353 |                     double best_score = 999.0;
12354 |                     for (const auto& b : g_db.biomes) {
12355 |                         if (e >= b.min_elevation && e <= b.max_elevation &&
12356 |                             temperature >= b.min_temp && temperature <= b.max_temp &&
12357 |                             m >= b.min_moisture && m <= b.max_moisture) {
12358 |                             selected_biome = b.numeric_id;
12359 |                             break;
12360 |                         }
12361 |                         // Fallback: match by elevation only (closest land biome)
12362 |                         // Skip special biomes (ruins, river, etc.) with min_elev >= 2.0
12363 |                         if (!b.is_water && b.min_elevation < 2.0) {
12364 |                             double b_min = b.min_elevation;
12365 |                             double b_max = b.max_elevation;
12366 |                             // Extend mountain range upward to catch clamped high elevations
12367 |                             if (b_max >= 0.9) b_max = 2.0;
12368 |                             if (e >= b_min && e <= b_max) {
12369 |                                 double score = std::abs(e - (b.min_elevation + b.max_elevation) / 2.0);
12370 |                                 if (score < best_score) {
12371 |                                     best_score = score;
12372 |                                     selected_biome = b.numeric_id;
12373 |                                 }
12374 |                             }
12375 |                         }
12376 |                     }
12377 |                     // Ultimate fallback: high elevation → mountains, low → ocean
12378 |                     if (selected_biome == 0 && e > 0.05) {
12379 |                         uint8_t mtn_id = getBiomeIdByTag("mountain", 4);
12380 |                         selected_biome = mtn_id;
12381 |                     }
12382 |                     map.grid[y * map.width + x].biome_id = selected_biome;
12383 |                 }
12384 |             }
12385 |         }));
12386 |     }
12387 |     for (auto& f : futures) f.get();
12388 | 
12389 |     // ====================================================================
12390 |     // PASS 2: Connectivity — ensure one connected continent, no small islands
12391 |     // ====================================================================
12392 |     if (cfg.continent.connectivity_pass && cfg.landform == "continent") {
12393 |         int w = map.width, h = map.height;
12394 |         uint8_t ocean_id = getBiomeIdByTag("ocean");
12395 |         uint8_t shallow_id = getBiomeIdByTag("shallow_water");
12396 |         uint8_t beach_id = getBiomeIdByTag("beach");
12397 |         uint8_t plains_id = getBiomeIdByTag("plains");
12398 | 
12399 |         auto isLand = [&](int idx) -> bool {
12400 |             uint8_t b = map.grid[idx].biome_id;
12401 |             return (b != ocean_id && b != shallow_id);
12402 |         };
12403 | 
12404 |         // Flood-fill to find all connected land components
12405 |         std::vector<int> component(w * h, -1);
12406 |         int num_components = 0;
12407 |         std::vector<int> component_size;
12408 |         int largest_component = 0;
12409 |         int largest_size = 0;
12410 | 
12411 |         int flood_dx[] = {0, 1, 0, -1};
12412 |         int flood_dy[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
12413 | 
12414 |         for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
12415 |             for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
12416 |                 int idx = y * w + x;
12417 |                 if (!isLand(idx) || component[idx] >= 0) continue;
12418 | 
12419 |                 int cid = num_components++;
12420 |                 component_size.push_back(0);
12421 |                 std::queue<std::pair<int,int>> q;
12422 |                 q.push({x, y});
12423 |                 component[idx] = cid;
12424 | 
12425 |                 while (!q.empty()) {
12426 |                     auto [cx, cy] = q.front(); q.pop();
12427 |                     component_size[cid]++;
12428 | 
12429 |                     for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
12430 |                         int nx = cx + flood_dx[d];
12431 |                         int ny = cy + flood_dy[d];
12432 |                         if (nx < 0 || nx >= w || ny < 0 || ny >= h) continue;
12433 |                         int nIdx = ny * w + nx;
12434 |                         if (isLand(nIdx) && component[nIdx] < 0) {
12435 |                             component[nIdx] = cid;
12436 |                             q.push({nx, ny});
12437 |                         }
12438 |                     }
12439 |                 }
12440 | 
12441 |                 if (component_size[cid] > largest_size) {
12442 |                     largest_size = component_size[cid];
12443 |                     largest_component = cid;
12444 |                 }
12445 |             }
12446 |         }
12447 | 
12448 |         // Remove small islands: convert land tiles of small components to ocean
12449 |         int remove_threshold = cfg.continent.remove_islands_under;
12450 |         for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i) {
12451 |             if (isLand(i) && component[i] >= 0 && component[i] != largest_component) {
12452 |                 if (component_size[component[i]] < remove_threshold) {
12453 |                     // Small island → convert to ocean
12454 |                     map.grid[i].biome_id = ocean_id;
12455 |                     elevation[i] = -0.4;
12456 |                     component[i] = -1;
12457 |                 }
12458 |             }
12459 |         }
12460 | 
12461 |         // Land bridge pass: find narrow ocean gaps between land components and fill them
12462 |         // For each water tile that separates two land areas within max_gap distance, fill with land
12463 |         int max_gap = cfg.continent.land_bridge_max_gap;
12464 |         if (max_gap > 0) {
12465 |             // Multiple dilation passes to connect nearby landmasses
12466 |             for (int pass = 0; pass < max_gap; ++pass) {
12467 |                 std::vector<uint8_t> bridged(w * h);
12468 |                 for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i) bridged[i] = map.grid[i].biome_id;
12469 | 
12470 |                 for (int y = 1; y < h - 1; ++y) {
12471 |                     for (int x = 1; x < w - 1; ++x) {
12472 |                         int idx = y * w + x;
12473 |                         if (isLand(idx)) continue;
12474 |                         // Check if this water tile is between two land tiles (horizontally or vertically)
12475 |                         bool left_land = isLand(y * w + (x - 1));
12476 |                         bool right_land = isLand(y * w + (x + 1));
12477 |                         bool up_land = isLand((y - 1) * w + x);
12478 |                         bool down_land = isLand((y + 1) * w + x);
12479 | 
12480 |                         if ((left_land && right_land) || (up_land && down_land)) {
12481 |                             // This is a narrow gap — fill with land (beach/plains)
12482 |                             bridged[idx] = (elevation[idx] >= -0.1) ? plains_id : beach_id;
12483 |                             elevation[idx] = 0.08; // Just above beach threshold
12484 |                         }
12485 |                     }
12486 |                 }
12487 |                 for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i) map.grid[i].biome_id = bridged[i];
12488 |             }
12489 |         }
12490 | 
12491 |         // Ensure minimum land ratio: if too little land, raise elevation near center
12492 |         double land_ratio = 0;
12493 |         for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i) {
12494 |             if (isLand(i)) land_ratio++;
12495 |         }
12496 |         land_ratio /= (w * h);
12497 | 
12498 |         if (land_ratio < cfg.continent.min_land_ratio) {
12499 |             // Raise a band around the continent core
12500 |             double deficit = cfg.continent.min_land_ratio - land_ratio;
12501 |             double expand_range = 0.65 + deficit * 2.0; // Expand the continent further
12502 | 
12503 |             for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
12504 |                 for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
12505 |                     double nx = (double)x / w;
12506 |                     double ny = (double)y / h;
12507 |                     double ddx = nx - 0.5;
12508 |                     double ddy = ny - 0.5;
12509 |                     double d = std::sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy) * 2.0;
12510 | 
12511 |                     if (d < expand_range && !isLand(y * w + x)) {
12512 |                         // Raise to land level
12513 |                         double t = 1.0 - (d / expand_range);
12514 |                         elevation[y * w + x] = 0.08 * t;
12515 |                         map.grid[y * w + x].biome_id = (t > 0.3) ? plains_id : beach_id;
12516 |                     }
12517 |                 }
12518 |             }
12519 |         }
12520 |     }
12521 | 
12522 |     // ====================================================================
12523 |     // PASS 3: Biome smoothing (multiple passes from config)
12524 |     // ====================================================================
12525 |     for (int smooth_pass = 0; smooth_pass < cfg.continent.smoothing_passes; ++smooth_pass) {
12526 |         std::vector<uint8_t> smoothed(map.width * map.height);
12527 |         for (int y = 0; y < map.height; ++y) {
12528 |             for (int x = 0; x < map.width; ++x) {
12529 |                 int idx = y * map.width + x;
12530 |                 uint8_t current = map.grid[idx].biome_id;
12531 |                 if (hasBiomeTag(current, "ocean") || hasBiomeTag(current, "shallow_water")) {
12532 |                     smoothed[idx] = current; continue;
12533 |                 }
12534 |                 std::map<uint8_t, int> counts;
12535 |                 for(int dy=-1; dy<=1; dy++) {
12536 |                     for(int dx=-1; dx<=1; dx++) {
12537 |                         if(dx==0 && dy==0) continue;
12538 |                         int nnx = x+dx, nny = y+dy;
12539 |                         if(nnx>=0 && nnx<map.width && nny>=0 && nny<map.height) {
12540 |                             counts[map.grid[nny*map.width+nnx].biome_id]++;
12541 |                         }
12542 |                     }
12543 |                 }
12544 |                 uint8_t dominant = current;
12545 |                 int max_c = 0;
12546 |                 for (auto& [t, c] : counts) {
12547 |                     if (c > max_c) { max_c = c; dominant = t; }
12548 |                 }
12549 |                 if (max_c >= 5) smoothed[idx] = dominant;
12550 |                 else smoothed[idx] = current;
12551 |             }
12552 |         }
12553 |         for (int i = 0; i < map.width * map.height; ++i) map.grid[i].biome_id = smoothed[i];
12554 |     }
12555 | 
12556 |     // ====================================================================
12557 |     // PASS 4: Continental shelf (shallow water around land)
12558 |     // ====================================================================
12559 |     std::vector<uint8_t> shelf_types(map.width * map.height);
12560 |     for (int i = 0; i < map.width * map.height; ++i) shelf_types[i] = map.grid[i].biome_id;
12561 | 
12562 |     uint8_t ocean_id = getBiomeIdByTag("ocean");
12563 |     uint8_t shallow_id = getBiomeIdByTag("shallow_water");
12564 | 
12565 |     for (int y = 0; y < map.height; ++y) {
12566 |         for (int x = 0; x < map.width; ++x) {
12567 |             if (map.grid[y * map.width + x].biome_id == ocean_id) {
12568 |                 bool near_land = false;
12569 |                 int radius = 3;
12570 |                 for (int dy = -radius; dy <= radius; ++dy) {
12571 |                     for (int ddx = -radius; ddx <= radius; ++ddx) {
12572 |                         if (ddx*ddx + dy*dy <= radius*radius) {
12573 |                             int nnx = x + ddx;
12574 |                             int nny = y + dy;
12575 |                             if (nnx >= 0 && nnx < map.width && nny >= 0 && nny < map.height) {
12576 |                                 uint8_t nt = map.grid[nny * map.width + nnx].biome_id;
12577 |                                 if (nt != ocean_id && nt != shallow_id) {
12578 |                                     near_land = true;
12579 |                                     break;
12580 |                                 }
12581 |                             }
12582 |                         }
12583 |                     }
12584 |                     if (near_land) break;
12585 |                 }
12586 |                 if (near_land) {
12587 |                     shelf_types[y * map.width + x] = shallow_id;
12588 |                 }
12589 |             }
12590 |         }
12591 |     }
12592 |     for (int i = 0; i < map.width * map.height; ++i) map.grid[i].biome_id = shelf_types[i];
12593 | 
12594 | 
12595 |     int dx[] = {0, 1, 0, -1, 1, 1, -1, -1};
12596 |     int dy[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0, -1, 1, 1, -1};
12597 | 
12598 |     // ====================================================================
12599 |     // PASS 5: Rivers (data-driven from config)
12600 |     // ====================================================================
12601 |     int w = map.width, h = map.height;
12602 |     PerlinNoise river_noise(seed + 123);
12603 | 
12604 |     for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
12605 |         for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
12606 |             int idx = y * w + x;
12607 |             uint8_t b_id = map.grid[idx].biome_id;
12608 |             if (hasBiomeTag(b_id, "ocean") || hasBiomeTag(b_id, "shallow_water")) continue;
12609 | 
12610 |             double nnx = (double)x / w;
12611 |             double nny = (double)y / h;
12612 | 
12613 |             double r_val = river_noise.fbm(nnx * cfg.rivers.noise_frequency,
12614 |                                             nny * cfg.rivers.noise_frequency,
12615 |                                             cfg.rivers.noise_octaves, 0.5, 2.0);
12616 | 
12617 |             double e = elevation[idx];
12618 |             double threshold = cfg.rivers.threshold_default;
12619 |             if (e < 0.2) threshold = cfg.rivers.threshold_plains;
12620 |             if (e > 0.6) threshold = cfg.rivers.threshold_mountains;
12621 | 
12622 |             if (std::abs(r_val) < threshold) {
12623 |                 map.grid[idx].biome_id = getBiomeIdByTag("river");
12624 |                 map.grid[idx].water_depth = (e < 0.2) ? 3 : 1;
12625 |             }
12626 |         }
12627 |     }
12628 | 
12629 |     // ====================================================================
12630 |     // PASS 6: River banks, floodplains, lakes
12631 |     // ====================================================================
12632 |     std::vector<uint8_t> new_types(w * h);
12633 |     for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i) new_types[i] = map.grid[i].biome_id;
12634 | 
12635 |     uint8_t river_id = getBiomeIdByTag("river");
12636 |     uint8_t lake_id = getBiomeIdByTag("lake");
12637 |     uint8_t riverbank_id = getBiomeIdByTag("riverbank");
12638 |     uint8_t floodplain_id = getBiomeIdByTag("floodplain");
12639 | 
12640 |     for (int y = 0; y < h; ++y) {
12641 |         for (int x = 0; x < w; ++x) {
12642 |             if (map.grid[y * w + x].biome_id == river_id) {
12643 |                 int depth = map.grid[y * w + x].water_depth;
12644 |                 int radius = (depth >= 3) ? 2 : 1;
12645 | 
12646 |                 for (int ddy = -radius; ddy <= radius; ++ddy) {
12647 |                     for (int ddx = -radius; ddx <= radius; ++ddx) {
12648 |                         int nnx = x + ddx, nny = y + ddy;
12649 |                         if (nnx >= 0 && nnx < w && nny >= 0 && nny < h) {
12650 |                             uint8_t orig_t = map.grid[nny * w + nnx].biome_id;
12651 |                             if (!hasBiomeTag(orig_t, "water")) {
12652 |                                 double dist = std::hypot(ddx, ddy);
12653 | 
12654 |                                 if (hasBiomeTag(orig_t, "tundra")) {
12655 |                                     continue;
12656 |                                 } else if (hasBiomeTag(orig_t, "desert")) {
12657 |                                     if (dist <= 1.5) new_types[nny * w + nnx] = riverbank_id;
12658 |                                 } else if (hasBiomeTag(orig_t, "swamp")) {
12659 |                                     continue;
12660 |                                 } else {
12661 |                                     if (dist <= 1.5) {
12662 |                                         new_types[nny * w + nnx] = riverbank_id;
12663 |                                     } else if (dist <= 2.5 && new_types[nny * w + nnx] != riverbank_id) {
12664 |                                         new_types[nny * w + nnx] = floodplain_id;
12665 |                                     }
12666 |                                 }
12667 |                             }
12668 |                         }
12669 |                     }
12670 |                 }
12671 |

12680 |                 }

12683 |                 }

12685 |         }
12686 |     }
12687 |     for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i) map.grid[i].biome_id = new_types[i];

12689 |     // ====================================================================
12690 |     // PASS 7: Volcanoes (data-driven from config)
12691 |     // ====================================================================
12692 |     int num_volcanoes = cfg.volcanoes.count;
12693 |     PerlinNoise vol_noise(seed + 999);
12694 |     uint8_t mountains_id = getBiomeIdByTag("mountain");
12695 |     uint8_t volcano_id = getBiomeIdByTag("volcano");
12696 |     uint8_t lava_id = getBiomeIdByTag("lava");

12702 |         int attempts = 0;

12704 |             vx = rand() % map.width;
12705 |             vy = rand() % map.height;
12706 |             attempts++;

12710 |             for (int ddy = -radius; ddy <= radius; ++ddy) {

12729 |             }
12730 |         }

12733 |     int x, y, g, f;

12737 | std::vector<std::pair<int,int>> findPath(const WorldMap& map, int startX, int startY, int goalX, int goalY, const std::vector<bool>& has_road, const std::vector<int>& path_status, MovementType moveType, int entity_size) {
12738 |     int w = map.width;
12739 |     int h = map.height;
12740 |     
12741 |     // Bounds check: ensure map grid is properly sized
12742 |     if (w <= 0 || h <= 0 || static_cast<size_t>(w * h) > map.grid.size()) return {};
12743 |     
12744 |     startX = std::clamp(startX, 0, w - 1);
12745 |     startY = std::clamp(startY, 0, h - 1);
12746 |     goalX = std::clamp(goalX, 0, w - 1);
12747 |     goalY = std::clamp(goalY, 0, h - 1);
12748 |     
12749 |     // Оптимизация выделения памяти: используем thread_local для предотвращения постоянных аллокаций
12750 |     thread_local std::vector<int> g_cost;
12751 |     thread_local std::vector<int> parent;
12752 |     if (g_cost.size() != static_cast<size_t>(w * h)) {
12753 |         g_cost.resize(w * h);
12754 |         parent.resize(w * h);
12755 |     }
12756 |     std::fill(g_cost.begin(), g_cost.end(), 1e9);
12757 |     std::fill(parent.begin(), parent.end(), -1);
12758 |     
12759 |     std::priority_queue<AStarNode, std::vector<AStarNode>, AStarCompare> pq;
12760 | 
12761 |     int startIdx = startY * w + startX;

12763 |     pq.push({startX, startY, 0, 0});
12764 | 
12765 |     int dx[] = {0, 1, 0, -1, 1, 1, -1, -1};
12766 |     int dy[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0, -1, 1, 1, -1};
12767 | 
12768 |     while (!pq.empty()) {
12769 |         auto curr = pq.top();
12770 |         pq.pop();
12771 | 
12772 |         if (curr.x == goalX && curr.y == goalY) break;

12774 | 
12775 |         for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {

12779 | 
12780 |             int nIdx = ny * w + nx;
12781 |             int cost = 1;
12782 |             
12783 |             if (path_status[nIdx] == 2) {
12784 |                 cost = 9999; // Заблокировано
12785 |             } else if (moveType == MovementType::LAND) {

12801 |                             cost = 10; // Брод
12802 |                         } else {
12803 |                             cost = 9999; // Разрушенный мост/паром непроходим

12806 |                         cost = 9999; // Паром не выдержит крупную армию или караван
12807 |                     } else {
12808 |                         cost = 1;
12809 |                         if (path_status[nIdx] == 1) cost *= 3;
12810 |                     }
12811 |                 } else {
12812 |                     if (is_water) {
12813 |                         if (hasBiomeTag(b_id, "river") && map.grid[nIdx].water_depth <= 1) {
12814 |                             cost = 10; // Брод
12815 |                         } else {
12816 |                             cost = 9999; // Строгий запрет на пересечение глубокой воды без моста
12817 |                         }
12818 |                     } else if (is_impassable) {
12819 |                         cost = 9999; // Горы/Вулканы непроходимы без дорог (тоннелей)
12820 |                     } else {
12821 |                         cost = base_cost * 2; // По бездорожью медленнее
12822 |                     }
12823 |                 }
12824 |             } else if (moveType == MovementType::WATER) {
12825 |                 uint8_t b_id = map.grid[nIdx].biome_id;
12826 |                 bool is_water = false;
12827 |                 const BiomeDef* biome_w = getBiomeById(b_id);
12828 |                 if (biome_w) {
12829 |                     is_water = biome_w->is_water;

12839 |                         else cost = 3;
12840 |                     } else {
12841 |                         cost = 2; // Default water cost
12842 |                     }
12843 |                 }
12844 |             } else if (moveType == MovementType::ANY) {
12845 |                 uint8_t b_id = map.grid[nIdx].biome_id;
12846 |                 const BiomeDef* biome_a = getBiomeById(b_id);
12847 |                 bool is_water_a = biome_a ? biome_a->is_water : false;
12848 |                 bool is_impassable_a = biome_a ? biome_a->is_impassable : false;
12849 |                 int base_cost_a = biome_a ? biome_a->movement_cost : 9999;
12850 | 
12851 |                 if (has_road[nIdx]) {
12852 |                     cost = 1;
12853 |                 } else if (is_water_a) {
12854 |                     // ANY может пересекать воду, но с высоким штрафом (для генерации мостов/паромов)
12855 |                     if (hasBiomeTag(b_id, "river")) {
12856 |                         cost = (map.grid[nIdx].water_depth <= 1) ? 15 : 25; // Брод или паром
12857 |                     } else if (hasBiomeTag(b_id, "lake")) {
12858 |                         cost = 30; // Паром через озеро
12859 |                     } else {
12860 |                         cost = 50; // Морской маршрут
12861 |                     }
12862 |                 } else if (is_impassable_a) {
12863 |                     // ANY может проходить через горы/вулканы с огромным штрафом (для генерации тоннелей)
12864 |                     cost = base_cost_a; // 9999 * 1 = тоннель крайне дорог, но возможен
12865 |                 } else {
12866 |                     cost = base_cost_a * 2; // Обычное бездорожье
12867 |                 }
12868 |                 if (path_status[nIdx] == 1) cost *= 3;
12869 |             }
12870 | 
12871 |             // Блокировка только для заблокированных дорог (status==2) и импассабл без ANY
12872 |             if (path_status[nIdx] == 2 && !(nx == goalX && ny == goalY)) {
12873 |                 // Заблокированные дороги непроходимы, кроме самой цели
12874 |                 if (moveType != MovementType::ANY) continue;
12875 |                 // Для ANY - заблокированные дороги очень дороги, но не непроходимы
12876 |                 cost = std::max(cost, 200);
12877 |             }
12878 | 
12879 |             if (cost >= g_gameplay_runtime.path_impassable_cost_threshold) {
12880 |                 if (nx == goalX && ny == goalY) cost = 5;
12881 |                 else continue;
12882 |             }
12883 | 
12884 |             int new_g = curr.g + cost * (i >= 4 ? 14 : 10);
12885 |             if (new_g < g_cost[nIdx]) {
12886 |                 g_cost[nIdx] = new_g;
12887 |                 parent[nIdx] = curr.y * w + curr.x;
12888 |                 int h_cost = (std::abs(nx - goalX) + std::abs(ny - goalY)) * 10;
12889 |                 pq.push({nx, ny, new_g, new_g + h_cost});
12890 |             }
12891 |         }
12892 |     }
12893 | 
12894 |     std::vector<std::pair<int,int>> path;
12895 |     int currIdx = goalY * w + goalX;
12896 |     if (parent[currIdx] == -1) return path;
12897 | 
12898 |     while (currIdx != startIdx) {
12899 |         path.push_back({currIdx % w, currIdx / w});
12900 |         currIdx = parent[currIdx];
12901 |     }
12902 |     path.push_back({startX, startY});
12903 |     std::reverse(path.begin(), path.end());
12904 |     return path;

13074 | void generateRoads(WorldMap& map, const World& w) {
13075 |     std::vector<bool> pathfinding_helper(map.width * map.height, false);
13076 |     std::vector<int> path_status_helper(map.width * map.height, 0);
13077 | 
13078 |     auto processRoadSegment = [&](MapRoad& road, int8_t quality) {
13079 |         std::vector<MapRoad> new_segments;
13080 |         MapRoad current_segment;
13081 |         current_segment.from = road.from;
13082 |         current_segment.to = road.to;
13083 |         current_segment.condition = road.condition;
13084 |         
13085 |         if (road.waypoints.empty()) return new_segments;
13086 | 
13087 |         int initial_idx = road.waypoints[0].second * map.width + road.waypoints[0].first;
13088 |         uint8_t initial_t = map.grid[initial_idx].biome_id;
13089 |         bool is_water_init = hasBiomeTag(initial_t, "water");
13090 |         bool is_impassable_init = hasBiomeTag(initial_t, "impassable");
13091 |         
13092 |         if (is_water_init) {
13093 |             current_segment.type = (map.grid[initial_idx].water_depth >= 3) ? "ferry" : "bridge";
13094 |         } else if (is_impassable_init) {
13095 |             current_segment.type = "tunnel";
13096 |         } else {
13097 |             current_segment.type = (quality == 2) ? "paved" : "dirt";
13098 |         }
13099 | 
13100 |         for (size_t i = 0; i < road.waypoints.size(); ++i) {
13101 |             auto wp = road.waypoints[i];
13102 |             int idx = wp.second * map.width + wp.first;
13103 |             if (quality > map.grid[idx].road_level) map.grid[idx].road_level = quality;
13104 |             pathfinding_helper[idx] = true;
13105 | 
13106 |             uint8_t t = map.grid[idx].biome_id;
13107 |             bool is_water = hasBiomeTag(t, "water");
13108 |             bool is_impassable = hasBiomeTag(t, "impassable");
13109 |             
13110 |             std::string target_type;
13111 |             if (is_water) {
13112 |                 map.grid[idx].bridge_flag = 1;
13113 |                 map.grid[idx].road_level = quality;
13114 |                 target_type = (map.grid[idx].water_depth >= 3) ? "ferry" : "bridge";
13115 |             } else if (is_impassable) {
13116 |                 target_type = "tunnel";
13117 |             } else {
13118 |                 target_type = (quality == 2) ? "paved" : "dirt";
13119 |             }
13120 | 
13121 |             if (current_segment.type != target_type && !current_segment.waypoints.empty()) {
13122 |                 current_segment.waypoints.push_back(wp);
13123 |                 new_segments.push_back(current_segment);
13124 |                 
13125 |                 current_segment.waypoints.clear();
13126 |                 current_segment.type = target_type;
13127 |                 if (i > 0) {
13128 |                     current_segment.waypoints.push_back(road.waypoints[i-1]);
13129 |                 }
13130 |             }
13131 |             
13132 |             if (current_segment.waypoints.empty() || current_segment.waypoints.back() != wp) {
13133 |                 current_segment.waypoints.push_back(wp);
13134 |             }
13135 |         }
13136 |         if (!current_segment.waypoints.empty()) new_segments.push_back(current_segment);
13137 |         return new_segments;
13138 |     };
13139 | 
13140 |     // 1. Сначала прокладываем внутренние (грунтовые) дороги
13141 |     // Собираем регионы, которые не получили дороги (для fallback-пасса)
13142 |     std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> isolated_regions; // {regionId, capitalId}
13143 | 
13144 |     for (const auto& [fid, f] : w.factions) {
13145 |         if (f.regions.empty()) continue;
13146 |         std::string capital = f.regions[0];
13147 |         if (!map.locations.count(capital)) continue;
13148 |         auto capLoc = map.locations.at(capital);
13149 | 
13150 |         for (size_t i = 1; i < f.regions.size(); ++i) {
13151 |             std::string rid = f.regions[i];
13152 |             if (!map.locations.count(rid)) continue;
13153 |             auto rLoc = map.locations.at(rid);
13154 | 
13155 |             // Пропускаем только если no_road=true И нет населения (действительно изолированные)
13156 |             bool is_truly_isolated = rLoc.no_road;
13157 |             auto regIt = w.regions.find(rid);
13158 |             if (regIt != w.regions.end() && regIt->second.population > 0) {
13159 |                 is_truly_isolated = false; // Жилые города ВСЕГДА получают дороги
13160 |             }
13161 |             if (is_truly_isolated) continue;
13162 | 
13163 |             auto path = findPath(map, rLoc.x, rLoc.y, capLoc.x, capLoc.y, pathfinding_helper, path_status_helper, MovementType::ANY);
13164 |             if (!path.empty()) {
13165 |                 MapRoad road; road.from = rid; road.to = capital; road.condition = "dirt"; road.waypoints = path;
13166 |                 auto segments = processRoadSegment(road, 1);
13167 |                 map.roads.insert(map.roads.end(), segments.begin(), segments.end());
13168 |             } else {
13169 |                 // Запоминаем изолированный регион для fallback-пасса
13170 |                 isolated_regions.push_back({rid, capital});
13171 |             }
13172 |         }
13173 |     }
13174 | 
13175 |     // 1.5 Fallback-пасс: пытаемся соединить изолированные жилые города
13176 |     // с ближайшим ЛЮБЫМ городом, у которого есть дорога
13177 |     for (const auto& [isolatedId, origCapital] : isolated_regions) {
13178 |         if (!map.locations.count(isolatedId)) continue;
13179 |         auto isoLoc = map.locations.at(isolatedId);
13180 |         auto regIt = w.regions.find(isolatedId);
13181 |         if (regIt != w.regions.end() && regIt->second.population <= 0) continue; // Только жилые
13182 | 
13183 |         // Ищем ближайший город с дорогой
13184 |         std::string bestTarget = "";
13185 |         int bestDist = 999999;
13186 |         for (const auto& [lid, lloc] : map.locations) {
13187 |             if (lid == isolatedId) continue;
13188 |             // Проверяем, есть ли у этого города дорога
13189 |             bool hasRoadConnection = false;
13190 |             for (const auto& road : map.roads) {
13191 |                 if (road.from == lid || road.to == lid) { hasRoadConnection = true; break; }
13192 |             }
13193 |             if (!hasRoadConnection) continue;
13194 | 
13195 |             int d = std::abs(lloc.x - isoLoc.x) + std::abs(lloc.y - isoLoc.y);
13196 |             if (d < bestDist) {
13197 |                 bestDist = d;
13198 |                 bestTarget = lid;
13199 |             }
13200 |         }
13201 | 
13202 |         if (!bestTarget.empty()) {
13203 |             auto targetLoc = map.locations.at(bestTarget);
13204 |             auto path = findPath(map, isoLoc.x, isoLoc.y, targetLoc.x, targetLoc.y, pathfinding_helper, path_status_helper, MovementType::ANY);
13205 |             if (!path.empty()) {
13206 |                 MapRoad road; road.from = isolatedId; road.to = bestTarget; road.condition = "dirt"; road.waypoints = path;
13207 |                 auto segments = processRoadSegment(road, 1);
13208 |                 map.roads.insert(map.roads.end(), segments.begin(), segments.end());
13209 |                 // Снимаем флаг no_road на карте
13210 |                 // (w.regions — const, менять нельзя, но map.locations достаточно)
13211 |                 map.locations[isolatedId].no_road = false;
13212 |             }
13213 |         }
13214 |     }
13215 | 
13216 |     // 2. Затем международные (мощеные) - они будут поглощать грунтовые
13217 |     std::vector<std::string> capitals;
13218 |     for (const auto& [fid, f] : w.factions) {
13219 |         if (!f.regions.empty() && map.locations.count(f.regions[0])) capitals.push_back(f.regions[0]);
13220 |     }
13221 | 
13222 |     for (size_t i = 0; i < capitals.size(); ++i) {
13223 |         for (size_t j = i + 1; j < capitals.size(); ++j) {
13224 |             std::string cap1 = capitals[i]; std::string cap2 = capitals[j];
13225 |             // Пропускаем только если оба города нежилые и имеют no_road
13226 |             bool skip1 = map.locations.at(cap1).no_road;
13227 |             bool skip2 = map.locations.at(cap2).no_road;
13228 |             auto r1It = w.regions.find(cap1);
13229 |             auto r2It = w.regions.find(cap2);
13230 |             if (r1It != w.regions.end() && r1It->second.population > 0) skip1 = false;
13231 |             if (r2It != w.regions.end() && r2It->second.population > 0) skip2 = false;
13232 |             if (skip1 || skip2) continue;
13233 |             if (w.factions.at(map.locations.at(cap1).faction).diplomacy.count(map.locations.at(cap2).faction)) {
13234 |                 if (w.factions.at(map.locations.at(cap1).faction).diplomacy.at(map.locations.at(cap2).faction) == "war") continue;
13235 |             }
13236 | 
13237 |             auto loc1 = map.locations.at(cap1); auto loc2 = map.locations.at(cap2);
13238 |             auto path = findPath(map, loc1.x, loc1.y, loc2.x, loc2.y, pathfinding_helper, path_status_helper, MovementType::ANY);
13239 |             if (!path.empty()) {
13240 |                 MapRoad road; road.from = cap1; road.to = cap2; road.condition = "paved"; road.waypoints = path;
13241 |                 auto segments = processRoadSegment(road, 2);
13242 |                 map.roads.insert(map.roads.end(), segments.begin(), segments.end());
13243 |             }
13244 |         }
13245 |     }
13246 | }

13283 | void generateCityLayout(Region& r, World& w) {
13284 |     // 1. Динамический размер города в зависимости от населения
13285 |     if (r.population < 2000) { r.layoutWidth = 10; r.layoutHeight = 10; }
13286 |     else if (r.population <= 10000) { r.layoutWidth = 16; r.layoutHeight = 16; }
13287 |     else { r.layoutWidth = 24; r.layoutHeight = 24; }
13288 | 
13289 |     r.cityLayout.clear();
13290 |     r.cityLayout.resize(r.layoutWidth * r.layoutHeight);
13291 |     for(int y=0; y<r.layoutHeight; ++y) {
13292 |         for(int x=0; x<r.layoutWidth; ++x) {
13293 |             CityBlock& b = r.cityLayout[y * r.layoutWidth + x];
13294 |             b.x = x; b.y = y; b.type = "empty"; b.name = "Empty Lot";
13295 |         }
13296 |     }
13297 | 
13298 |     auto getBlock = [&](int x, int y) -> CityBlock& { return r.cityLayout[y * r.layoutWidth + x]; };
13299 | 
13300 |     // 2. Генерация дорожной сети (Квартальная система)
13301 |     int midX = r.layoutWidth / 2;
13302 |     int midY = r.layoutHeight / 2;
13303 |     
13304 |     for(int y=0; y<r.layoutHeight; ++y) {
13305 |         for(int x=0; x<r.layoutWidth; ++x) {
13306 |             bool isRoad = false;
13307 |             std::string roadName = "Road";
13308 | 
13309 |             auto getRoadName = [&](const std::string& defaultName) {
13310 |                 if (!g_db.city_gen_rules.road_names.empty()) return g_db.city_gen_rules.road_names[thread_safe_rand() % g_db.city_gen_rules.road_names.size()];
13311 |                 return defaultName;
13312 |             };
13313 |             auto getSquareName = [&](const std::string& defaultName) {
13314 |                 if (!g_db.city_gen_rules.square_names.empty()) return g_db.city_gen_rules.square_names[thread_safe_rand() % g_db.city_gen_rules.square_names.size()];
13315 |                 return defaultName;
13316 |             };
13317 | 
13318 |             // Главные тракты (Крест)
13319 |             if (x == midX || y == midY) { isRoad = true; roadName = getRoadName("Main Street"); }
13320 |             // Кольцевая дорога (Стены/Граница)
13321 |             else if (x == 1 || x == r.layoutWidth - 2 || y == 1 || y == r.layoutHeight - 2) { isRoad = true; roadName = getRoadName("Ring Road"); }
13322 |             // Второстепенные улицы (сетка кварталов)
13323 |             else if (x % 4 == 0 || y % 4 == 0) { isRoad = true; roadName = getRoadName("Alley"); }
13324 | 
13325 |             // Центральная площадь
13326 |             if (std::abs(x - midX) <= 1 && std::abs(y - midY) <= 1) {
13327 |                 isRoad = true; roadName = getSquareName("Central Square");
13328 |             }
13329 | 
13330 |             if (isRoad) {
13331 |                 getBlock(x, y).type = "road";
13332 |                 getBlock(x, y).name = roadName;
13333 |             }
13334 |         }
13335 |     }
13336 | 
13337 |     // 3. Зонирование (Центр, Жилые кварталы, Окраины)
13338 |     std::vector<std::pair<int,int>> centerSpots;
13339 |     std::vector<std::pair<int,int>> edgeSpots;
13340 |     std::vector<std::pair<int,int>> midSpots;
13341 | 
13342 |     for(int y=0; y<r.layoutHeight; ++y) {
13343 |         for(int x=0; x<r.layoutWidth; ++x) {
13344 |             if (getBlock(x, y).type != "empty") continue;
13345 |             
13346 |             int distToCenter = std::abs(x - midX) + std::abs(y - midY);
13347 |             if (distToCenter <= 4) centerSpots.push_back({x, y});
13348 |             else if (x <= 2 || x >= r.layoutWidth - 3 || y <= 2 || y >= r.layoutHeight - 3) edgeSpots.push_back({x, y});
13349 |             else midSpots.push_back({x, y});
13350 |         }
13351 |     }

13353 |     thread_local std::mt19937 gen_local(static_cast<unsigned int>(std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch().count()) + static_cast<unsigned int>(std::hash<std::thread::id>{}(std::this_thread::get_id())) + 2);
13354 |     std::shuffle(centerSpots.begin(), centerSpots.end(), gen_local);
13355 |     std::shuffle(edgeSpots.begin(), edgeSpots.end(), gen_local);
13356 |     std::shuffle(midSpots.begin(), midSpots.end(), gen_local);
13357 | 
13358 |     int counter = 1;
13359 |     auto placeBuilding = [&](const std::string& type, const std::string& name, const std::string& linked_id, std::vector<std::pair<int,int>>& prefZone, std::vector<std::pair<int,int>>& altZone) {
13360 |         std::pair<int,int> spot = {-1, -1};
13361 |         if (!prefZone.empty()) { spot = prefZone.back(); prefZone.pop_back(); }
13362 |         else if (!altZone.empty()) { spot = altZone.back(); altZone.pop_back(); }
13363 |         
13364 |         if (spot.first != -1) {
13365 |             auto& b = getBlock(spot.first, spot.second);
13366 |             b.type = type;
13367 |             b.name = name;

13370 | 
13371 |             JsonValue subLoc = JsonValue::object();
13372 |             subLoc.set("id", b.sublocation_id);
13373 |             subLoc.set("name", b.name);
13374 |             subLoc.set("parentId", r.id);
13375 |             subLoc.set("type", b.type);
13376 |             
13377 |             std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_sublocations_mutex);
13378 |             w.subLocations[b.sublocation_id] = subLoc;
13379 |         }
13380 |     };
13381 | 
13382 |     auto getFacName = [&](const std::string& type, const std::string& defaultName) -> std::string {
13383 |         if (g_db.city_gen_rules.facility_names.count(type) && !g_db.city_gen_rules.facility_names[type].empty()) {

13389 | 
13390 |     // 4. Экономический ребаланс и расстановка (Data-Driven)
13391 |     int merchantCount = 0;
13392 |     for (const auto& [nId, npc] : w.npcs) {
13393 |         if (npc.homeLocation == r.id && npc.economy.profession_type == "merchant" && !npc.economy.workplaceId.empty()) {
13394 |             merchantCount++;

13401 |

13429 | 
13430 | double scoreItemCandidate(const std::string& itemId,
13431 |                           const std::string& requiredTag,
13432 |                           const std::vector<std::string>& preferredIds = {},
13433 |                           const std::vector<std::string>& preferredTags = {},
13434 |                           const std::string& priorityProperty = "") {
13435 |     if (!requiredTag.empty() && !itemHasTag(itemId, requiredTag)) return -1e9;
13436 | 
13437 |     double score = 0.0;
13438 |     for (size_t i = 0; i < preferredIds.size(); ++i) {
13439 |         if (preferredIds[i] == itemId) {
13440 |             score += 500.0 - static_cast<double>(i * 20);
13441 |             break;
13442 |         }
13443 |     }
13444 |     for (size_t i = 0; i < preferredTags.size(); ++i) {
13445 |         if (itemHasTag(itemId, preferredTags[i])) {
13446 |             score += 120.0 - static_cast<double>(i * 10);
13447 |         }
13448 |     }
13449 |     if (!priorityProperty.empty()) {
13450 |         score += getItemNumericProperty(itemId, priorityProperty, 0.0) * 10.0;
13451 |     }
13452 |     if (requiredTag == "food") {
13453 |         score += getFoodPriority(itemId, priorityProperty.empty() ? "reserve_priority" : priorityProperty);
13454 |     }
13455 | 
13456 |     const auto itemIt = g_db.items.find(itemId);
13457 |     if (itemIt != g_db.items.end()) {
13458 |         score -= static_cast<double>(itemIt->second.basePrice) * 0.05;
13459 |     }
13460 | 
13461 |     return score;
13462 | }
13463 | 
13464 | std::string chooseBestItemCandidate(const std::vector<std::string>& candidates,
13465 |                                     const std::string& requiredTag,
13466 |                                     const std::vector<std::string>& preferredIds = {},
13467 |                                     const std::vector<std::string>& preferredTags = {},
13468 |                                     const std::string& priorityProperty = "") {
13469 |     std::string bestId;
13470 |     double bestScore = -1e9;
13471 | 
13472 |     for (const auto& itemId : candidates) {
13473 |         double score = scoreItemCandidate(itemId, requiredTag, preferredIds, preferredTags, priorityProperty);
13474 |         if (score > bestScore || (std::abs(score - bestScore) < 0.001 && itemId < bestId)) {
13475 |             bestScore = score;
13476 |             bestId = itemId;
13477 |         }
13478 |     }
13479 | 
13480 |     return bestScore <= -1e8 ? "" : bestId;
13481 | }

13485 |                                         const std::vector<std::string>& preferredTags = {},

13489 |     for (const auto& itemId : g_db.all_item_ids) {

13532 | 
13533 | void addFacilityOutputsToResourceSet(std::set<std::string>& resources,
13534 |                                      const std::string& facilityId,
13535 |                                      int minOutputs,
13536 |                                      int maxOutputs,
13537 |                                      const std::vector<std::string>& preferredIds = {}) {
13538 |     const FacilityTemplate* tpl = g_facilityRegistry.getTemplate(facilityId);
13539 |     if (!tpl) return;
13540 | 
13541 |     std::vector<std::string> outputs = getFacilityOutputIds(*tpl);
13542 |     if (outputs.empty()) return;
13543 | 
13544 |     std::stable_sort(outputs.begin(), outputs.end(), [&](const std::string& left, const std::string& right) {
13545 |         auto leftIt = std::find(preferredIds.begin(), preferredIds.end(), left);
13546 |         auto rightIt = std::find(preferredIds.begin(), preferredIds.end(), right);
13547 |         const bool leftPreferred = leftIt != preferredIds.end();
13548 |         const bool rightPreferred = rightIt != preferredIds.end();
13549 |         if (leftPreferred != rightPreferred) return leftPreferred;
13550 |         if (leftPreferred && rightPreferred) return leftIt < rightIt;
13551 |         return left < right;
13552 |     });
13553 | 
13554 |     int desiredCount = minOutputs;
13555 |     if (maxOutputs > minOutputs) desiredCount += thread_safe_rand() % (maxOutputs - minOutputs + 1);
13556 |     desiredCount = std::min(desiredCount, static_cast<int>(outputs.size()));
13557 | 
13558 |     for (int i = 0; i < desiredCount; ++i) {
13559 |         resources.insert(outputs[i]);
13560 |     }
13561 | }

13641 | 
13642 | int calculateInitialFacilityLevel(const Region& region, const std::string& ownerRace, const FacilityTemplate& tpl) {
13643 |     int level = 0;
13644 | 
13645 |     if (tpl.hasTag("extractor")) {
13646 |         int matchedOutputs = 0;
13647 |         for (const auto& [itemId, rate] : tpl.extraction_rates) {
13648 |             if (region.available_raw_resources.count(itemId)) matchedOutputs++;
13649 |         }
13650 |         if (matchedOutputs <= 0) return 0;
13651 | 
13652 |         level = 1 + (thread_safe_rand() % (matchedOutputs + 2));
13653 |         if (tpl.hasTag("food")) level += 1;
13654 |     } else if (tpl.hasTag("processor")) {
13655 |         int matchedRecipes = 0;
13656 |         for (const auto& recipe : g_db.recipes) {
13657 |             if (recipe.facility == tpl.id && recipeUsesRegionResources(recipe, region)) matchedRecipes++;
13658 |         }
13659 |         if (matchedRecipes <= 0) return 0;
13660 |         level = 1 + (thread_safe_rand() % std::min(4, matchedRecipes + 1));
13661 |     } else if (tpl.hasTag("service")) {
13662 |         level = (region.population >= 1000) ? (thread_safe_rand() % 3) : (thread_safe_rand() % 2);
13663 |     } else if (tpl.hasTag("storage")) {
13664 |         level = 1;
13665 |     }
13666 | 
13667 |     if (level <= 0) return 0;
13668 | 
13669 |     double regionalMultiplier = 1.0;
13670 |     if (tpl.resource_multiplier_type == "fertility") regionalMultiplier += std::max(0.0, region.fertility - 1.0);
13671 |     if (tpl.resource_multiplier_type == "mineral") regionalMultiplier += std::max(0.0, region.mineral_wealth - 1.0);
13672 | 
13673 |     double raceMultiplier = 1.0;
13674 |     auto raceIt = tpl.race_modifiers.find(ownerRace);
13675 |     if (raceIt != tpl.race_modifiers.end()) raceMultiplier = std::max(0.0, raceIt->second);
13676 | 
13677 |     level = std::max(0, static_cast<int>(std::round(level * regionalMultiplier * raceMultiplier)));
13678 |     return std::min(level, 20);
13679 | }

14450 | void bootstrapWorld(int days, int targetStartDay) {
14451 |     g_bootstrap = true;
14452 |     g_world.current_day = targetStartDay - days;
14453 |     if (g_world.current_day < 0) g_world.current_day = 0;
14454 |     
14455 |     // 1. Initial resources
14456 |     for (auto& [rid, r] : g_world.regions) {
14457 |         addBootstrapStarterResources(r);
14458 |     }
14459 | 
14460 |     // 2. Initial caravans
14461 |     std::vector<std::string> capitals;
14462 |     for (const auto& [fid, f] : g_world.factions) {
14463 |         if (!f.regions.empty()) capitals.push_back(f.regions[0]);
14464 |     }
14465 |     if (capitals.size() >= 2) {
14466 |         for (size_t i = 0; i < capitals.size(); ++i) {
14467 |             std::string origin = capitals[i];
14468 |             std::string dest = capitals[(i + 1) % capitals.size()];
14469 |             
14470 |             std::vector<std::pair<int,int>> caravan_path;
14471 |             if (g_path_cache.count({origin, dest})) caravan_path = g_path_cache[{origin, dest}];
14472 |             if (caravan_path.empty()) continue;
14473 | 
14474 |             std::string chestId = createContainer("caravan_chest", "bootstrap", 999999, 1000, origin);
14475 |             int num_goods = 2 + thread_safe_rand() % 3;
14476 |             for (int g = 0; g < num_goods; ++g) {
14477 |                 if (g_db.all_item_ids.empty()) break;
14478 |                 std::string gt = g_db.all_item_ids[thread_safe_rand() % g_db.all_item_ids.size()];
14479 |                 if (g_db.items[gt].category == "document") { g--; continue; }
14480 |                 createItem(gt, 20 + thread_safe_rand() % 51, chestId, 0, "Bootstrap Caravan");
14481 |             }
14482 |             
14483 |             Caravan c;
14484 |             c.id = "caravan_" + generateUUID();
14485 |             c.origin = origin;
14486 |             c.destination = dest;
14487 |             c.chest_id = chestId;
14488 |             c.wagons = 2;
14489 |             c.guards = 5;
14490 |             c.hoursLeft = 24 + thread_safe_rand() % 49;
14491 |             if (g_path_cache.count({origin, dest})) {
14492 |                 c.path = g_path_cache[{origin, dest}];
14493 |                 if (!c.path.empty()) { c.x = c.path[0].first; c.y = c.path[0].second; }
14494 |             }
14495 |             g_world.regions[origin].caravans.push_back(c);
14496 |         }
14497 |     }
14498 | 
14499 |     // 3. Simulate
14500 |     int ticks = days * 24;
14501 |     for (int i = 0; i < ticks; i++) {
14502 |         hourlyTick();
14503 |         g_world.tick++;
14504 |     }
14505 | 
14506 |     // 4. Cleanup
14507 |     g_world.news.clear();
14508 |     g_world.needsGlobalEvent = false;
14509 |     g_world.lastDirectInjectionDay = -999;
14510 |     g_world.tick = 0;

14512 |     g_world.time.accumulatedMinutes = 0;
14513 |     g_world.time.internalHour = 0;
14514 |     updateWeather();
14515 |     g_bootstrap = false;
14516 | }

14519 | // Simulate N ticks
14520 | void reportProgress(int currentTick, const std::string& lastNews,
14521 |                     const JsonValue& dirtyItems,
14522 |                     const JsonValue& dirtyContainers,
14523 |                     const JsonValue& deletedItems,
14524 |                     const JsonValue& deletedContainers)
14525 | {
14526 |     JsonValue res = JsonValue::object();
14527 |     res.set("status", "progress");
14528 | 
14529 |     int totalDays = currentTick / 24;
14530 |     int years = totalDays / 360;
14531 |     int months = (totalDays % 360) / 30 + 1;
14532 | 
14533 |     std::string msg = "Симуляция истории: Год " + std::to_string(years + 1)
14534 |                     + ", Месяц " + std::to_string(months);
14535 |     if (!lastNews.empty()) {
14536 |         msg += " | Последнее событие: " + lastNews;
14537 |     }
14538 |     res.set("message", msg);
14539 | 
14540 |     // Отправляем ТОЛЬКО изменившиеся данные
14541 |     if (!dirtyItems.arr_val.empty())
14542 |         res.set("items", dirtyItems);
14543 |     if (!dirtyContainers.arr_val.empty())
14544 |         res.set("containers", dirtyContainers);
14545 |     if (!deletedItems.arr_val.empty())
14546 |         res.set("deleted_items", deletedItems);
14547 |     if (!deletedContainers.arr_val.empty())
14548 |         res.set("deleted_containers", deletedContainers);
14549 | 
14550 |     std::cout << res.toString() << std::endl;
14551 |     std::cout.flush();
14552 | 
14553 |     // Очищаем списки удалённых, чтобы не дублировать их в следующих репортах
14554 |     g_deleted_items.clear();
14555 |     g_deleted_containers.clear();
14556 | }
14557 | 
14558 | void simulateTicks(int ticks) {
14559 |     for (int i = 0; i < ticks; i++) {
14560 |         hourlyTick();                 // внутри: dailyTick и weeklyTick вызываются автоматически
14561 |         g_world.tick++;
14562 | 
14563 |         // Отправляем прогресс каждый день (24 тика), чтобы интерфейс не зависал
14564 |         if (g_world.tick > 0 && g_world.tick % 24 == 0) {
14565 |             std::string lastNewsText = "";
14566 |             if (!g_world.news.empty()) {
14567 |                 lastNewsText = g_world.news.back().text;
14568 |             }
14569 | 
14570 |                                // Мы больше не очищаем is_dirty флаги здесь, иначе JS клиент никогда не узнает
14571 |                    // о созданных предметах (например, на складах бизнеса) по завершении симуляции.
14572 |                    // Флаги накопятся и будут отправлены единым пакетом в конце команды.
14573 |                    JsonValue emptyArr = JsonValue::array();
14574 |                    reportProgress(g_world.tick, lastNewsText, emptyArr, emptyArr, emptyArr, emptyArr);
14575 |         }
14576 |     }
14577 | }

14579 | // ============================================================================
14580 | // REAL-TIME SIMULATION & PROTOCOL HANDLER
14581 | // ============================================================================
14582 | 
14583 | std::atomic<bool> g_realtime_active{false};
14584 | std::atomic<int> g_realtime_interval{500};
14585 | std::mutex g_main_mutex;
14586 | std::thread* g_realtime_thread = nullptr;
14587 | 
14588 | void serializeRegistriesGlobal(JsonValue& response, bool full = false) {
14589 |     std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_registry_mutex);
14590 |     JsonValue itemsArr = JsonValue::array();
14591 |     for (size_t i=0; i<g_items.data.size(); ++i) {
14592 |         if (!g_items.active[i]) continue;
14593 |         if (full || g_items.data[i].is_dirty) {
14594 |             JsonValue pair = JsonValue::array();
14595 |             pair.push(JsonValue(g_items.data[i].id));
14596 |             pair.push(g_items.data[i].toJson());
14597 |             itemsArr.push(pair);
14598 |             g_items.data[i].is_dirty = false;
14599 |         }
14600 |     }
14601 |     response.set("items", itemsArr);
14602 |     
14603 |     JsonValue contArr = JsonValue::array();
14604 |     for (size_t i=0; i<g_containers.data.size(); ++i) {
14605 |         if (!g_containers.active[i]) continue;
14606 |         if (full || g_containers.data[i].is_dirty) {
14607 |             JsonValue pair = JsonValue::array();
14608 |             pair.push(JsonValue(g_containers.data[i].id));
14609 |             pair.push(g_containers.data[i].toJson());
14610 |             contArr.push(pair);
14611 |             g_containers.data[i].is_dirty = false;
14612 |         }
14613 |     }
14614 |     response.set("containers", contArr);
14615 | 
14616 |     if (!full) {
14617 |         JsonValue delItems = JsonValue::array();
14618 |         for (const auto& id : g_deleted_items) delItems.push(JsonValue(id));
14619 |         response.set("deleted_items", delItems);
14620 |         
14621 |         JsonValue delConts = JsonValue::array();
14622 |         for (const auto& id : g_deleted_containers) delConts.push(JsonValue(id));
14623 |         response.set("deleted_containers", delConts);
14624 |     }
14625 |     
14626 |     g_deleted_items.clear();
14627 |     g_deleted_containers.clear();
14628 | }
14629 | 
14630 | void realtimeLoop() {
14631 |     while (g_realtime_active) {
14632 |         {
14633 |             std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_main_mutex);
14634 |             if (!g_realtime_active) break;
14635 |             
14636 |             for (int i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
14637 |                 hourlyTick();
14638 |                 g_world.tick++;
14639 |             }
14640 |             
14641 |             JsonValue response = JsonValue::object();
14642 |             response.set("status", "realtime_update");
14643 |             response.set("tick", g_world.tick);
14644 |             response.set("current_day", g_world.current_day);
14645 |             
14646 |             // Send lightweight status info every tick
14647 |             JsonValue t = JsonValue::object();
14648 |             t.set("accumulatedMinutes", g_world.time.accumulatedMinutes);
14649 |             t.set("internalHour", g_world.time.internalHour);
14650 |             response.set("time", t);
14651 | 
14652 |             JsonValue h = JsonValue::object();
14653 |             h.set("warWeariness", g_world.homeostasis.warWeariness);
14654 |             h.set("fertility", g_world.homeostasis.fertility);
14655 |             h.set("peaceBoredom", g_world.homeostasis.peaceBoredom);
14656 |             response.set("homeostasis", h);
14657 |             
14658 |             JsonValue eventsArr = JsonValue::array();
14659 |             for (const auto& ev : g_world.player_trek.pending_events) {
14660 |                 eventsArr.push(ev.toJson());
14661 |             }
14662 |             g_world.player_trek.pending_events.clear();
14663 |             response.set("trek_events", eventsArr);
14664 | 
14665 |             // FIX: Do NOT serialize entire world every 500ms — that was causing
14666 |             // massive CPU spikes and blocking g_main_mutex for seconds.
14667 |             // Instead, only send dirty items/containers (delta update).
14668 |             // JS client can request full world via getFullState when needed.
14669 |             serializeRegistriesGlobal(response, false);
14670 |             
14671 |             {
14672 |                 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> outLock(g_output_mutex);
14673 |                 std::cout << response.toString() << std::endl;
14674 |                 std::cout.flush();
14675 |             }
14676 |         }
14677 |         std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(g_realtime_interval.load()));
14678 |     }
14679 | }
14680 | 
14681 | int main() {
14682 | #ifdef _WIN32

14685 | #endif

  12 |  * 1. Engine loads DLL/SO via dlopen/LoadLibrary
  13 |  * 2. Engine calls MeteraPlugin_GetAPI() → plugin receives function table
  14 |  * 3. Engine calls MeteraPlugin_Init(plugin_id) → plugin registers callbacks
  15 |  * 4. Engine calls MeteraPlugin_OnLoad() → plugin performs one-time setup
  16 |  * 5. During simulation, engine fires registered callbacks
  17 |  * 6. On shutdown, engine calls MeteraPlugin_Shutdown()
  18 |  *
  19 |  * === CALLBACK MODEL ===
  20 |  *
  21 |  * Callbacks are "Deferred Response" — they run AFTER the current tick.
  22 |  * If a mod needs to change simulation state, changes apply on the NEXT tick.
  23 |  * This prevents blocking the simulation loop.
  24 |  *
  25 |  * Visual/audio callbacks are "Fire and Forget" — no return value expected.
  26 |  */
  27 |

  29 |

--- engine/raw_test.cpp (C++, 90 lines, ~685 tokens) ---
   1 | #include <iostream>
   2 | #include <sstream>
   3 | #include <string>
   4 | 
   5 | class JsonWriter {
   6 | private:
   7 |     std::ostringstream ss;
   8 |     int indent_level = 0;
   9 |     
  10 |     void write_indent() {
  11 |         for (int i = 0; i < indent_level; i++) ss << "  ";
  12 |     }
  13 |     
  14 | public:
  15 |     void startObject() { ss << "{"; indent_level++; }
  16 |     void endObject() { indent_level--; ss << "}"; }
  17 |     
  18 |     void key(const std::string& k) {
  19 |         if (indent_level > 0) write_indent();
  20 |         ss << "\"" << k << "\": ";
  21 |     }
  22 |     
  23 |     void value(const std::string& v) {
  24 |         ss << "\"" << v << "\"";
  25 |     }
  26 |     
  27 |     void comma() { ss << ","; }
  28 |     
  29 |     std::string str() const { return ss.str(); }
  30 | };
  31 | 
  32 | std::string extractJsonString(const std::string& json, const std::string& key) {
  33 |     std::string search = "\"" + key + "\":";
  34 |     size_t pos = json.find(search);
  35 |     if (pos == std::string::npos) return "";
  36 |     
  37 |     pos += search.length();
  38 |     while (pos < json.length() && (json[pos] == ' ' || json[pos] == '\t' || json[pos] == '\n')) pos++;
  39 |     
  40 |     if (pos >= json.length()) return "";
  41 |     
  42 |     if (json[pos] != '"') {
  43 |         size_t end = pos;
  44 |         while (end < json.length() && json[end] != ',' && json[end] != '}' && json[end] != ']' && json[end] != ' ') {
  45 |             end++;
  46 |         }
  47 |         return json.substr(pos, end - pos);
  48 |     }
  49 |     
  50 |     pos++;
  51 |     std::string result;
  52 |     while (pos < json.length()) {
  53 |         if (json[pos] == '\\' && pos + 1 < json.length()) {
  54 |             pos++;
  55 |             switch (json[pos]) {
  56 |                 case '"': result += '"'; break;
  57 |                 case '\\': result += '\\'; break;
  58 |                 default: result += json[pos]; break;
  59 |             }
  60 |             pos++;
  61 |         } else if (json[pos] == '"') {
  62 |             break;
  63 |         } else {
  64 |             result += json[pos++];
  65 |         }
  66 |     }
  67 |     
  68 |     return result;
  69 | }
  70 | 
  71 | int main() {
  72 |     // Тест записи
  73 |     JsonWriter w;
  74 |     w.startObject();
  75 |     w.key("status"); w.value("ok");
  76 |     w.comma();
  77 |     w.key("message"); w.value("Engine initialized");
  78 |     w.endObject();
  79 |     std::string output = w.str();
  80 |     std::cout << "OUTPUT: " << output << std::endl;
  81 |     
  82 |     // Тест чтения
  83 |     std::string status = extractJsonString(output, "status");
  84 |     std::string message = extractJsonString(output, "message");
  85 |     std::cout << "status='" << status << "'" << std::endl;
  86 |     std::cout << "message='" << message << "'" << std::endl;
  87 |     
  88 |     return 0;
  89 | }

 199 |     def start_generation(self):
 200 |         if not self.engine.is_running:
 201 |             if not self.engine.start():
 202 |                 return
 203 |             self.engine.send({"command": "init"})
 204 | 
 205 |         self.status_lbl.configure(text="Загрузка базы данных...", text_color="#f1c40f")
 206 |         self.progress_bar.configure(mode="indeterminate")
 207 |         self.progress_bar.start()
 208 |         self.btn_init.configure(state="disabled")
 209 | 
 210 |         base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
 211 |         data_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(base_dir), 'data')
 212 |         database = build_runtime_database(data_dir)
 213 |         database["command"] = "loadDatabase"
 214 | 
 215 |         # Send loadDatabase command and wait for acknowledgment before buildWorld
 216 |         self.engine.send(database)
 217 | 
 218 |         # Sync biome colors from biomes.json for map rendering
 219 |         biomes_data = database.get("biomes", [])
 220 |         if isinstance(biomes_data, list) and biomes_data:
 221 |             self._biome_colors = {}
 222 |             for b in sorted(biomes_data, key=lambda x: x.get("numeric_id", 0)):
 223 |                 nid = b.get("numeric_id", 0)
 224 |                 hex_color = b.get("color_hex", "#000000")
 225 |                 hex_color = hex_color.lstrip('#')
 226 |                 if len(hex_color) == 6:
 227 |                     rgb = tuple(int(hex_color[i:i+2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
 228 |                     self._biome_colors[nid] = rgb
 229 |             print(f"[BIOME COLORS] Synced {len(self._biome_colors)} colors from biomes.json")
 230 | 
 231 |         self._pending_db = database  # Store for ack-based flow
 232 |         self._waiting_for_db_ack = True
 233 |         # buildWorld will be sent in handle_result after loadDatabase ack
 234 | 
 235 |     def _send_build_world(self):
 236 |         """Send buildWorld command AFTER loadDatabase acknowledgment.
 237 |         Loads era-specific global_locations so the world is not empty.
 238 |         """
 239 |         era = self.era_var.get()
 240 | 
 241 |         data_dir = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'data')
 242 |         runtime_manifest = self._pending_db.get("runtime_manifest", {}) if hasattr(self, "_pending_db") else {}
 243 |         location_info = resolve_era_location_file(
 244 |             self._pending_db.get("eras", []) if hasattr(self, "_pending_db") else [],
 245 |             era,
 246 |             runtime_manifest.get("era_location_fallback_file", "locations_rebirth.json")
 247 |         )
 248 |         if location_info.get("warning"):
 249 |             print(location_info["warning"])
 250 |         loc_path = os.path.join(data_dir, location_info["file_name"])
 251 |         global_locations = self._load_json(loc_path, {})
 252 |         loc_count = len(global_locations) if isinstance(global_locations, dict) else 0
 253 |         print(f"[LOCATIONS] era={era} file={location_info['file_name']} count={loc_count}")
 254 |         if loc_count == 0:
 255 |             print(f"[WARN] No locations loaded! World will be empty.")
 256 | 
 257 |         self.pending_bootstrap = True
 258 |         self.engine.send({
 259 |             "command": "buildWorld",
 260 |             "player_id": "sim_admin",
 261 |             "era": era,
 262 |             "initial_agents": self.agents_var.get(),
 263 |             "global_locations": global_locations
 264 |         })

 315 |         self.engine.send({
 316 |             "command": "gmModifyTerrain",
 317 |             "args": {
 318 |                 "regionId": target,
 319 |                 "radius": 10,
 320 |                 "newType": 9 # RUINS
 321 |             }
 322 |         })

 355 |     def handle_progress(self, msg):
 356 |         self.after(0, lambda: self.status_lbl.configure(text=msg))

 358 |     def handle_result(self, data):
 359 |         def update_ui():
 360 |             self.progress_bar.stop()
 361 |             self.progress_bar.set(1)
 362 | 
 363 |             # Ack-based flow: after loadDatabase succeeds, send buildWorld
 364 |             if getattr(self, '_waiting_for_db_ack', False):
 365 |                 if data.get("status") == "ok" and "world" not in data:
 366 |                     self._waiting_for_db_ack = False
 367 |                     self.status_lbl.configure(text="База загружена. Генерация мира...", text_color="#3498db")
 368 |                     self.after(100, self._send_build_world)
 369 |                     return
 370 |                 # If we got world data, loadDatabase was already processed inline
 371 |                 self._waiting_for_db_ack = False
 372 | 
 373 |             # Если пришла только карта (от getWorldMap)
 374 |             if "map" in data and "world" not in data:
 375 |                 if self.world_data is None:
 376 |                     self.world_data = {}
 377 |                 self.world_data["map"] = data["map"]
 378 |                 if self.current_filter == "map":
 379 |                     self.render_map()
 380 |                 return
 381 | 
 382 |             if data.get("status") == "realtime_update":
 383 |                 self.world_data = data.get("world", self.world_data)
 384 |                 self.status_lbl.configure(text=f"Реал-тайм: Тик {self.world_data.get('tick', 0)}", text_color="#8e44ad")
 385 |                 if self.current_filter == "map":
 386 |                     self.render_map()
 387 |                 else:
 388 |                     self.render_content()
 389 |                 return
 390 | 
 391 |             if "world" in data:
 392 |                 self.world_data = data["world"]
 393 |                 
 394 |                 if not hasattr(self, 'containers_data'): self.containers_data = {}
 395 |                 if not hasattr(self, 'items_data'): self.items_data = {}
 396 |                 for c in data.get("containers", []): self.containers_data[c[0]] = c[1]
 397 |                 for i in data.get("items", []): self.items_data[i[0]] = i[1]
 398 |                 for c_id in data.get("deleted_containers", []): self.containers_data.pop(c_id, None)
 399 |                 for i_id in data.get("deleted_items", []): self.items_data.pop(i_id, None)
 400 |                 
 401 |                 if getattr(self, 'pending_bootstrap', False):
 402 |                     self.pending_bootstrap = False
 403 |                     self.status_lbl.configure(text="Экономическая балансировка...", text_color="#f39c12")
 404 |                     total_pop = sum(r.get("population", 0) for r in self.world_data.get("regions", {}).values())
 405 |                     days = max(30, 30 + total_pop // 10000)
 406 |                     self.engine.send({"command": "bootstrapWorld", "days": days})
 407 |                     return # Ждем ответа от bootstrapWorld
 408 |                     
 409 |                 self.status_lbl.configure(text=f"Готово! Тик: {self.world_data.get('tick', 0)}", text_color="#2ecc71")
 410 |                 self.btn_sim.configure(state="normal")
 411 |                 self.btn_init.configure(state="normal")
 412 | 
 413 |                 if hasattr(self, 'btn_realtime'):
 414 |                     self.btn_realtime.configure(state="normal")
 415 |                 if hasattr(self, 'btn_realtime'):
 416 |                     self.btn_realtime.configure(state="normal")
 417 |                 if self.current_filter == "map":
 418 |                     self.render_map()
 419 |                 else:
 420 |                     self.render_content()
 421 |             elif data.get("message") == "Engine initialized":
 422 |                 self.status_lbl.configure(text="Движок инициализирован", text_color="#2ecc71")
 423 |                 
 424 |         self.after(0, update_ui)
 425 | 
 426 |     def handle_error(self, msg):
 427 |         self.after(0, lambda: messagebox.showerror("Ошибка Движка", msg))
 428 |         self.after(0, self.stop_engine)

 430 |     def render_map(self):
 431 |         if not self.world_data or "map" not in self.world_data:
 432 |             self.request_map()
 433 |             return
 434 |             
 435 |         map_data = self.world_data["map"]
 436 |         w = map_data.get("width", 256)
 437 |         h = map_data.get("height", 256)
 438 |         
 439 |         grid = map_data.get("grid", [])
 440 |         tiles = [cell[0] for cell in grid] if grid else map_data.get("tiles", [])
 441 |         
 442 |         roads = map_data.get("roads", [])
 443 |         locations = map_data.get("locations", {})
 444 |         disasters = map_data.get("disasters", [])
 445 | 
 446 |         if not tiles:
 447 |             return
 448 | 
 449 |         # Цвета тайлов: prefer synced from biomes.json, fallback to hardcoded
 450 |         COLORS = getattr(self, '_biome_colors', None)
 451 |         if not COLORS:
 452 |             COLORS = {
 453 |                 0: (26, 59, 92),    # OCEAN
 454 |             1: (41, 128, 185),  # SHALLOW_WATER
 455 |             2: (46, 204, 113),  # PLAINS
 456 |             3: (39, 174, 96),   # FOREST
 457 |             4: (127, 140, 141), # MOUNTAINS
 458 |             5: (243, 156, 18),  # HILLS
 459 |             6: (230, 126, 34),  # DESERT
 460 |             7: (142, 68, 173),  # SWAMP
 461 |             8: (236, 240, 241), # TUNDRA
 462 |             9: (52, 73, 94),    # RUINS
 463 |             10: (155, 89, 182), # ANOMALY
 464 |             11: (52, 152, 219), # RIVER
 465 |             12: (192, 57, 43),  # VOLCANO
 466 |             13: (60, 176, 67),  # RIVERBANK (Изумрудный)
 467 |             14: (31, 97, 141),  # LAKE (Глубокий синий)
 468 |             15: (88, 214, 141), # FLOODPLAIN (Светло-зеленый)
 469 |             16: (211, 84, 0),   # LAVA
 470 |             17: (85, 85, 85)    # ASH
 471 |             }
 472 | 
 473 |         # Создаем базовое изображение
 474 |         img = Image.new('RGB', (w, h))
 475 |         pixel_data = [COLORS.get(t, (0,0,0)) for t in tiles]
 476 |         img.putdata(pixel_data)
