   29 | // --- SEEDED PRNG (deterministic rolls for game mechanics) ---
   30 | // ======================================================================
   31 | const GameRNG = {
   32 |     _seed: Date.now(),
   33 |     /**
   34 |      * Seed the RNG. Call once at game start or on load.
   35 |      * @param {number} seed
   36 |      */
   37 |     seed(seed) { this._seed = seed >>> 0; },
   38 |     /**
   39 |      * Mulberry32 вЂ” fast 32-bit PRNG. Returns [0, 1).
   40 |      * Deterministic given the same seed sequence.
   41 |      */
   42 |     next() {
   43 |         let t = this._seed += 0x6D2B79F5;
   44 |         t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
   45 |         t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
   46 |         return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
   47 |     },
   48 |     /** Returns integer in [min, max] inclusive (like a d20 roll). */
   49 |     roll(min, max) {
   50 |         return Math.floor(this.next() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
   51 |     },
   52 |     /** d20 + modifier roll, used for lockpicking, skill checks etc. */
   53 |     d20(modifier = 0) {
   54 |         return this.roll(1, 20) + modifier;
   55 |     }
   56 | };

   62 | function normalizeContainerLocation(locationData = null) {
   63 |     if (typeof locationData === 'string') {
   64 |         return { world_coords: null, parent_entity: null, parent_container: null, region_id: locationData };
   65 |     }
   66 |     return {
   67 |         world_coords: Array.isArray(locationData?.world_coords) ? [...locationData.world_coords] : null,
   68 |         parent_entity: locationData?.parent_entity || null,
   69 |         parent_container: locationData?.parent_container || null,
   70 |         region_id: locationData?.region_id ?? null
   71 |     };
   72 | }

   74 | function resolveActorLocation(actorId) {
   75 |     if (!actorId) return null;
   76 |     if (actorId === getInventoryActorId('default') && player) {
   77 |         return normalizeContainerLocation({ world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: 'player', parent_container: null, region_id: player.location || null });
   78 |     }
   79 |     if (ContainerRegistry.has(actorId)) {
   80 |         return resolveContainerLocation(actorId);
   81 |     }
   82 |     const npc = World?.npcs?.[actorId];
   83 |     if (npc) {
   84 |         return normalizeContainerLocation({ world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: actorId, parent_container: null, region_id: npc.currentLocation || npc.homeLocation || null });
   85 |     }
   86 |     return null;
   87 | }
   88 | 
   89 | function resolveContainerLocation(containerId) {
   90 |     const resolvedId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
   91 |     if (!resolvedId) return null;
   92 |     const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedId);
   93 |     if (!cont) return null;
   94 | 
   95 |     const location = normalizeContainerLocation(cont.location);
   96 |     if (cont.type === 'magical_pocket') { return normalizeContainerLocation({ world_coords: null, parent_entity: cont.owner_id || null, parent_container: null, region_id: getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.system_regions.magical_pocket }); }
   97 | 
   98 |     if (location.parent_entity === 'player' || (cont.owner_id === 'player' && (cont.type === 'player_backpack' || cont.type === 'player_equipment'))) {
   99 |         location.parent_entity = 'player';
  100 |         location.region_id = player?.location || location.region_id;
  101 |     }
  102 | 
  103 |     const parentNpc = location.parent_entity ? World?.npcs?.[location.parent_entity] : null;
  104 |     if (parentNpc) {
  105 |         location.region_id = parentNpc.currentLocation || parentNpc.homeLocation || location.region_id;
  106 |     }
  107 | 
  108 |     return location;
  109 | }

  136 | function getRuntimeDataRegistry(name) {
  137 |     const sources = [
  138 |         window.RuntimeData,
  139 |         window.runtimeData,
  140 |         window.RuntimeDatabase,
  141 |         window.GameData,
  142 |         window.__RUNTIME_DATA__
  143 |     ].filter(Boolean);
  144 | 
  145 |     for (const source of sources) {
  146 |         if (source[name]) return source[name];
  147 |         if (source.data && source.data[name]) return source.data[name];
  148 |         if (typeof source.get === 'function') {
  149 |             const value = source.get(name);
  150 |             if (value) return value;
  151 |         }
  152 |     }
  153 |     return null;
  154 | }

  156 | async function loadSystemContainerRegistry() {
  157 |     if (_systemContainerRegistry) return _systemContainerRegistry;
  158 |     if (_systemContainerRegistryPromise) return _systemContainerRegistryPromise;
  159 | 
  160 |     _systemContainerRegistryPromise = (async () => {
  161 |         const fromRuntime = getRuntimeDataRegistry('system_containers');
  162 |         if (fromRuntime) {
  163 |             _systemContainerRegistry = fromRuntime;
  164 |             return _systemContainerRegistry;
  165 |         }
  166 | 
  167 |         if (typeof fetch === 'function') {
  168 |             try {
  169 |                 const response = await fetch(SYSTEM_CONTAINER_REGISTRY_PATH);
  170 |                 if (response.ok) {
  171 |                     _systemContainerRegistry = await response.json();
  172 |                     return _systemContainerRegistry;
  173 |                 }
  174 |             } catch (error) {
  175 |                 console.warn('[DataArch] РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РёС‚СЊ data/system_containers.json:', error.message);
  176 |             }
  177 |         }
  178 | 
  179 |         _systemContainerRegistry = { aliases: {}, containers: {} };
  180 |         return _systemContainerRegistry;
  181 |     })();
  182 | 
  183 |     return _systemContainerRegistryPromise;
  184 | }

  205 |     if (key === 'player_equipment') return player?.container_equipment || null;

  257 | function resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId) {
  258 |     if (!containerId) return containerId;
  259 | 
  260 |     const resolvedInstanceId = getSystemContainerInstanceId(containerId);
  261 |     if (resolvedInstanceId) return resolvedInstanceId;
  262 | 
  263 |     const resolvedKey = resolveSystemContainerKey(containerId);
  264 |     if (resolvedKey !== containerId) {
  265 |         console.warn(`[resolveSpecialContainerId] system container '${containerId}' not found. Ensure it explicitly before resolving.`);
  266 |         return null;
  267 |     }
  268 | 
  269 |     return containerId;
  270 | }

  308 | function countRealItems(containerId, prototypeId) {
  309 |     const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
  310 |     if (!cont || !cont.items) return 0;
  311 |     return cont.items.reduce((sum, itemId) => {
  312 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  313 |         return (item && item.prototype_id === prototypeId) ? sum + item.stack_size : sum;
  314 |     }, 0);

  330 | function availableManpower(faction) {
  331 |     if (!faction || typeof World === 'undefined' || !World) return 0;
  332 |     let total = 0;
  333 |     for (let rid of faction.regions || []) {
  334 |         const region = World.regions[rid];
  335 |         if (!region || !region.vault_id) continue;
  336 |         const manpowerConfig = getGameplayRuntimeConfig().faction_manpower; const weapons = manpowerConfig.weapon_good_ids.reduce((sum, goodId) => sum + countRealItems(region.vault_id, goodId), 0); const food = manpowerConfig.food_good_ids.reduce((sum, goodId) => sum + countRealItems(region.vault_id, goodId), 0); const population = region.population || 0; const possibleSoldiers = Math.min(Math.floor(population * requireRuntimeNumber(manpowerConfig.population_soldier_ratio, 'gameplay_runtime.faction_manpower.population_soldier_ratio')), weapons); if (food < possibleSoldiers * requireRuntimeNumber(manpowerConfig.food_per_soldier, 'gameplay_runtime.faction_manpower.food_per_soldier')) continue;
  337 |         total += possibleSoldiers;
  338 |     }
  339 |     return Math.floor(total);
  340 | }

  342 | const OwnershipService = {
  343 |     canAccess: function(actorId, containerId, options = {}) {
  344 |         const resolvedId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  345 |         if (!resolvedId) return true;
  346 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedId);
  347 |         if (!cont) return false;
  348 | 
  349 |         if (cont.type === 'magical_pocket') {
  350 |             if (cont.owner_id !== actorId) return false;
  351 |             if (actorId === getInventoryActorId('default') && (!player?.statusEffects || !player.statusEffects['spell_magical_pocket'])) return false;
  352 |             return true;
  353 |         }
  354 | 
  355 |         if (cont.lock_data?.is_locked && !options.allowLocked) return false;
  356 |         if (resolvedId === player?.container_backpack || resolvedId === player?.container_equipment) return actorId === getInventoryActorId('default');
  357 |         if (cont.location?.parent_entity && cont.location.parent_entity === actorId) return true;
  358 |         if (options.ignoreDistance) return true;
  359 | 
  360 |         const actorLocation = resolveActorLocation(actorId);
  361 |         const containerLocation = resolveContainerLocation(resolvedId);
  362 |         if (!actorLocation || !containerLocation) return false;
  363 |         return checkDistance(actorLocation, containerLocation);
  364 |     }
  365 | };

  367 | const EconomySim = {
  368 |   calculatePrice: function(prototypeId, regionId, isBuying) {
  369 |     const economyConfig = getGameplayRuntimeConfig().economy;
  370 |     let basePrice = ECONOMY_ITEMS[prototypeId]?.basePrice || toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.default_base_price, 10);
  371 |     let region = typeof World !== 'undefined' && World ? World.regions[regionId] : null;
  372 |     let marketMod = region?.markets[prototypeId] ? (region.markets[prototypeId] / basePrice) : 1.0;
  373 |     let chaMod = player ? (toRuntimeNumber(player.stats.cha, 10) - toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.charisma_baseline, 10)) * toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.charisma_price_step, 0.05) : 0;
  374 |     let finalPrice = basePrice * marketMod;
  375 |     if (isBuying) finalPrice *= (toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.buy_multiplier, 1.2) - chaMod);
  376 |     else finalPrice *= (toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.sell_multiplier, 0.8) + chaMod);
  377 |     return Math.max(toRuntimeNumber(economyConfig.min_price, 1), Math.floor(finalPrice));
  378 |   }
  379 | };

  382 | function checkDistance(loc1, loc2) {
  383 |     loc1 = normalizeContainerLocation(loc1);
  384 |     loc2 = normalizeContainerLocation(loc2);
  385 |     if (!loc1?.region_id || !loc2?.region_id) return false;
  386 |     if (loc1.region_id !== loc2.region_id) return false;
  387 |     if (!loc1.world_coords || !loc2.world_coords) return true;
  388 |     const dist = Math.hypot(loc1.world_coords[0] - loc2.world_coords[0], loc1.world_coords[1] - loc2.world_coords[1]);
  389 |     return dist <= toRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.access_distance, 10.0);
  390 | }

  392 | function is_sellable(containerId, itemId) {
  393 |     const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  394 |     const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  395 |     const cont = resolvedContainerId ? ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId) : null;
  396 |     if (!item || !cont) return false;
  397 |     if (item.container_id !== resolvedContainerId) return false;
  398 |     if (item.state !== 'idle') return false;
  399 |     if (item.flags?.quest_item) return false;
  400 |     if (item.flags?.bound_to_owner && item.flags.bound_to_owner !== cont.owner_id) return false;
  401 |     if (item.flags?.stolen) return false;
  402 |     return true;
  403 | }

  408 |         const id = getInventoryEngineRuntimeConfig().id_prefixes.container + generateUUID();
  409 |         const defaultLocation = locationData || (
  410 |             ownerId === 'player' && (type === 'player_backpack' || type === 'player_equipment')
  411 |                 ? { world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: 'player', parent_container: null, region_id: player?.location || null }
  412 |                 : null
  413 |         );
  414 |         const container = {
  415 |             id: id,
  416 |             type: type,
  417 |             max_weight_kg: maxWeight,
  418 |             max_slots: maxSlots,
  419 |             owner_id: ownerId,
  420 |             location: normalizeContainerLocation(defaultLocation),
  421 |             lock_data: { is_locked: false, difficulty: toRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_lock_difficulty, 10), trap: null, ...(extraData.lock_data || {}) }, physical_props: { health: toRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_container_health, 200), flammable: !getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.non_flammable_container_types.includes(type), ...(extraData.physical_props || {}) },
  422 |             custom_props: { ...(extraData.custom_props || {}) },
  423 |             items: []
  424 |         };
  425 |         setContainer(id, normalizeContainer(container));
  426 |         return id;
  427 |     },
  428 |     createItem: function(prototypeId, quantity, containerId, customProps = {}) {
  429 |         const proto = itemsReferenceData ? itemsReferenceData.find(i => i.id === prototypeId) : null;
  430 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  431 |         const id = getInventoryEngineRuntimeConfig().id_prefixes.item + generateUUID();
  432 |         const gameplayConfig = getGameplayRuntimeConfig(); let baseWeight = proto ? (proto.weight || toRuntimeNumber(gameplayConfig.inventory.default_item_weight, 1)) : toRuntimeNumber(gameplayConfig.inventory.default_item_weight, 1); if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(gameplayConfig.currency.physical_weights, prototypeId)) baseWeight = toRuntimeNumber(gameplayConfig.currency.physical_weights[prototypeId], baseWeight);
  433 | 
  434 |         const reservedKeys = new Set(['flags', 'durability', 'slot_index', 'slot', 'state', 'created_at', 'last_moved_at']);
  435 |         const mergedCustomProps = {};
  436 |         Object.keys(customProps || {}).forEach(key => {
  437 |             if (!reservedKeys.has(key)) mergedCustomProps[key] = customProps[key];
  438 |         });
  439 | 
  440 |         const item = {
  441 |             id: id,
  442 |             prototype_id: prototypeId,
  443 |             name: proto ? proto.name : prototypeId,
  444 |             stack_size: quantity,
  445 |             container_id: resolvedContainerId,
  446 |             slot_index: customProps.slot_index ?? customProps.slot ?? null,
  447 |             state: customProps.state || getInventoryMovementRuntimeConfig().states.default,
  448 |             flags: { quest_item: false, bound_to_owner: null, stolen: false, magical: false, fragile: false, ...(customProps.flags || {}) },
  449 |             durability: Number.isFinite(customProps.durability) ? customProps.durability : (proto ? (proto.durability || toRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_item_durability, 100)) : toRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_item_durability, 100)),
  450 |             custom_props: { weight_per_unit: baseWeight, name: customProps.name || proto?.name || prototypeId, ...mergedCustomProps },
  451 |             created_at: customProps.created_at ?? (player ? player.stats.turnCount : 0),
  452 |             last_moved_at: customProps.last_moved_at ?? (player ? player.stats.turnCount : 0)
  453 |         };
  454 |         ItemRegistry.set(id, item);
  455 |         if (resolvedContainerId && ContainerRegistry.has(resolvedContainerId)) {
  456 |             const targetCont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
  457 |             if (!targetCont.items) targetCont.items = [];
  458 |             targetCont.items.push(id);
  459 |         }
  460 |         return id;
  461 |     },
  462 |     updateContainerLocation: async function(containerId, locationData) {

  470 |     getContainerWeight: function(containerId) {
  471 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
  472 |         if (!cont) return 0;
  473 |         return getContainerItems(cont).reduce((sum, itemId) => {
  474 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  475 |             return sum + (it ? (it.custom_props.weight_per_unit ?? requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_item_weight, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_item_weight')) * it.stack_size : 0);
  476 |         }, 0);
  477 |     },
  478 |     findItemByPrototype: function(containerId, protoId) {
  479 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
  480 |         if (!cont) return null;
  481 |         return getContainerItems(cont).find(id => {
  482 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(id);
  483 |             return it && (it.prototype_id === protoId || it.custom_props?.aiIdentifier === protoId);
  484 |         });
  485 |     },
  486 |     _restoreMovementSnapshot: function(snapshot, createdItemIds = []) {
  487 |         if (!snapshot) return;
  488 |         snapshot.containers.forEach(([containerId, data]) => {
  489 |             if (data) setContainer(containerId, structuredClone(data));
  490 |         });
  491 |         const snapshotItemIds = new Set(snapshot.items.map(([itemId]) => itemId));
  492 |         createdItemIds.forEach(itemId => {
  493 |             if (!snapshotItemIds.has(itemId)) ItemRegistry.delete(itemId);
  494 |         });
  495 |         snapshot.items.forEach(([itemId, data]) => {
  496 |             if (data) ItemRegistry.set(itemId, structuredClone(data));
  497 |         });
  498 |     },
  499 |     moveItem: function(itemId, sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, quantity = null, options = {}) {
  500 |         if (!ItemRegistry.has(itemId)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_not_found', 'Item not found') };
  501 | 
  502 |         const actorId = options.actorId || getInventoryActorId('default');
  503 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId || ItemRegistry.get(itemId)?.container_id);
  504 |         const requestedTargetId = resolveSpecialContainerId(targetContainerId);
  505 |         let item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  506 | 
  507 |         if (!resolvedSourceId || !ContainerRegistry.has(resolvedSourceId)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('source_container_not_found', 'Source container not found') };
  508 |         if (item.container_id !== resolvedSourceId) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_source_mismatch', 'Item is not in the declared source container') };
  509 |         if (item.state === getInventoryMovementRuntimeConfig().states.trade_locked && !options.allowTradeLocked) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_state_locks_movement', 'Item state locks movement') };
  510 | 
  511 |         let actualTargetId = requestedTargetId;
  512 |         if (!actualTargetId) {
  513 |             actualTargetId = getOrCreateGroundPile(resolveContainerLocation(resolvedSourceId) || resolveActorLocation(actorId));
  514 |         }
  515 |         if (!ContainerRegistry.has(actualTargetId)) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('target_container_not_found', 'Target container not found') };
  516 |         if (resolvedSourceId === actualTargetId) return { success: true, movedItemId: itemId, targetContainerId: actualTargetId, sourceContainerId: resolvedSourceId };
  517 | 
  518 |         if (!options.ignoreAccess) {
  519 |             if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, resolvedSourceId, { allowLocked: options.allowLocked, ignoreDistance: options.ignoreDistance })) {
  520 |                 return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('access_denied_source', 'Access denied to source container') };
  521 |             }
  522 |             if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, actualTargetId, { allowLocked: options.allowLocked, ignoreDistance: options.ignoreDistance })) {
  523 |                 return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('access_denied_target', 'Access denied to target container') };
  524 |             }
  525 |         }
  526 | 
  527 |         const sourceContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedSourceId);
  528 |         const targetContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(actualTargetId);
  529 |         const requestedQuantity = normalizeInventoryMoveQuantity(quantity, item.stack_size);
  530 |         if (!Number.isFinite(requestedQuantity) || requestedQuantity <= 0) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('invalid_quantity', 'Invalid quantity') };
  531 |         if (requestedQuantity > item.stack_size) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('not_enough_stack', 'Not enough quantity in stack') };
  532 |         if (item.flags?.bound_to_owner && targetContainer.owner_id !== item.flags.bound_to_owner) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('item_soulbound', 'Item is soulbound') };
  533 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id && getContainerItems(targetContainer).length >= targetContainer.max_slots) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('target_slots_full', 'Target container is full (slots)') };
  534 | 
  535 |         const currentWeight = this.getContainerWeight(actualTargetId);
  536 |         const itemWeight = (item.custom_props.weight_per_unit ?? requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_item_weight, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_item_weight')) * requestedQuantity;
  537 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id && currentWeight + itemWeight > targetContainer.max_weight_kg) {
  538 |             return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('target_weight_full', 'Target container is full (weight)') };
  539 |         }
  540 | 
  541 |         let movingItem = item;
  542 |         let createdItemId = null;
  543 |         if (requestedQuantity < item.stack_size) {
  544 |             item.stack_size -= requestedQuantity;
  545 |             // FIX: Create the split item directly in the TARGET container, not source.
  546 |             // Previously passed resolvedSourceId which added it to source,
  547 |             // then it was moved via filter+push вЂ” but createItem already adds to container's .items array,
  548 |             // causing a duplicate in source or missed addition to target.
  549 |             createdItemId = this.createItem(item.prototype_id, requestedQuantity, null, {
  550 |                 ...structuredClone(item.custom_props || {}),
  551 |                 flags: structuredClone(item.flags || {}),
  552 |                 durability: item.durability,
  553 |                 slot_index: item.slot_index,
  554 |                 state: item.state,
  555 |                 created_at: item.created_at,
  556 |                 last_moved_at: item.last_moved_at
  557 |             });
  558 |             movingItem = ItemRegistry.get(createdItemId);
  559 |         }
  560 | 
  561 |         if (!sourceContainer.items) sourceContainer.items = [];
  562 |         sourceContainer.items = sourceContainer.items.filter(id => id !== movingItem.id);
  563 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id) {
  564 |             if (!targetContainer.items) targetContainer.items = [];
  565 |             targetContainer.items.push(movingItem.id);
  566 |             movingItem.container_id = actualTargetId;
  567 |         }
  568 |         movingItem.container_id = actualTargetId;
  569 | 
  570 |         const movedIntoPlayerOwned = player && (
  571 |             actualTargetId === player.container_backpack ||
  572 |             actualTargetId === player.container_equipment ||
  573 |             targetContainer.owner_id === 'player'
  574 |         );
  575 |         if (movedIntoPlayerOwned && sourceContainer.owner_id && sourceContainer.owner_id !== 'player') {
  576 |             movingItem.flags.stolen = true;
  577 |         }
  578 | 
  579 |         if (sourceContainer.type === getInventoryMovementRuntimeConfig().resource_debit_source_container_type && sourceContainer.owner_id !== targetContainer.owner_id) {
  580 |             const regionId = resolveContainerLocation(sourceContainer.id)?.region_id;
  581 |             if (regionId && typeof World !== 'undefined' && World?.regions?.[regionId]?.resources?.[movingItem.prototype_id]) {
  582 |                 const regionResource = World.regions[regionId].resources[movingItem.prototype_id];
  583 |                 regionResource.amount = Math.max(0, regionResource.amount - movingItem.stack_size);
  584 |             }
  585 |         }
  586 | 
  587 |         movingItem.last_moved_at = player ? player.stats.turnCount : 0;
  588 |         if (player && (isGoldLikeItem(movingItem) || isGoldLikeItem(item))) syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
  589 | 
  590 |         return { success: true, movedItemId: movingItem.id, createdItemId, targetContainerId: actualTargetId, sourceContainerId: resolvedSourceId };
  591 |     },
  592 |     moveItems: function(sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, items, options = {}) {
  593 |         if (!Array.isArray(items) || items.length === 0) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('no_items_requested', 'No items requested') };
  594 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId);
  595 |         const resolvedTargetId = resolveSpecialContainerId(targetContainerId) || getOrCreateGroundPile(resolveContainerLocation(resolvedSourceId) || resolveActorLocation(options.actorId || getInventoryActorId('default')));
  596 |         const trackedItemIds = Array.from(new Set(items.map(obj => obj?.id).filter(Boolean)));
  597 |         const snapshot = {
  598 |             containers: [resolvedSourceId, resolvedTargetId].filter(Boolean).map(containerId => [containerId, ContainerRegistry.has(containerId) ? structuredClone(ContainerRegistry.get(containerId)) : null]),
  599 |             items: trackedItemIds.filter(itemId => ItemRegistry.has(itemId)).map(itemId => [itemId, structuredClone(ItemRegistry.get(itemId))])
  600 |         };
  601 |         const createdItemIds = [];
  602 | 
  603 |         for (const moveRequest of items) {
  604 |             const res = this.moveItem(moveRequest.id, resolvedSourceId, resolvedTargetId, moveRequest.quantity || null, options);
  605 |             if (!res.success) {
  606 |                 this._restoreMovementSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
  607 |                 return res;
  608 |             }
  609 |             if (res.createdItemId) createdItemIds.push(res.createdItemId);
  610 |         }
  611 | 
  612 |         return { success: true, movedCount: items.length, targetContainerId: resolvedTargetId };
  613 |     },
  614 |     removeItem: function(itemId, quantity) {
  615 |         if (!ItemRegistry.has(itemId)) return false;
  616 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  617 |         const shouldSyncGold = isCurrencyPrototype(item.prototype_id) && item.container_id === player?.container_backpack;
  618 |         if (item.stack_size <= quantity) {
  619 |             if (item.container_id && ContainerRegistry.has(item.container_id)) {
  620 |                 const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(item.container_id);
  621 |                 if (!cont.items) cont.items = [];
  622 |                 cont.items = cont.items.filter(id => id !== itemId);
  623 |             }
  624 |             ItemRegistry.delete(itemId);
  625 |         } else {
  626 |             item.stack_size -= quantity;
  627 |         }
  628 |         if (shouldSyncGold) syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
  629 |         return true;
  630 |     },
  631 |     destroyContainer: function(containerId) {
  632 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  633 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
  634 |         if (!cont) return false;
  635 | 
  636 |         const groundPileId = getOrCreateGroundPile(resolveContainerLocation(resolvedContainerId));
  637 |         const itemsToMove = [...(cont.items || [])];
  638 |         itemsToMove.forEach(itemId => this.moveItem(itemId, resolvedContainerId, groundPileId, null, getInventoryTransferOptions('system_full_access')));
  639 |         ContainerRegistry.delete(resolvedContainerId);
  640 |         return true;
  641 |     },
  642 |     unlockContainer: function(containerId, actorId) {
  643 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  644 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
  645 |         if (!cont || !cont.lock_data.is_locked) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('not_locked_or_not_found', 'Not locked or not found') };
  646 |         if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, resolvedContainerId, { allowLocked: true })) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('too_far_from_container', 'Too far away from container') };
  647 |         const actorContId = actorId === getInventoryActorId('default') ? player.container_backpack : null;
  648 |         if (!actorContId) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('actor_inventory_not_found', 'Actor inventory not found') };
  649 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
  650 |         const unlockConfig = getInventoryUnlockRuntimeConfig();
  651 |         const lockpickId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === unlockConfig.lockpick_prototype_id);
  652 |         if (!lockpickId) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('no_lockpicks', 'No lockpicks') };
  653 |         this.removeItem(lockpickId, 1);
  654 |         const roll = GameRNG.d20(getInventoryUnlockAbilityModifier());
  655 |         if (roll >= cont.lock_data.difficulty) {
  656 |             cont.lock_data.is_locked = false;
  657 |             return { success: true, message: getInventoryFeedbackText('unlock_success', 'Unlocked successfully') };
  658 |         } else {
  659 |             let trapMsg = "";
  660 |             if (cont.lock_data.trap) {
  661 |                 if (cont.lock_data.trap.stat === 'hp') damagePlayerHP(cont.lock_data.trap.amount);
  662 |                 trapMsg = ` РЎСЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°Р»Р° Р»РѕРІСѓС€РєР°! РЈСЂРѕРЅ: ${cont.lock_data.trap.amount}.`;
  663 |             }
  664 |             return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('lockpick_broke', 'Lockpick broke, failed to unlock.{trapMessage}', { trapMessage: trapMsg }) };
  665 |         }
  666 |     },
  667 |     confiscateStolen: function(sourceContainerId, destContainerId) {
  668 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId);
  669 |         const resolvedDestId = resolveSpecialContainerId(destContainerId);
  670 |         const src = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedSourceId);
  671 |         if (!src) return 0;
  672 |         const stolenItems = getContainerItems(src).filter(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.flags?.stolen);
  673 |         let count = 0;
  674 |         stolenItems.forEach(id => {
  675 |             if (this.moveItem(id, resolvedSourceId, resolvedDestId, null, getInventoryTransferOptions('system_ignore_access')).success) count++;
  676 |         });
  677 |         return count;
  678 |     },
  679 |     buildContainer: function(actorId, type, location) {
  680 |         const actorContId = actorId === getInventoryActorId('default') ? player.container_backpack : null;
  681 |         if (!actorContId) return null;
  682 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
  683 |         const buildConfig = getInventoryBuildingRuntimeConfig();
  684 |         const resourceId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === buildConfig.resource_prototype_id);
  685 |         const resourceItem = resourceId ? ItemRegistry.get(resourceId) : null;
  686 |         if (!resourceItem || resourceItem.stack_size < buildConfig.resource_cost) return null;
  687 |         this.removeItem(resourceId, buildConfig.resource_cost);
  688 |         return this.createContainer(type, actorId, buildConfig.default_max_weight_kg, buildConfig.default_max_slots, buildConstructedContainerLocation(location, buildConfig));
  689 |     }
  690 | };

  703 | async function sendInventoryCommand(action, args, _retryCount = 0) {
  704 |     const retryConfig = getInventoryEngineRuntimeConfig().ipc_retry; const MAX_RETRIES = retryConfig.max_retries; const RETRY_DELAY_MS = retryConfig.delay_ms; const RETRY_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER = retryConfig.backoff_multiplier;
  705 | 
  706 |     if (!window.electronAPI || !window.electronAPI.nexusInventoryCommand) {
  707 |         // FALLBACK: IPC РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРµРЅ вЂ” РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓРµРј Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅСѓСЋ СЂРµР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёСЋ (OldCoreInventorySystem)
  708 |         return executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args);
  709 |     }
  710 |     try {
  711 |         const res = await window.electronAPI.nexusInventoryCommand({ action, args });
  712 |         if (res.status === 'ok') {
  713 |             if (res.items) res.items.forEach(([k, v]) => ItemRegistry.set(k, v));
  714 |             if (res.containers) res.containers.forEach(([k, v]) => setContainer(k, v));
  715 |             if (res.deleted_items) res.deleted_items.forEach(id => ItemRegistry.delete(id));
  716 |             if (res.deleted_containers) res.deleted_containers.forEach(id => ContainerRegistry.delete(id));
  717 |             return res;
  718 |         }
  719 | 
  720 |         // Р•СЃР»Рё РґРІРёР¶РѕРє РЅРµ РіРѕС‚РѕРІ вЂ” РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂСЏРµРј РїРѕРїС‹С‚РєСѓ СЃ Р·Р°РґРµСЂР¶РєРѕР№ (race condition РїСЂРё Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєРµ РјРёСЂР°)
  721 |         const isEngineNotReady = res.status === 'error' && (
  722 |             (res.message && (
  723 |                 res.message.includes('Engine not ready') ||
  724 |                 res.message.includes('Engine restarted') ||
  725 |                 res.message.includes('timed out') ||
  726 |                 res.message.includes('crashed')
  727 |             )) ||
  728 |             // Р•СЃР»Рё РґРІРёР¶РѕРє РІРµСЂРЅСѓР» РѕС€РёР±РєСѓ Р±РµР· РґРµС‚Р°Р»РµР№ вЂ” С‚РѕР¶Рµ РїСЂРѕР±СѓРµРј РµС‰С‘ СЂР°Р·
  729 |             (!res.message && _retryCount === 0)
  730 |         );
  731 |         if (isEngineNotReady && _retryCount < MAX_RETRIES) {
  732 |             const delay = Math.floor(RETRY_DELAY_MS * (1 + (_retryCount * RETRY_BACKOFF_MULTIPLIER)));
  733 |             console.warn(`[Inventory] Engine not ready for '${action}' (attempt ${_retryCount + 1}/${MAX_RETRIES}). Retrying in ${delay}ms...`);
  734 |             await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
  735 |             return await sendInventoryCommand(action, args, _retryCount + 1);
  736 |         }
  737 | 
  738 |         // IPC РІРµСЂРЅСѓР» РѕС€РёР±РєСѓ РїРѕСЃР»Рµ РІСЃРµС… РїРѕРїС‹С‚РѕРє вЂ” fallback РЅР° Р»РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅСѓСЋ СЂРµР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёСЋ
  739 |         console.warn(`[Inventory] IPC error for '${action}': ${res.error || res.message || res.status}. Falling back to local.${_retryCount > 0 ? ` (after ${_retryCount} retries)` : ''}`);
  740 |         return executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args);
  741 |     } catch (e) {
  742 |         if (_retryCount < MAX_RETRIES && (e.message || '').includes('not ready')) {
  743 |             const delay = RETRY_DELAY_MS * (_retryCount + 1);
  744 |             console.warn(`[Inventory] IPC exception for '${action}' (attempt ${_retryCount + 1}/${MAX_RETRIES}). Retrying in ${delay}ms...`);
  745 |             await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, delay));
  746 |             return await sendInventoryCommand(action, args, _retryCount + 1);
  747 |         }
  748 |         console.warn(`[Inventory] IPC exception for '${action}': ${e.message}. Falling back to local.`);
  749 |         return executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args);
  750 |     }
  751 | }
  752 | 
  753 | /**
  754 |  * Р›РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅР°СЏ СЂРµР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёСЏ РёРЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ вЂ” fallback РєРѕРіРґР° C++ РґРІРёР¶РѕРє / IPC РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС‹.
  755 |  * Р”РµР»РµРіРёСЂСѓРµС‚ Рє OldCoreInventorySystem (СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚ РЅР°РїСЂСЏРјСѓСЋ СЃ ContainerRegistry / ItemRegistry).
  756 |  */
  757 | function executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args) {
  758 |     switch (action) {
  759 |         case 'createContainer': {
  760 |             const id = OldCoreInventorySystem.createContainer(
  761 |                 args.type, args.ownerId, args.maxWeight, args.maxSlots, args.location, {
  762 |                     lock_data: args.lock_data, physical_props: args.physical_props, custom_props: args.custom_props
  763 |                 }
  764 |             );
  765 |             return { status: 'ok', containerId: id };
  766 |         }
  767 |         case 'createItem': {
  768 |             const id = OldCoreInventorySystem.createItem(
  769 |                 args.prototypeId, args.quantity, args.containerId, args.customProps
  770 |             );
  771 |             return { status: 'ok', itemId: id };
  772 |         }
  773 |         case 'moveItem': {
  774 |             const res = OldCoreInventorySystem.moveItem(
  775 |                 args.itemId, null, args.targetContainerId,
  776 |                 args.quantity >= 0 ? args.quantity : null,
  777 |                 getInventoryTransferOptions('player_ui')
  778 |             );
  779 |             return { status: res.success ? 'ok' : 'error', ...res, feedback: res.error };
  780 |         }
  781 |         case 'moveItems': {
  782 |             const res = OldCoreInventorySystem.moveItems(
  783 |                 args.sourceContainerId, args.targetContainerId, args.items,
  784 |                 getInventoryTransferOptions('player_ui')
  785 |             );
  786 |             return { status: res.success ? 'ok' : 'error', ...res, feedback: res.error };
  787 |         }
  788 |         case 'removeItem': {
  789 |             const ok = OldCoreInventorySystem.removeItem(args.itemId, args.quantity);
  790 |             return { status: ok ? 'ok' : 'error', success: ok };
  791 |         }
  792 |         case 'destroyContainer': {
  793 |             const ok = OldCoreInventorySystem.destroyContainer(args.containerId);
  794 |             return { status: ok ? 'ok' : 'error', success: ok };
  795 |         }
  796 |         case 'updateContainerLocation': {
  797 |             const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(args.containerId);
  798 |             if (cont) {
  799 |                 cont.location = normalizeContainerLocation(args.location);
  800 |                 return { status: 'ok', success: true };
  801 |             }
  802 |             return { status: 'error', success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('container_not_found', 'Container not found') };
  803 |         }
  804 |         case 'syncEntity':
  805 |         case 'updateEntityStat':
  806 |         case 'updateItemStat':
  807 |             // РљРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹ СЃРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·Р°С†РёРё NPC/Entity вЂ” СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°СЋС‚ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ С‡РµСЂРµР· C++ РґРІРёР¶РѕРє.
  808 |             // Р›РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РЅРµС‚ СЂРµРµСЃС‚СЂР° NPC, РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РІРѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµРј OK (fire-and-forget).
  809 |             return { status: 'ok', success: true };
  810 |         default:
  811 |             console.warn(`[Inventory] Unknown local command: ${action}`);
  812 |             return { status: 'error', success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('unknown_command', 'Unknown command: {action}', { action }) };
  813 |     }
  814 | }

  816 | async function getOrCreateGroundPileAsync(locationData) {

  821 |         physical_props: { health: requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_container_health, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_container_health'), flammable: false }
  822 |     });

  825 | async function consumeRealItemsAsync(containerId, prototypeId, quantity) {
  826 |     const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
  827 |     if (!cont) return 0;
  828 |     let remaining = quantity;
  829 |     let taken = 0;
  830 |     for (const itemId of [...getContainerItems(cont)]) {
  831 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  832 |         if (!item || item.prototype_id !== prototypeId) continue;
  833 |         const take = Math.min(item.stack_size, remaining);
  834 |         if (take > 0) {
  835 |             await CoreInventorySystemAsync.removeItem(itemId, take);
  836 |             remaining -= take;
  837 |             taken += take;
  838 |         }
  839 |         if (remaining <= 0) break;
  840 |     }
  841 |     return taken;
  842 | }

  849 |             name: getItemName(prototypeId, player?.era)

  883 |     getContainerWeight: function(containerId) {
  884 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);

  886 |         return getContainerItems(cont).reduce((sum, itemId) => {
  887 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
  888 |             return sum + (it ? (it.custom_props.weight_per_unit ?? requireRuntimeNumber(getGameplayRuntimeConfig().inventory.default_item_weight, 'gameplay_runtime.inventory.default_item_weight')) * it.stack_size : 0);
  889 |         }, 0);
  890 |     },

  896 |             return it && (it.prototype_id === protoId || it.custom_props?.aiIdentifier === protoId);
  897 |         });

  930 |     unlockContainer: async function(containerId, actorId) {
  931 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
  932 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
  933 |         if (!cont || !cont.lock_data.is_locked) return { success: false, error: "Not locked or not found" };
  934 |         if (!OwnershipService.canAccess(actorId, resolvedContainerId, { allowLocked: true })) return { success: false, error: "Too far away from container" };
  935 |         const actorContId = actorId === 'player' ? player.container_backpack : null;
  936 |         if (!actorContId) return { success: false, error: "Actor inventory not found" };
  937 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
  938 |         const lockpickId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === 'lockpicks_common');
  939 |         if (!lockpickId) return { success: false, error: "No lockpicks" };
  940 |         await this.removeItem(lockpickId, 1);
  941 |         const roll = GameRNG.d20((player.stats.dex - 10)/2);
  942 |         if (roll >= cont.lock_data.difficulty) {
  943 |             cont.lock_data.is_locked = false;
  944 |             return { success: true, message: "Unlocked successfully" };
  945 |         } else {
  946 |             let trapMsg = "";
  947 |             if (cont.lock_data.trap) {
  948 |                 if (cont.lock_data.trap.stat === 'hp') damagePlayerHP(cont.lock_data.trap.amount);
  949 |                 trapMsg = ` РЎСЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°Р»Р° Р»РѕРІСѓС€РєР°! РЈСЂРѕРЅ: ${cont.lock_data.trap.amount}.`;
  950 |             }
  951 |             return { success: false, error: "Lockpick broke, failed to unlock." + trapMsg };
  952 |         }
  953 |     },
  954 |     confiscateStolen: async function(sourceContainerId, destContainerId) {
  955 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId);
  956 |         let resolvedDestId = resolveSpecialContainerId(destContainerId);
  957 |         if (!resolvedDestId && resolveSystemContainerKey(destContainerId) === 'guard_confiscation_chest') {
  958 |             resolvedDestId = await ensureGuardConfiscationChest();
  959 |         }
  960 |         const src = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedSourceId);
  961 |         if (!src) return 0;
  962 |         const stolenItems = getContainerItems(src).filter(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.flags?.stolen);
  963 |         let count = 0;
  964 |         for (const id of stolenItems) {
  965 |             const res = await this.moveItem(id, resolvedSourceId, resolvedDestId, null, { actorId: getInventoryActorId('system'), ignoreAccess: true, ignoreDistance: true });
  966 |             if (res.success) count++;
  967 |         }
  968 |         return count;
  969 |     },
  970 |     buildContainer: async function(actorId, type, location) {
  971 |         const actorContId = actorId === 'player' ? player.container_backpack : null;
  972 |         if (!actorContId) return null;
  973 |         const actorCont = ContainerRegistry.get(actorContId);
  974 |         const buildConfig = getInventoryBuildingRuntimeConfig();
  975 |         const resourceId = getContainerItems(actorCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id)?.prototype_id === buildConfig.resource_prototype_id);
  976 |         const resourceItem = resourceId ? ItemRegistry.get(resourceId) : null;
  977 |         if (!resourceItem || resourceItem.stack_size < buildConfig.resource_cost) return null;
  978 |         await this.removeItem(resourceId, buildConfig.resource_cost);
  979 |         return await this.createContainer(type, actorId, buildConfig.default_max_weight_kg, buildConfig.default_max_slots, buildConstructedContainerLocation(location, buildConfig));
  980 |     }
  981 | };
  982 | // DEPRECATED: CoreInventorySystem alias removed.
  983 | // Previously, this was: const CoreInventorySystem = CoreInventorySystemAsync;
  984 | // This was DANGEROUS because callers used sync patterns (no await) on async functions,
  985 | // causing silent failures (promises not awaited, operations silently dropped).
  986 | // 
  987 | // MIGRATION GUIDE:
  988 | // - For code that NEEDS sync behavior (UI helpers, pure local calculations):
  989 | //   Use OldCoreInventorySystem directly вЂ” it operates on local registries only.
  990 | // - For code that NEEDS engine synchronization (persisting to C++ engine):
  991 | //   Use CoreInventorySystemAsync and ALWAYS await the result.
  992 | // - NEVER call CoreInventorySystemAsync methods without await.
  993 | // - If you see "CoreInventorySystem" in code, replace it with either
  994 | //   OldCoreInventorySystem (sync, local) or CoreInventorySystemAsync (async, networked).
  995 | 
  996 | // Backward compatibility wrapper that warns when used without proper async handling
  997 | const CoreInventorySystem = new Proxy(OldCoreInventorySystem, {
  998 |     get(target, prop) {
  999 |         if (prop in CoreInventorySystemAsync && typeof CoreInventorySystemAsync[prop] === 'function') {
 1000 |             // Return the async version but log a deprecation warning
 1001 |             const asyncFn = CoreInventorySystemAsync[prop];
 1002 |             return function(...args) {
 1003 |                 const stackHint = new Error().stack?.split('\n')[2]?.trim() || 'unknown caller';
 1004 |                 console.warn(`[DEPRECATED] CoreInventorySystem.${prop}() called вЂ” this returns a Promise. Use "await CoreInventorySystemAsync.${prop}()" instead. Called from: ${stackHint}`);
 1005 |                 const result = asyncFn.apply(this, args);
 1006 |                 // If the result is a promise, check if it's being awaited
 1007 |                 if (result && typeof result.then === 'function') {
 1008 |                     result.catch(err => {
 1009 |                         console.error(`[CoreInventorySystem] Unhandled async error in ${prop}():`, err);
 1010 |                     });
 1011 |                 }
 1012 |                 return result;
 1013 |             };
 1014 |         }
 1015 |         return target[prop];
 1016 |     }

 1019 | async function equipItemAsync(itemId, targetSlot = null) {
 1020 |     if (window.ModAPI) ModAPI.emit('onPlayerEquipped', {itemId, slot: targetSlot, action: 'equip'});
 1021 |     if (!player || !player.container_backpack || !player.container_equipment) return null;

 1024 | 
 1025 |     if (!targetSlot) {
 1026 |         const allPossibleSlots = bodySlots.filter(s => !itemToEquip.custom_props.slot || itemToEquip.custom_props.slot === s || (['right_hand', 'left_hand'].includes(s) && ['right_hand', 'left_hand'].includes(itemToEquip.custom_props.slot)));
 1027 |         if (allPossibleSlots.length === 0) return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.itemNotEquipable', { itemName: itemToEquip.custom_props.name });
 1028 |         const eqCont = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_equipment);
 1029 |         targetSlot = allPossibleSlots.find(s => !getContainerItems(eqCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id).slot_index === s));

 1031 |     }

 1034 |

 1036 |         itemId, slot: targetSlot, equipmentContainerId: player.container_equipment, backpackContainerId: player.container_backpack

 1040 |         updateInventoryDisplay();
 1041 |         updateEquipmentDisplay();

 1050 | async function unequipItemAsync(slot) {
 1051 |     if (!player || !player.container_equipment || !player.container_backpack) return null;
 1052 |     const eqCont = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_equipment);
 1053 |     const itemId = getContainerItems(eqCont).find(id => ItemRegistry.get(id).slot_index === slot);
 1054 |     if (!itemId) return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.slotIsEmpty', { slot: slot });
 1055 | 
 1056 |     const itemToUnequip = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 1057 |     const backpack = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_backpack);
 1058 | 
 1059 |     if (getContainerItems(backpack).length >= player.inventoryCapacity) {
 1060 |         return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.inventoryFullOnUnequip', { itemName: itemToUnequip.custom_props.name });
 1061 |     }
 1062 | 
 1063 |     const res = await sendInventoryCommand(getInventoryCommandName('unequip_item'), {
 1064 |         slot, equipmentContainerId: player.container_equipment, backpackContainerId: player.container_backpack
 1065 |     });
 1066 | 
 1067 |     if (res.success) {
 1068 |         updateInventoryDisplay();
 1069 |         updateEquipmentDisplay();
 1070 |         updateCharacterSheet();
 1071 |         queuePlayerActionForGM(`Player unequipped item '${itemToUnequip.custom_props.name}' from slot '${slot}'.`);
 1072 |         if (itemTooltipElement) itemTooltipElement.style.display = 'none';
 1073 |         return t('gameInterface.commandFeedback.itemUnequipped', { itemName: itemToUnequip.custom_props.name, slot: slot });
 1074 |     }
 1075 |     return res.feedback;

 1203 | async function mountTransport(itemId) {
 1204 |     if (!player || !player.container_backpack) return null;
 1205 | 
 1206 |     const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 1207 |     if (!item) return "Item not found";
 1208 | 
 1209 |     const transportTypes = TransportSystem.registry ? Object.keys(TransportSystem.registry) : ['horse', 'warhorse', 'cart', 'wagon', 'ship_deed'];
 1210 |     const isTransportByPrototype = transportTypes.includes(item.prototype_id);
 1211 |     const isTransportByProperty = item.custom_props?.isTransport === true;
 1212 | 
 1213 |     if (!isTransportByPrototype && !isTransportByProperty) {
 1214 |         return t('transport.notTransport', 'This item is not a transport');
 1215 |     }
 1216 | 
 1217 |     const feedback = await executeCommand('mountTransport', {
 1218 |         itemId: itemId,
 1219 |         backpackContainerId: player.container_backpack
 1220 |     });
 1221 | 
 1222 |     if (feedback && !feedback.includes('ERROR')) {
 1223 |         await updateTransportUI();
 1224 |         addLogMessage(feedback, 'system-message');
 1225 |         queuePlayerActionForGM(`Player mounted transport: ${item.custom_props.name || item.prototype_id}`);
 1226 |     }
 1227 | 
 1228 |     return feedback || "Failed to mount transport";
 1229 | }

 1231 | async function dismountTransport() {
 1232 |     const feedback = await executeCommand('dismountTransport', {});
 1233 | 
 1234 |     if (feedback && !feedback.includes('ERROR')) {

 1361 |         }

 1364 |             const merchant = World?.npcs?.[trade.target];
 1365 |             if (!merchant?.inventory || merchant.inventory.gold < remaining) return { success: false, error: getInventoryFeedbackText('merchant_account_short_gold', 'Merchant account is short on gold') };

 2420 |     confirmTrade: async function(tradeId) {
 2421 |         if (!this.activeTrades.has(tradeId)) return { success: false, error: "Trade not found" };
 2422 |         const trade = this.activeTrades.get(tradeId);
 2423 | 
 2424 |         const readiness = this._validateTradeReady(trade);
 2425 |         if (!readiness.success) return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, readiness.error);
 2426 | 
 2427 |         const snapshot = this._snapshotTradeState(trade);
 2428 |         const createdItemIds = [];
 2429 | 
 2430 |         const offerResult = await this._executeItemTransfers(trade.offer_items, trade.initiator_container, trade.target_container, createdItemIds);
 2431 |         if (!offerResult.success) {
 2432 |             this._restoreTradeSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
 2433 |             return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, offerResult.error || "Failed to move offer item");
 2434 |         }
 2435 | 
 2436 |         let requestResult = { success: true };
 2437 |         if (trade.mode === 'manual') {
 2438 |             requestResult = await this._executeItemTransfers(trade.request_items, trade.target_container, trade.initiator_container, createdItemIds);
 2439 |         } else {
 2440 |             requestResult = await this._transferMerchantGold(trade, createdItemIds);
 2441 |         }
 2442 | 
 2443 |         if (!requestResult.success) {
 2444 |             this._restoreTradeSnapshot(snapshot, createdItemIds);
 2445 |             return this._rollbackTrade(tradeId, requestResult.error || "Failed to complete trade payment");
 2446 |         }
 2447 | 
 2448 |         trade.status = "completed";
 2449 |         this.activeTrades.delete(tradeId);
 2450 |         this._toggleConfirmButton(null);
 2451 |         if (player?.active_trade_id === tradeId) player.active_trade_id = null;
 2452 |         syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 2453 |         await this._postProcessTrade(trade);
 2454 |         return { success: true, tradeId, price: trade.final_price || 0 };
 2455 |     },
 2456 |     _rollbackTrade: function(tradeId, reason) {
 2457 |         const trade = this.activeTrades.get(tradeId);
 2458 |         if (trade) {
 2459 |             this._releaseTradeLocks(trade);
 2460 |             trade.status = "failed";
 2461 |             this.activeTrades.delete(tradeId);
 2462 |         }
 2463 |         this._toggleConfirmButton(null);
 2464 |         if (player?.active_trade_id === tradeId) player.active_trade_id = null;
 2465 |         return { success: false, error: reason };
 2466 |     },
 2467 |     negotiateTrade: function(tradeId, newOffer, newRequestItems = []) {
 2468 |         if (!this.activeTrades.has(tradeId)) return { success: false, error: "Trade not found" };
 2469 |         const trade = this.activeTrades.get(tradeId);
 2470 |         if (trade.mode === 'sale') {
 2471 |             const requestedPrice = parseInt(newOffer, 10);
 2472 |             if (!Number.isFinite(requestedPrice) || requestedPrice <= 0) return { success: false, error: "Invalid negotiated offer" };
 2473 |             if (requestedPrice < trade.negotiation.min_price || requestedPrice > trade.negotiation.max_price) {
 2474 |                 return { success: false, error: `Merchant rejects this price. Allowed range: ${trade.negotiation.min_price}-${trade.negotiation.max_price}.` };
 2475 |             }
 2476 |             if (getGoldAmountInContainer(trade.target_container) < requestedPrice) {
 2477 |                 return { success: false, error: "Merchant cannot cover the negotiated price" };
 2478 |             }
 2479 |             trade.final_price = requestedPrice;
 2480 |             return { success: true, acceptedPrice: requestedPrice };
 2481 |         }
 2482 | 
 2483 |         this._releaseTradeLocks(trade);
 2484 |         trade.offer_items = [];
 2485 |         trade.request_items = [];
 2486 |         const prepResult = this._prepareManualTrade(trade, newOffer, newRequestItems);
 2487 |         return prepResult.success ? { success: true } : prepResult;
 2488 |     }
 2489 | };

 2862 | function parseLocString(str, disableLoc = window.DISABLE_LOCALIZATION) {
 2863 |     if (typeof str !== 'string') return str;
 2864 |     let result = str;
 2865 | 
 2866 |     if (!disableLoc && str.includes('"loc_key"')) {
 2867 |         const processParsed = (data, originalStr) => {
 2868 |             if (data.loc_args) {
 2869 |                 for (let k in data.loc_args) {
 2870 |                     let argStr = data.loc_args[k];
 2871 |                     if (typeof argStr === 'string') {
 2872 |                         if (typeof ECONOMY_ITEMS !== 'undefined') {
 2873 |                             Object.keys(ECONOMY_ITEMS).forEach(itemId => {
 2874 |                                 const r = new RegExp('\\b' + itemId + '\\b', 'g');
 2875 |                                 if (r.test(argStr)) {
 2876 |                                     argStr = argStr.replace(r, getItemName(itemId, player ? player.era : getRuntimeDefaultEraId()));
 2877 |                                 }
 2878 |                             });
 2879 |                         }
 2880 |                         if (typeof FACILITY_NAMES !== 'undefined') {
 2881 |                             Object.keys(FACILITY_NAMES).forEach(facId => {
 2882 |                                 const r = new RegExp('\\b' + facId + '\\b', 'g');
 2883 |                                 if (r.test(argStr)) {
 2884 |                                     argStr = argStr.replace(r, getFacilityName(facId, player ? player.era : getRuntimeDefaultEraId()));
 2885 |                                 }
 2886 |                             });
 2887 |                         }
 2888 |                         if (argStr.includes('"loc_key"')) {
 2889 |                             argStr = parseLocString(argStr, disableLoc);
 2890 |                         }
 2891 |                         data.loc_args[k] = argStr;
 2892 |                     }
 2893 |                 }
 2894 |             }
 2895 |             let trans = t(data.loc_key, data.loc_args, null);
 2896 |             if (trans === null) {
 2897 |                 let fallbackText = data.loc_key.split('.').pop() + ": ";
 2898 |                 if (data.loc_args) fallbackText += Object.values(data.loc_args).join(', ');
 2899 |                 return fallbackText;
 2900 |             }
 2901 |             return trans;
 2902 |         };
 2903 | 
 2904 |         try {
 2905 |             let data = JSON.parse(str);
 2906 |             if (data && data.loc_key) {
 2907 |                 result = processParsed(data, str);
 2908 |             }
 2909 |         } catch(e) {
 2910 |             const regex = /\{"loc_key":"[^"]+"(?:,\s*"loc_args":\{.*?\})?\}/g;
 2911 |             result = str.replace(regex, (match) => {
 2912 |                 try {
 2913 |                     let data = JSON.parse(match);
 2914 |                     if (data && data.loc_key) return processParsed(data, match);
 2915 |                 } catch(err) {
 2916 |                     console.warn('[i18n] Failed to parse location JSON fragment:', match, err.message);
 2917 |                 }
 2918 |                 return match;
 2919 |             });
 2920 |         }
 2921 |     }
 2922 | 
 2923 |     if (window.ModAPI && window.ModAPI.applyTextFilters) {
 2924 |         result = window.ModAPI.applyTextFilters(result);
 2925 |     }
 2926 |     return result;

 3443 | // --- XSS PROTECTION: Escape HTML special characters ---
 3444 | function escapeHTML(str) {
 3445 |     if (typeof str !== 'string') return String(str);
 3446 |     return str.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
 3447 |               .replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#039;');
 3448 | }
 3449 | // Sanitize HTML content вЂ” strip dangerous tags while preserving safe formatting
 3450 | function sanitizeHTML(html) {
 3451 |     if (typeof html !== 'string') return '';
 3452 |     // Use DOMPurify if available (loaded in index.html), otherwise fallback to basic sanitization
 3453 |     if (typeof DOMPurify !== 'undefined' && DOMPurify.sanitize) {
 3454 |         return DOMPurify.sanitize(html, { ALLOWED_TAGS: ['b', 'i', 'em', 'strong', 'span', 'br', 'p', 'div', 'ul', 'ol', 'li', 'a'], ALLOWED_ATTR: ['class', 'href', 'style', 'title'] });
 3455 |     }
 3456 |     // Fallback: basic regex sanitization (less secure than DOMPurify)
 3457 |     return html
 3458 |         .replace(/<script\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/script>)<[^<]*)*<\/script>/gi, '')
 3459 |         .replace(/<iframe\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/iframe>)<[^<]*)*<\/iframe>/gi, '')
 3460 |         .replace(/<object\b[^<]*(?:(?!<\/object>)<[^<]*)*<\/object>/gi, '')
 3461 |         .replace(/<embed\b[^>]*>/gi, '')
 3462 |         .replace(/on\w+\s*=\s*"[^"]*"/gi, '')
 3463 |         .replace(/on\w+\s*=\s*'[^']*'/gi, '')
 3464 |         .replace(/on\w+\s*=\s*[^\s>]+/gi, '')
 3465 |         .replace(/javascript:/gi, '')
 3466 |         .replace(/<svg\b[^>]*>/gi, '')
 3467 |         .replace(/<img\b[^>]*onerror\b[^>]*>/gi, '');
 3468 | }

 4542 | function checkEffectTrigger(effect, trigger) {

 4560 | function applyEffectAction(entity, effect, action) {
 4561 |     let message = null;
 4562 |     try {
 4563 |         switch (action.type) {
 4564 |             case 'modify_stat': {
 4565 |                 const { stat, change } = action;
 4566 |                 const changeValue = parseInt(change, 10);
 4567 |                 if (!entity.stats || isNaN(changeValue)) break;
 4568 | 
 4569 |                 const oldValue = entity.stats[stat] || 0;
 4570 |                 entity.stats[stat] = oldValue + changeValue;
 4571 | 
 4572 |                 // РћРіСЂР°РЅРёС‡РµРЅРёСЏ
 4573 |                 if (stat === 'hp') {
 4574 |                     entity.stats.hp = Math.max(0, Math.min(entity.stats.hp, entity.stats.maxHp));
 4575 |                 }
 4576 |                 if (stat === 'mana' && entity.class === 'mage') {
 4577 |                     entity.stats.mana = Math.max(0, Math.min(entity.stats.mana, entity.stats.maxMana));
 4578 |                 }
 4579 | 
 4580 |                 const statName = t(`gameInterface.characterPanel.${stat}`, null, stat);
 4581 |                 const changeText = changeValue > 0 ? `+${changeValue}` : changeValue;
 4582 |                 message = t('gameInterface.log.effectModifyStat', { effectName: effect.name, statName: statName, change: changeText });
 4583 |                 break;
 4584 |             }
 4585 |             case 'set_stat': {
 4586 |                 const { stat, value } = action;
 4587 |                 const setValue = parseInt(value, 10);
 4588 |                 if (!entity.stats || isNaN(setValue)) break;
 4589 | 
 4590 |                 // РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅСЏРµРј РѕСЂРёРіРёРЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРµ Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёРµ, РµСЃР»Рё РѕРЅРѕ РµС‰Рµ РЅРµ СЃРѕС…СЂР°РЅРµРЅРѕ
 4591 |                 if (!effect.originalValues) {
 4592 |                     effect.originalValues = {};
 4593 |                 }
 4594 |                 if (effect.originalValues[stat] === undefined) {
 4595 |                     effect.originalValues[stat] = entity.stats[stat] || 0;
 4596 |                 }
 4597 | 
 4598 |                 entity.stats[stat] = setValue;
 4599 |                 const statName = t(`gameInterface.characterPanel.${stat}`, null, stat);
 4600 |                 message = t('gameInterface.log.effectSetStat', { effectName: effect.name, statName: statName, value: setValue });
 4601 |                 break;
 4602 |             }
 4603 |             case 'restore_stat': {
 4604 |                 const { stat } = action;
 4605 |                 if (effect.originalValues && effect.originalValues[stat] !== undefined) {
 4606 |                     entity.stats[stat] = effect.originalValues[stat];
 4607 |                     const statName = t(`gameInterface.characterPanel.${stat}`, null, stat);
 4608 |                     message = t('gameInterface.log.effectRestoreStat', { effectName: effect.name, statName: statName, value: entity.stats[stat] });
 4609 |                     delete effect.originalValues[stat]; // РћС‡РёС‰Р°РµРј СЃРѕС…СЂР°РЅРµРЅРЅРѕРµ Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёРµ
 4610 |                 }
 4611 |                 break;
 4612 |             }
 4613 |         }
 4614 |     } catch (e) {
 4615 |         console.error("РћС€РёР±РєР° РїСЂРёРјРµРЅРµРЅРёСЏ РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёСЏ СЌС„С„РµРєС‚Р°:", e, action);
 4616 |     }
 4617 |     return message;

 5539 | function applyTranslations() {
 5540 |     const elements = document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]');
 5541 | 
 5542 |     elements.forEach(el => {
 5543 |         if (el.id === 'level-info') { // level-info РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РѕС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅРѕ С‡РµСЂРµР· updateCharacterSheet
 5544 |             return;
 5545 |         }
 5546 | 
 5547 |         const keyWithOptions = el.dataset.i18n;
 5548 |         let key = keyWithOptions;
 5549 |         let attribute = 'textContent'; // РџРѕ СѓРјРѕР»С‡Р°РЅРёСЋ РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»СЏРµРј С‚РµРєСЃС‚РѕРІРѕРµ СЃРѕРґРµСЂР¶РёРјРѕРµ
 5550 | 
 5551 |         // РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµРј, СѓРєР°Р·Р°РЅ Р»Рё Р°С‚СЂРёР±СѓС‚ РІ data-i18n (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ, [placeholder]key.name)
 5552 |         if (key.startsWith('[')) {
 5553 |             const match = key.match(/^\[(.*?)\](.*)/);
 5554 |             if (match) {
 5555 |                 attribute = match[1];
 5556 |                 key = match[2];
 5557 |             }
 5558 |         }
 5559 | 
 5560 |         let variables = null;
 5561 |         if (el.dataset.i18nVariables) {
 5562 |             try {
 5563 |                 // Р—Р°РјРµРЅСЏРµРј РѕРґРёРЅР°СЂРЅС‹Рµ РєР°РІС‹С‡РєРё РЅР° РґРІРѕР№РЅС‹Рµ РґР»СЏ РєРѕСЂСЂРµРєС‚РЅРѕРіРѕ JSON.parse
 5564 |                 const jsonString = el.dataset.i18nVariables.replace(/'/g, '"');
 5565 |                 variables = JSON.parse(jsonString);
 5566 |             } catch (e) {
 5567 |                 console.error(`РћС€РёР±РєР° СЂР°Р·Р±РѕСЂР° РїРµСЂРµРјРµРЅРЅС‹С… i18n РґР»СЏ РєР»СЋС‡Р° "${key}":`, e, el.dataset.i18nVariables);
 5568 |             }
 5569 |         }
 5570 | 
 5571 |         let translation = t(key, variables); // РџРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµРј РїРµСЂРµРІРѕРґ
 5572 | 
 5573 |         if (translation !== key) { // Р•СЃР»Рё РїРµСЂРµРІРѕРґ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ Рё РѕРЅ РЅРµ СЂР°РІРµРЅ СЃР°РјРѕРјСѓ РєР»СЋС‡Сѓ
 5574 |             if (attribute === 'textContent') {
 5575 |                 el.textContent = translation; // Safe: textContent doesn't parse HTML
 5576 |             } else if (attribute === 'innerHTML') {
 5577 |                 el.innerHTML = sanitizeHTML(translation);
 5578 |             } else if (el.hasAttribute(attribute)) {
 5579 |                 el.setAttribute(attribute, translation);
 5580 |             } else {
 5581 |                 // Р•СЃР»Рё СЌС‚Рѕ СЃРїРµС†РёР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ Р°С‚СЂРёР±СѓС‚, РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹Р№ РЅРµ СЏРІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ СЃС‚Р°РЅРґР°СЂС‚РЅС‹Рј HTML Р°С‚СЂРёР±СѓС‚РѕРј

 5596 | 
 5597 | function t(key, variables = null, fallback = null) {
 5598 |     let translation = undefined;
 5599 |     
 5600 |     // РЎРЅР°С‡Р°Р»Р° РёС‰РµРј РїРµСЂРµРІРѕРґ РІ СЃР»РѕРІР°СЂСЏС… РјРѕРґРѕРІ
 5601 |     if (window.ModAPI && window.ModAPI.customTranslations && window.ModAPI.customTranslations[currentLanguage]) {
 5602 |         translation = key.split('.').reduce((obj, i) => obj?.[i], window.ModAPI.customTranslations[currentLanguage]);
 5603 |     }
 5604 |     
 5605 |     // Р•СЃР»Рё РјРѕРґ РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµРѕРїСЂРµРґРµР»РёР» СЃС‚СЂРѕРєСѓ, РёС‰РµРј РІ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРѕР№ РёРіСЂРµ
 5606 |     if (translation === undefined) {
 5607 |         translation = key.split('.').reduce((obj, i) => obj?.[i], translations);
 5608 |     }
 5609 | 
 5610 |     if (typeof translation !== 'string') {
 5611 |         translation = fallback !== null ? fallback : key;
 5612 |     }
 5613 | 
 5614 |     if (variables && typeof translation === 'string') {
 5615 |         for (const varKey in variables) {
 5616 |             const regex = new RegExp(`\\{${varKey}\\}`, 'g');
 5617 |             translation = translation.replace(regex, variables[varKey]);
 5618 |         }
 5619 |     }
 5620 |     return translation || (fallback !== null ? fallback : key);
 5621 | }

 7578 | function resetCharacterCreation() {

 7589 |             if (charEraSelect) charEraSelect.value = backup.era || getRuntimeDefaultEraId();

 7659 |             const raceMod = RACE_MODIFIERS[selectedRace][stat] || 0;
 7660 |             baseStatsForDistribution[stat] = classStat + raceMod;

 7662 |         });

 7665 |         updateStatCreationDisplay();
 7666 |     } else {

 7674 | function handleStatChange(event) {
 7675 |     const button = event.target;
 7676 |     const stat = button.getAttribute('data-stat');
 7677 |     const change = button.classList.contains('plus') ? 1 : -1;
 7678 | 
 7679 |     if (!charRaceSelect.value || !charClassSelect.value || baseStatsForDistribution[stat] === undefined) return;
 7680 | 
 7681 |     const baseStatValueForDistribution = baseStatsForDistribution[stat];
 7682 | 
 7683 |     if (change > 0 && availableStatPoints > 0) {
 7684 |         currentCreationStats[stat]++;
 7685 |         availableStatPoints--;
 7686 |     } else if (change < 0 && currentCreationStats[stat] > baseStatValueForDistribution) {
 7687 |         currentCreationStats[stat]--;
 7688 |         availableStatPoints++;
 7689 |     }
 7690 |     updateStatCreationDisplay();
 7691 | }
 7692 | 
 7693 | function updateStatCreationDisplay() {
 7694 |     creationStatPointsDisplay.textContent = availableStatPoints;
 7695 | 
 7696 |     Object.keys(createStatDisplays).forEach(stat => {
 7697 |         createStatDisplays[stat].textContent = currentCreationStats[stat] !== undefined ? currentCreationStats[stat] : (baseStatsForDistribution[stat] || '0');
 7698 |     });
 7699 | 
 7700 |     statButtons.forEach(button => {
 7701 |         const stat = button.getAttribute('data-stat');
 7702 |         const isPlus = button.classList.contains('plus');
 7703 |         const baseValue = baseStatsForDistribution[stat];
 7704 |         const currentValue = currentCreationStats[stat];
 7705 | 
 7706 |         if (isPlus) {
 7707 |             button.disabled = availableStatPoints <= 0;
 7708 |         } else {
 7709 |             button.disabled = currentValue === undefined || currentValue <= baseValue;
 7710 |         }
 7711 |     });
 7712 |     checkCreationFormValidity();
 7713 | }

 8138 | function advanceTime(pulses) {
 8139 |     if (!player || !player.gameTime) return;
 8140 |     if (pulses <= 0) return;
 8141 | 
 8142 |     let gt = player.gameTime;
 8143 |     let oldHour = gt.hour;
 8144 | 
 8145 |     if (!player.lastTurnPulses) player.lastTurnPulses = gt.totalPulses;
 8146 |     gt.totalPulses += pulses;
 8147 |     gt.minute += pulses * 5;
 8148 | 
 8149 |     while (gt.minute >= 60) {
 8150 |         gt.minute -= 60;
 8151 |         gt.hour += 1;
 8152 |     }
 8153 |     while (gt.hour >= 24) {
 8154 |         gt.hour -= 24;
 8155 |         gt.day += 1;
 8156 |     }
 8157 |     while (gt.day > 30) {
 8158 |         gt.day -= 30;
 8159 |         gt.month += 1;
 8160 |     }
 8161 |     while (gt.month > 12) {
 8162 |         gt.month -= 12;
 8163 |         gt.year += 1;
 8164 |     }
 8165 | 
 8166 |     checkTimeTriggers(oldHour, gt.hour);
 8167 |     if (enableWorldSim && typeof updateWorldSimulation === 'function') {
 8168 |         if (pulses >= 288) {
 8169 |             showLoadingScreen('loadingScreen.generatingWorld', 'РЎРёРјСѓР»СЏС†РёСЏ РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРё Рё СЃРѕР±С‹С‚РёР№...');
 8170 |             isWaitingForAI = true;
 8171 |             window.isSimulatingTime = true;
 8172 |         }
 8173 |         updateWorldSimulation(pulses);
 8174 |     }
 8175 |     updateTimeDisplay();
 8176 | }

 8178 | function checkTimeTriggers(oldHour, newHour) {
 8179 |     if (oldHour === newHour) return;

 8185 |                 if (newHour >= tp.start_hour || newHour < tp.end_hour) timeOfDay = typeof t === 'function' ? t(tp.name_i18n_key, null, tp.id) : tp.id;
 8186 |             } else {
 8187 |                 if (newHour >= tp.start_hour && newHour < tp.end_hour) timeOfDay = typeof t === 'function' ? t(tp.name_i18n_key, null, tp.id) : tp.id;
 8188 |             }
 8189 |         }
 8190 |     }

 8719 | function levelUp() {

 8729 |         player.stats.level++;

 8731 |         levelsGainedThisCycle++;

 8768 | function handleStatIncrease(event) {

 8771 |     const validStats = ['str', 'dex', 'int', 'con', 'cha', 'res'];

 8781 |         player.stats.hp = Math.min((player.stats.hp || 0) + hpDiff, player.stats.maxHp);
 8782 |     }

 8784 |         player.inventoryCapacity = 10 + Math.floor((player.stats.str - 10) / 2);

10767 | async function loadPromptFromFile(filePath) {
10768 |     try {
10769 |         if (typeof window.ensureRuntimeDataLoaded === 'function' && !window.RUNTIME_DATABASE) {
10770 |             await window.ensureRuntimeDataLoaded();

10775 |                 console.log(`РџСЂРѕРјРїС‚ СѓСЃРїРµС€РЅРѕ РїРѕР»СѓС‡РµРЅ РёР· runtime registry: ${filePath}`);
10776 |                 return runtimePrompt.content;
10777 |             }

10780 |         if (!response.ok) {

15721 | /**
15722 |  * Р Р°СЃСЃС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°РµС‚ СЌС„С„РµРєС‚РёРІРЅС‹Рµ С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°, СѓС‡РёС‚С‹РІР°СЏ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІС‹Рµ СЃС‚Р°С‚С‹,
15723 |  * Р±РѕРЅСѓСЃС‹ РѕС‚ СЌРєРёРїРёСЂРѕРІРєРё Рё РІСЂРµРјРµРЅРЅС‹Рµ СЌС„С„РµРєС‚С‹.
15724 |  * @returns {{effectiveStats: object, bonuses: object}} РћР±СЉРµРєС‚ СЃ РёС‚РѕРіРѕРІС‹РјРё С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєР°РјРё Рё Р±РѕРЅСѓСЃР°РјРё.
15725 |  */
15726 | function getEffectiveStats() {
15727 |     if (!player) return { effectiveStats: {}, bonuses: {}, breakdown: {} };
15728 | 
15729 |     const effectiveStats = structuredClone(player.stats);
15730 |     const bonuses = {};
15731 |     const breakdown = {};
15732 | 
15733 |     const statsToTrack = ['str', 'dex', 'int', 'con', 'cha', 'res', 'hp', 'mana'];
15734 |     statsToTrack.forEach(s => {
15735 |         bonuses[s] = 0;
15736 |         breakdown[s] = [];
15737 |     });
15738 | 
15739 |     if (player.container_equipment) {
15740 |         const eqCont = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_equipment);
15741 |         if (eqCont) {
15742 |             (eqCont.items || []).forEach(itemId => {
15743 |                 const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
15744 |                 if (item && item.custom_props && Array.isArray(item.custom_props.effects)) {
15745 |                     item.custom_props.effects.forEach(effect => {
15746 |                         const stat = effect.stat?.toLowerCase();
15747 |                         if (statsToTrack.includes(stat)) {
15748 |                             const change = Number(effect.change) || 0;
15749 |                             bonuses[stat] += change;
15750 |                             effectiveStats[stat] += (stat === 'hp' || stat === 'mana') ? 0 : change;
15751 | 
15752 |                             breakdown[stat].push({
15753 |                                 name: item.custom_props.name || item.prototype_id,
15754 |                                 change: change
15755 |                             });
15756 |                         }
15757 |                     });
15758 |                 }
15759 |             });
15760 |         }
15761 |     }
15762 | 
15763 |     const totalWeight = CoreInventorySystemAsync.getContainerWeight(player.container_backpack) + CoreInventorySystemAsync.getContainerWeight(player.container_equipment);
15764 |     const carryLimit = effectiveStats.str * 5;
15765 |     if (totalWeight > carryLimit) {
15766 |         const penalty = Math.floor((totalWeight - carryLimit) / 10) + 1;
15767 |         bonuses['dex'] -= penalty;
15768 |         effectiveStats.dex -= penalty;
15769 |         breakdown['dex'].push({ name: "РџРµСЂРµРіСЂСѓР· (Р’РµСЃ)", change: -penalty });
15770 |     }
15771 | 
15772 | 
15773 |     effectiveStats.maxHp = calculateMaxHp(effectiveStats.con) + bonuses['hp'];
15774 |     if (player.class === 'mage') {
15775 |         effectiveStats.maxMana = calculateMaxMana(effectiveStats.int, player.stats.level) + bonuses['mana'];
15776 |     }
15777 | 
15778 |     return { effectiveStats, bonuses, breakdown };
15779 | }
