17097 | function createRulerForFaction(id, faction, era, isHeir = false) {
17098 |     const names = ["Alpha", "Beta", "Gamma", "Delta", "Epsilon", "Zeta", "Eta", "Theta", "Iota", "Kappa"];
17099 |     let name = (isHeir ? "Heir " : "Ruler ") + names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)];
17100 |     const personalityDefaults = getRulerEntityPersonalityDefaults();
17101 |     let baseWisdom = getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('wisdom_min') + Math.floor(Math.random() * getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('wisdom_range'));
17102 |     let baseCruelty = getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('cruelty_min') + Math.floor(Math.random() * getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('cruelty_range'));
17103 |     let baseDiplomacy = getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('diplomacy_min') + Math.floor(Math.random() * getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('diplomacy_range'));
17104 |     let baseMilitary = getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('military_min') + Math.floor(Math.random() * getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('military_range'));
17105 | 
17106 |     return {
17107 |         id: id,
17108 |         name: name,
17109 |         factionId: faction.id || id.replace("_heir", ""),
17110 |         type: "ruler",
17111 |         stats: { hp: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('hp'), maxHp: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('hp'), str: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('strength'), dex: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('dexterity'), int: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('intelligence'), con: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('constitution'), cha: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('charisma'), res: getRulerEntityDefaultStat('resilience') },
17112 |         personality: {
17113 |             ambition: getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('ambition_min') + Math.floor(Math.random() * getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('ambition_range')),
17114 |             paranoia: getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('paranoia_min') + Math.floor(Math.random() * getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('paranoia_range')),
17115 |             wisdom: baseWisdom + Math.floor(Math.random() * ((getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('wisdom_variance') * 2) + 1)) - getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('wisdom_variance'),
17116 |             cruelty: baseCruelty + Math.floor(Math.random() * ((getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('cruelty_variance') * 2) + 1)) - getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('cruelty_variance'),
17117 |             diplomacy: baseDiplomacy + Math.floor(Math.random() * ((getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('diplomacy_variance') * 2) + 1)) - getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('diplomacy_variance'),
17118 |             military: baseMilitary + Math.floor(Math.random() * ((getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('military_variance') * 2) + 1)) - getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('military_variance'),
17119 |             stewardship: getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('stewardship_min') + Math.floor(Math.random() * getRulerEntityPersonalityNumber('stewardship_range'))
17120 |         },
17121 |         traits: ["РђРјР±РёС†РёРѕР·РЅС‹Р№", "РҐРёС‚СЂС‹Р№"],
17122 |         health: requireRuntimeNumber(getRulerEntityCommandDefaults().health_percent, 'gameplay_runtime.command_defaults.ruler_entity.health_percent'),
17123 |         alive: true,
17124 |         heir: isHeir ? null : id + "_heir",
17125 |         currentGoal: null,
17126 |         gmOverride: null,
17127 |         lastTickDay: 0
17128 |     };
17129 | }

17134 | function checkRulerDeaths() {
17135 |     for (let rId in World.rulers) {
17136 |         let r = World.rulers[rId];

17228 | function checkRulerDeaths() {
17229 |     for (let rId in World.rulers) {
17230 |         let r = World.rulers[rId];
17231 |         if (r.alive && (r.health <= 0 || r.stats.hp <= 0)) {
17232 |             r.alive = false;
17233 |             if (World.npcs[rId]) World.npcs[rId].isAlive = false; // РЎРёРЅС…СЂРѕРЅРёР·Р°С†РёСЏ СЃ NPC
17234 |             
17235 |             if (r.heir && World.rulers[r.heir]) {
17236 |                 let heir = World.rulers[r.heir];
17237 |                 World.factions[r.factionId].rulerId = heir.id;
17238 |                 generateWorldNews(`РЎРњР•РќРђ Р’Р›РђРЎРўР: ${r.name} РјРµСЂС‚РІ. РўСЂРѕРЅ Р·Р°РЅРёРјР°РµС‚ ${heir.name}.`, "global", 5, 'misc');
17239 |                 
17240 |                 // РќР°СЃР»РµРґРЅРёРє СЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІРёС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂР°РІРёС‚РµР»РµРј
17241 |                 let newRulerId = r.factionId + "_ruler_" + Date.now();
17242 |                 heir.id = newRulerId;
17243 |                 heir.aiIdentifier = newRulerId;
17244 |                 heir.profession = "РџСЂР°РІРёС‚РµР»СЊ";
17245 |                 World.rulers[newRulerId] = heir;
17246 |                 World.npcs[newRulerId] = heir; // Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»СЏРµРј РІ NPC
17247 |                 World.factions[r.factionId].rulerId = newRulerId;
17248 |                 
17249 |                 // РЎРѕР·РґР°РµРј РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РЅР°СЃР»РµРґРЅРёРєР°
17250 |                 let newHeirId = r.factionId + "_heir_" + Date.now();

17252 |                 World.rulers[newHeirId] = newHeir;
17253 |                 World.npcs[newHeirId] = newHeir;
17254 |                 heir.heir = newHeirId;
17255 |

17257 |                 delete World.npcs[r.heir];
17258 |             } else {
17259 |                 generateWorldNews(`РљР РР—РРЎ: ${r.name} РјРµСЂС‚РІ, Рё РЅР°СЃР»РµРґРЅРёРєРѕРІ РЅРµС‚! Р¤СЂР°РєС†РёСЏ РїРѕРіСЂСѓР¶Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ РІ С…Р°РѕСЃ.`, "global", 5, 'disaster');

17300 |

17308 |                 products.push(...Object.keys(r.outputs));
17309 |             }
17310 |         });
17311 |     }
17312 |     return [...new Set(products)];

17871 | async function performAiPlayerFetch(systemInstruction, history, providerModel, currentInput) {

17881 |         });

17884 |

17889 |         else if (targetUrl.endsWith('/v1')) targetUrl += '/chat/completions';
17890 |

17895 |         headers['HTTP-Referer'] = "https://github.com/MrKins/Chronicles-of-Meterea";
17896 |         headers['X-Title'] = "Chronicles of Meterea Auto-Tester";

17900 |         headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + aiPlayerApiKey;

17902 |     } else if (aiPlayerProvider === 'gemini') {

  67 |     def load_image(self):
  68 |         path = filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("PNG", "*.png")])
  69 |         if not path: return
  70 |         
  71 |         self.img_source = Image.open(path).convert("RGBA")
  72 |         # Увеличиваем для удобства клика (визуально)
  73 |         display_scale = 2
  74 |         w, h = self.img_source.size
  75 |         self.display_img = self.img_source.resize((w*display_scale, h*display_scale), Image.NEAREST)
  76 |         self.photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(self.display_img)
  77 |         
  78 |         self.canvas.delete("all")
  79 |         self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, image=self.photo, anchor="nw")
  80 |         self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, w*display_scale, h*display_scale))
  81 |         self.scale_factor = display_scale
  82 | 
  83 |     def on_canvas_click(self, event):
  84 |         if not self.img_source: return
  85 |         
  86 |         # Пересчитываем клик в реальные пиксели картинки
  87 |         real_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x) / self.scale_factor
  88 |         real_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y) / self.scale_factor
  89 | 
  90 |         # Вычисляем колонку и строку (x тайла и y тайла)
  91 |         # Учитываем отступ 1px между тайлами
  92 |         tile_x = int(real_x // (self.tile_size + self.spacing))
  93 |         tile_y = int(real_y // (self.tile_size + self.spacing))
  94 | 
  95 |         self.selected_coords = (tile_x, tile_y)
  96 |         
  97 |         # Рисуем рамку выбора
  98 |         self.canvas.delete("selector")
  99 |         sel_x = tile_x * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.scale_factor
 100 |         sel_y = tile_y * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.scale_factor
 101 |         size = self.tile_size * self.scale_factor
 102 |         self.canvas.create_rectangle(sel_x, sel_y, sel_x+size, sel_y+size, outline="cyan", width=2, tags="selector")
 103 | 
 104 |         self.update_preview(tile_x, tile_y)
 105 | 
 106 |     def update_preview(self, tx, ty):
 107 |         # Вырезаем тайл из оригинала
 108 |         x0 = tx * (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 109 |         y0 = ty * (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 110 |         tile_img = self.img_source.crop((x0, y0, x0+self.tile_size, y0+self.tile_size))
 111 |         tile_img = tile_img.resize((64, 64), Image.NEAREST)
 112 |         self.preview_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(tile_img)
 113 |         self.preview_canvas.create_image(0, 0, image=self.preview_photo, anchor="nw")
 114 | 
 115 |     def add_mapping(self):
 116 |         tile_id = self.id_entry.get().strip()
 117 |         if not tile_id:
 118 |             messagebox.showwarning("Внимание", "Введите ID тайла!")
 119 |             return
 120 |         
 121 |         self.mappings[tile_id] = {"x": self.selected_coords[0], "y": self.selected_coords[1]}
 122 |         self.refresh_list()
 123 |         self.id_entry.delete(0, tk.END)
 124 | 
 125 |     def refresh_list(self):
 126 |         self.listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
 127 |         for k, v in sorted(self.mappings.items()):
 128 |             self.listbox.insert(tk.END, f"{k}: x={v['x']}, y={v['y']}")
 129 | 
 130 |     def copy_json(self):

 132 |         self.root.clipboard_clear()

 186 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 187 |     #  Прокрутка и панорамирование
 188 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 189 |     def update_scrollregion(self):
 190 |         """Обновить область прокрутки после изменения содержимого канваса"""
 191 |         if not self.img_source:
 192 |             return
 193 |         w, h = self.img_source.size
 194 |         display_w = w * self.zoom
 195 |         display_h = h * self.zoom
 196 |         self.canvas.config(scrollregion=(0, 0, display_w, display_h))
 197 | 
 198 |     def on_mousewheel(self, event):
 199 |         """Обработка колесика мыши"""
 200 |         if event.delta:
 201 |             # Windows / Mac
 202 |             delta = int(event.delta / 120)
 203 |         else:
 204 |             # Linux (Button-4 = up, Button-5 = down)
 205 |             delta = 1 if event.num == 4 else -1
 206 |         if event.state & 0x0001:  # Shift зажат -> горизонтальная прокрутка
 207 |             self.canvas.xview_scroll(-delta, "units")
 208 |         else:
 209 |             self.canvas.yview_scroll(-delta, "units")
 210 | 
 211 |     def drag_start(self, event):
 212 |         self.drag_start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
 213 |         self.drag_start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
 214 | 
 215 |     def drag_move(self, event):
 216 |         dx = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x) - self.drag_start_x
 217 |         dy = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y) - self.drag_start_y
 218 |         self.canvas.move("all", dx, dy)
 219 |         self.drag_start_x = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
 220 |         self.drag_start_y = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
 221 |         self.update_scrollregion()
 222 | 
 223 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 224 |     #  Отрисовка (с обновлением scrollregion)
 225 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 226 |     def redraw_canvas_full(self):
 227 |         if not self.img_source:
 228 |             return
 229 |         self.canvas.delete("all")
 230 |         w, h = self.img_source.size
 231 |         display_w = w * self.zoom
 232 |         display_h = h * self.zoom
 233 |         self.display_img = self.img_source.resize((display_w, display_h), Image.NEAREST)
 234 |         self.photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(self.display_img)
 235 |         self.canvas.create_image(0, 0, image=self.photo, anchor="nw")
 236 | 
 237 |         step = (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 238 |         for x in range(0, display_w, step):
 239 |             self.canvas.create_line(x, 0, x, display_h, fill="#444", width=1, tags="grid")
 240 |         for y in range(0, display_h, step):
 241 |             self.canvas.create_line(0, y, display_w, y, fill="#444", width=1, tags="grid")
 242 | 
 243 |         self.mapping_rects.clear()
 244 |         for tid, pos in self.mappings.items():
 245 |             tx, ty = pos["x"], pos["y"]
 246 |             self._draw_mapping_rect(tx, ty)
 247 | 
 248 |         self._redraw_all_selections()
 249 |         self._draw_current_highlight()
 250 |         self.update_scrollregion()
 251 | 
 252 |     def _draw_mapping_rect(self, tx, ty):
 253 |         x0 = tx * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 254 |         y0 = ty * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 255 |         size = self.tile_size * self.zoom
 256 |         rect_id = self.canvas.create_rectangle(x0, y0, x0+size, y0+size, outline="#2ecc71", width=2, tags="mapping")
 257 |         self.mapping_rects[(tx, ty)] = rect_id
 258 |         return rect_id
 259 | 
 260 |     def _remove_mapping_rect(self, tx, ty):
 261 |         if (tx, ty) in self.mapping_rects:
 262 |             self.canvas.delete(self.mapping_rects[(tx, ty)])
 263 |             del self.mapping_rects[(tx, ty)]
 264 | 
 265 |     def _draw_selection_rect(self, tx, ty):
 266 |         x0 = tx * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 267 |         y0 = ty * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 268 |         size = self.tile_size * self.zoom
 269 |         rect_id = self.canvas.create_rectangle(x0, y0, x0+size, y0+size, outline="#f1c40f", width=3, tags="selection")
 270 |         self.selection_rects[(tx, ty)] = rect_id
 271 |         return rect_id
 272 | 
 273 |     def _remove_selection_rect(self, tx, ty):
 274 |         if (tx, ty) in self.selection_rects:
 275 |             self.canvas.delete(self.selection_rects[(tx, ty)])
 276 |             del self.selection_rects[(tx, ty)]
 277 | 
 278 |     def _redraw_all_selections(self):
 279 |         for rect_id in self.selection_rects.values():
 280 |             self.canvas.delete(rect_id)
 281 |         self.selection_rects.clear()
 282 |         for (tx, ty) in self.selected_tiles:
 283 |             self._draw_selection_rect(tx, ty)
 284 | 
 285 |     def _draw_current_highlight(self):
 286 |         if self.current_highlight:
 287 |             self.canvas.delete(self.current_highlight)
 288 |         tx, ty = self.selected_coords
 289 |         x0 = tx * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 290 |         y0 = ty * (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 291 |         size = self.tile_size * self.zoom
 292 |         self.current_highlight = self.canvas.create_rectangle(x0, y0, x0+size, y0+size, outline="#00ffff", width=3, tags="current")
 293 | 
 294 |     def add_mapping_visual(self, tile_id, x, y):
 295 |         self._draw_mapping_rect(x, y)
 296 |         if (x, y) in self.selected_tiles:
 297 |             self.selected_tiles.remove((x, y))
 298 |             self._remove_selection_rect(x, y)
 299 | 
 300 |     def remove_mapping_visual(self, x, y):
 301 |         self._remove_mapping_rect(x, y)
 302 | 
 303 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 304 |     #  Выделение
 305 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 306 |     def clear_selection(self):
 307 |         for (x, y) in self.selected_tiles:
 308 |             self._remove_selection_rect(x, y)
 309 |         self.selected_tiles.clear()
 310 | 
 311 |     def toggle_selection(self, x, y):
 312 |         if self.is_tile_mapped(x, y):
 313 |             self.update_status(f"Тайл ({x},{y}) уже размечен", "#e74c3c")
 314 |             return
 315 |         if (x, y) in self.selected_tiles:
 316 |             self.selected_tiles.remove((x, y))
 317 |             self._remove_selection_rect(x, y)
 318 |             self.update_status(f"Тайл ({x},{y}) убран из выделения", "#f39c12")
 319 |         else:
 320 |             self.selected_tiles.append((x, y))
 321 |             self._draw_selection_rect(x, y)
 322 |             self.update_status(f"Тайл ({x},{y}) добавлен (всего {len(self.selected_tiles)})", "#2ecc71")
 323 | 
 324 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 325 |     #  Обработчики кликов
 326 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 327 |     def on_canvas_click(self, event):
 328 |         if not self.img_source:
 329 |             return
 330 |         cx = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
 331 |         cy = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
 332 |         step = (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 333 |         tx = int(cx // step)
 334 |         ty = int(cy // step)
 335 |         max_x = self.img_source.width // (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 336 |         max_y = self.img_source.height // (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 337 |         if 0 <= tx < max_x and 0 <= ty < max_y:
 338 |             if event.state & 0x0001:  # Shift
 339 |                 self.toggle_selection(tx, ty)
 340 |             else:
 341 |                 self.clear_selection()
 342 |                 self.selected_coords = (tx, ty)
 343 |                 self._draw_current_highlight()
 344 |                 self.update_preview()
 345 |                 existing_id = self.get_id_at(tx, ty)
 346 |                 if existing_id:
 347 |                     self.id_entry.delete(0, tk.END)
 348 |                     self.id_entry.insert(0, existing_id)
 349 |                 else:
 350 |                     self.id_entry.delete(0, tk.END)
 351 | 
 352 |     def on_canvas_right_click(self, event):
 353 |         if not self.img_source:
 354 |             return
 355 |         cx = self.canvas.canvasx(event.x)
 356 |         cy = self.canvas.canvasy(event.y)
 357 |         step = (self.tile_size + self.spacing) * self.zoom
 358 |         tx = int(cx // step)
 359 |         ty = int(cy // step)
 360 |         existing_id = self.get_id_at(tx, ty)
 361 |         if existing_id and messagebox.askyesno("Удалить", f"Удалить '{existing_id}'?"):
 362 |             del self.mappings[existing_id]
 363 |             self.remove_mapping_visual(tx, ty)
 364 |             self.refresh_listbox()
 365 |             self.update_status(f"Удалён {existing_id}", "#e67e22")
 366 | 
 367 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 368 |     #  Вспомогательные методы
 369 |     # ------------------------------------------------------------
 370 |     def update_preview(self):
 371 |         if not self.img_source:
 372 |             return
 373 |         tx, ty = self.selected_coords
 374 |         cache_key = (tx, ty, self.tile_size, self.spacing)
 375 |         if cache_key in self.preview_cache:
 376 |             disp = self.preview_cache[cache_key]
 377 |         else:
 378 |             x0 = tx * (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 379 |             y0 = ty * (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 380 |             self.current_tile_img = self.img_source.crop((x0, y0, x0+self.tile_size, y0+self.tile_size))
 381 |             disp = self.current_tile_img.resize((128, 128), Image.NEAREST)
 382 |             self.preview_cache[cache_key] = disp
 383 |         self.preview_photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(disp)
 384 |         self.preview_canvas.delete("all")
 385 |         self.preview_canvas.create_image(0, 0, image=self.preview_photo, anchor="nw")
 386 | 
 387 |     def get_id_at(self, tx, ty):
 388 |         for tid, pos in self.mappings.items():
 389 |             if pos["x"] == tx and pos["y"] == ty:
 390 |                 return tid
 391 |         return None
 392 | 
 393 |     def is_tile_mapped(self, x, y):
 394 |         return any(pos["x"] == x and pos["y"] == y for pos in self.mappings.values())
 395 | 
 396 |     def add_mapping(self):
 397 |         tile_id = self.id_entry.get().strip()
 398 |         if not tile_id:
 399 |             messagebox.showwarning("Пустой ID", "Введите ID")
 400 |             return
 401 |         if tile_id in self.mappings and not messagebox.askyesno("Заменить?", f"ID '{tile_id}' уже существует. Заменить?"):
 402 |             return
 403 |         tx, ty = self.selected_coords
 404 |         old_id = self.get_id_at(tx, ty)
 405 |         if old_id:
 406 |             del self.mappings[old_id]
 407 |             self.remove_mapping_visual(tx, ty)
 408 |         self.mappings[tile_id] = {"x": tx, "y": ty}
 409 |         self.add_mapping_visual(tile_id, tx, ty)
 410 |         self.refresh_listbox()
 411 |         self.id_entry.delete(0, tk.END)
 412 |         self.update_status(f"Добавлен {tile_id}", "#2ecc71")
 413 |         self.jump_to_next_unmapped()
 414 | 
 415 |     def refresh_listbox(self):
 416 |         self.listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
 417 |         for tid, pos in self.mappings.items():
 418 |             self.listbox.insert(tk.END, f"{tid}  [{pos['x']},{pos['y']}]")
 419 | 
 420 |     def delete_mapping(self, event):
 421 |         sel = self.listbox.curselection()
 422 |         if sel:
 423 |             line = self.listbox.get(sel[0])
 424 |             tid = line.split("[")[0].strip()
 425 |             if tid in self.mappings:
 426 |                 pos = self.mappings[tid]
 427 |                 self.remove_mapping_visual(pos["x"], pos["y"])
 428 |                 del self.mappings[tid]
 429 |                 self.refresh_listbox()
 430 |                 self.update_status(f"Удалён {tid}", "#e67e22")
 431 | 
 432 |     def edit_mapping(self, event):
 433 |         sel = self.listbox.curselection()
 434 |         if sel:
 435 |             line = self.listbox.get(sel[0])
 436 |             old = line.split("[")[0].strip()
 437 |             new = simpledialog.askstring("Редактировать", "Новое имя:", initialvalue=old)
 438 |             if new and new != old:
 439 |                 pos = self.mappings.pop(old)
 440 |                 self.mappings[new] = pos
 441 |                 self.refresh_listbox()
 442 |                 self.update_status(f"Переименован {old} → {new}", "#f39c12")
 443 | 
 444 |     def undo_last(self):
 445 |         if self.listbox.size() > 0:
 446 |             last = self.listbox.get(tk.END)
 447 |             tid = last.split("[")[0].strip()
 448 |             if tid in self.mappings:
 449 |                 pos = self.mappings[tid]
 450 |                 self.remove_mapping_visual(pos["x"], pos["y"])
 451 |                 del self.mappings[tid]
 452 |                 self.refresh_listbox()
 453 |                 self.update_status(f"Отменён {tid}", "#e67e22")
 454 | 
 455 |     def jump_to_next_unmapped(self):
 456 |         if not self.img_source:
 457 |             return
 458 |         max_x = self.img_source.width // (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 459 |         max_y = self.img_source.height // (self.tile_size + self.spacing)
 460 |         cx, cy = self.selected_coords
 461 |         for x in range(cx+1, max_x):
 462 |             if not self.is_tile_mapped(x, cy):
 463 |                 self.selected_coords = (x, cy)
 464 |                 self._draw_current_highlight()
 465 |                 self.update_preview()
 466 |                 self.id_entry.delete(0, tk.END)
 467 |                 return
 468 |         for y in range(cy+1, max_y):
 469 |             for x in range(max_x):
 470 |                 if not self.is_tile_mapped(x, y):
 471 |                     self.selected_coords = (x, y)
 472 |                     self._draw_current_highlight()
 473 |                     self.update_preview()
 474 |                     self.id_entry.delete(0, tk.END)
 475 |                     return
 476 |         messagebox.showinfo("Готово", "Все тайлы размечены!")
 477 |

 479 |     #  Загрузка / сохранение

 481 |     def load_image(self):
 482 |         path = filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("PNG images", "*.png")])
 483 |         if not path:
 484 |             return
 485 |         self.img_source = Image.open(path).convert("RGBA")
 486 |         self.mappings.clear()
 487 |         self.listbox.delete(0, tk.END)
 488 |         self.project_path = None
 489 |         self.clear_selection()
 490 |         self.selected_coords = (0, 0)
 491 |         self.redraw_canvas_full()
 492 |         self.update_status(f"Загружен {os.path.basename(path)}", "#2ecc71")
 493 | 
 494 |     def update_grid_settings(self):
 495 |         self.tile_size = self.tile_size_var.get()
 496 |         self.spacing = self.spacing_var.get()
 497 |         if self.img_source:
 498 |             self.redraw_canvas_full()
 499 | 
 500 |     def save_project(self):
 501 |         if not self.img_source:
 502 |             messagebox.showwarning("Нет спрайт-листа", "Сначала загрузите изображение")
 503 |             return
 504 |         path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension=".json", filetypes=[("Meterea project", "*.json")])
 505 |         if not path:
 506 |             return
 507 |         data = {
 508 |             "version": "1.0",
 509 |             "image_path": getattr(self.img_source, 'filename', ''),
 510 |             "tile_size": self.tile_size,
 511 |             "spacing": self.spacing,
 512 |             "zoom": self.zoom,
 513 |             "mappings": self.mappings
 514 |         }
 515 |         with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 516 |             json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
 517 |         self.project_path = path
 518 |         self.update_status(f"Сохранён {os.path.basename(path)}", "#2ecc71")
 519 | 
 520 |     def load_project(self):
 521 |         path = filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("Meterea project", "*.json")])
 522 |         if not path:
 523 |             return
 524 |         with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
 525 |             data = json.load(f)
 526 |         self.tile_size = data.get("tile_size", 16)
 527 |         self.spacing = data.get("spacing", 1)
 528 |         self.tile_size_var.set(self.tile_size)
 529 |         self.spacing_var.set(self.spacing)
 530 |         img_path = data.get("image_path")
 531 |         if img_path and os.path.exists(img_path):
 532 |             self.img_source = Image.open(img_path).convert("RGBA")
 533 |             self.img_source.filename = img_path
 534 |         else:
 535 |             self.load_image()
 536 |             if not self.img_source:
 537 |                 return
 538 |         self.mappings = data.get("mappings", {})
 539 |         self.refresh_listbox()
 540 |         self.clear_selection()
 541 |         self.selected_coords = (0, 0)
 542 |         self.redraw_canvas_full()

 643 |     def _process_selected_tiles(self, tiles):

 645 |         processed = 0
 646 |         for i in range(0, total, BATCH_SIZE):

 697 |     def process_batch_grouped(self, tiles):

 699 |         processed = 0
 700 |         for i in range(0, total, BATCH_SIZE):
 701 |             chunk = tiles[i:i+BATCH_SIZE]

 725 |     def send_batch_request(self, chunk):
 726 |         content = [{"type": "text", "text": f"You will receive {len(chunk)} tile images. For each image, output a JSON array of strings in snake_case describing the tile. Example: [\"dark_purple_tile\", \"stone_wall\", \"grass_center\"]. Order must match the order of images."}]
 727 |         for (x, y) in chunk:
 728 |             x0 = x*(self.tile_size+self.spacing)
 729 |             y0 = y*(self.tile_size+self.spacing)
 730 |             tile_img = self.img_source.crop((x0, y0, x0+self.tile_size, y0+self.tile_size))
 731 |             img = tile_img.convert("RGB").resize((256, 256), Image.LANCZOS)
 732 |             buffered = io.BytesIO()
 733 |             img.save(buffered, format="JPEG", quality=75)
 734 |             img_b64 = base64.b64encode(buffered.getvalue()).decode('utf-8')
 735 |             content.append({"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{img_b64}"}})
 736 | 
 737 |         payload = {
 738 |             "model": VISION_MODEL,
 739 |             "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}],
 740 |             "max_tokens": 200,
 741 |             "temperature": 0.2
 742 |             # NOTE: response_format json_object is intentionally NOT set here.
 743 |             # The AI is asked to return a JSON array of names, but json_object
 744 |             # wraps the response in {"result": [...]}, complicating extraction.
 745 |             # Without it, the regex below extracts the array directly.
 746 |         }
 747 |         headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LLMOST_API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
 748 |         try:
 749 |             resp = requests.post(f"{LLMOST_BASE_URL}/chat/completions", json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=60)
 750 |             if resp.status_code == 200:
 751 |                 data = resp.json()
 752 |                 answer = data['choices'][0]['message']['content'].strip()
 753 |                 # Try direct JSON parse first (if model returns a bare array)
 754 |                 try:
 755 |                     names = json.loads(answer)
 756 |                     if not isinstance(names, list):
 757 |                         # Model returned an object — extract the array field
 758 |                         for v in names.values():
 759 |                             if isinstance(v, list):
 760 |                                 names = v
 761 |                                 break
 762 |                         else:
 763 |                             names = []
 764 |                 except json.JSONDecodeError:
 765 |                     # Fallback: regex extraction for partial/malformed JSON
 766 |                     match = re.search(r'\[.*\]', answer, re.DOTALL)
 767 |                     names = json.loads(match.group(0)) if match else []
 768 |                 results = []
 769 |                 for idx, (x, y) in enumerate(chunk):
 770 |                     name = names[idx] if idx < len(names) else "unknown"
 771 |                     name = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9_]', '_', name).strip('_')
 772 |                     if not name:
 773 |                         name = "unknown"
 774 |                     results.append((x, y, name))
 775 |                 return results
 776 |             else:
 777 |                 return [(x, y, None) for (x, y) in chunk]
 778 |         except Exception as e:
 779 |             return [(x, y, None) for (x, y) in chunk]

  73 |     def load_image(self):
  74 |         self.image_path = filedialog.askopenfilename(filetypes=[("PNG files", "*.png")])
  75 |         if not self.image_path: return
  76 |         self.image = Image.open(self.image_path).convert("RGBA")
  77 |         
  78 |         preview = self.image.copy()
  79 |         preview.thumbnail((420, 420))
  80 |         self.photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(preview)
  81 |         self.preview_label.config(image=self.photo)
  82 |         self.status.config(text=f"Загружено: {os.path.basename(self.image_path)}", fg="green")
  83 | 
  84 |     def show_grid_preview(self):
  85 |         if not self.image:
  86 |             messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", "Сначала загрузи файл!")
  87 |             return
  88 |         
  89 |         # Создаём превью
  90 |         preview = self.image.copy()
  91 |         preview.thumbnail((420, 420))
  92 |         w, h = preview.size
  93 |         orig_w, orig_h = self.image.size
  94 |         scale = w / orig_w
  95 |         
  96 |         draw = ImageDraw.Draw(preview)
  97 |         
  98 |         cols = self.cols_var.get()
  99 |         rows = self.rows_var.get()
 100 |         cell_w = self.cell_w_var.get() * scale
 101 |         cell_h = self.cell_h_var.get() * scale
 102 |         h_pad = self.h_pad_var.get() * scale
 103 |         offset_x = self.offset_x_var.get() * scale
 104 |         offset_y = self.offset_y_var.get() * scale
 105 |         
 106 |         # Вертикальные линии
 107 |         for j in range(1, cols):
 108 |             x = offset_x + j * (cell_w + h_pad)
 109 |             draw.line([(x, 0), (x, h)], fill="red", width=3)
 110 |         
 111 |         # Горизонтальные линии
 112 |         for i in range(1, rows):
 113 |             y = offset_y + i * (cell_h + h_pad)
 114 |             draw.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill="red", width=3)
 115 |         
 116 |         # Рамка вокруг
 117 |         draw.rectangle([offset_x, offset_y, w-1, h-1], outline="red", width=3)
 118 |         
 119 |         self.photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(preview)
 120 |         self.preview_label.config(image=self.photo)
 121 |         self.status.config(text="Сетка наложена! Подгоняй параметры и жми кнопку снова", fg="#FF9800")
 122 | 
 123 |     def split(self):
 124 |         if not self.image:
 125 |             messagebox.showerror("Ошибка", "Загрузи файл!")
 126 |             return
 127 |         
 128 |         # тот же код разделения, что раньше (с удалением белого фона)
 129 |         cols = self.cols_var.get()
 130 |         rows = self.rows_var.get()
 131 |         cell_w = self.cell_w_var.get()
 132 |         cell_h = self.cell_h_var.get()
 133 |         h_pad = self.h_pad_var.get()
 134 |         offset_x = self.offset_x_var.get()
 135 |         offset_y = self.offset_y_var.get()
 136 |         
 137 |         output_dir = "output_swords"
 138 |         os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
 139 |         
 140 |         count = 0
 141 |         for i in range(rows):
 142 |             for j in range(cols):
 143 |                 left = offset_x + j * (cell_w + h_pad)
 144 |                 top = offset_y + i * (cell_h + h_pad)
 145 |                 right = left + cell_w
 146 |                 bottom = top + cell_h
 147 |                 
 148 |                 cell = self.image.crop((left, top, right, bottom))
 149 |                 
 150 |                 # Удаляем белый фон
 151 |                 data = cell.getdata()
 152 |                 new_data = [(r, g, b, 0) if (r, g, b) == (255, 255, 255) else (r, g, b, a) for r, g, b, a in data]
 153 |                 cell.putdata(new_data)
 154 |                 
 155 |                 random_name = f"item_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.png"
 156 |                 cell.save(os.path.join(output_dir, random_name))
 157 |                 count += 1
 158 |         
 159 |         messagebox.showinfo("ГОТОВО!", f"Готово! {count} предметов с прозрачным фоном\nПапка: {os.path.abspath(output_dir)}")

 106 | // Minimal EventBus
 107 | const EventBus = {
 108 |     _listeners: {},
 109 |     on(event, callback) {
 110 |         if (!this._listeners[event]) this._listeners[event] = [];
 111 |         const entry = { callback, once: false };
 112 |         this._listeners[event].push(entry);
 113 |         return () => { const list = this._listeners[event]; if (list) { const idx = list.indexOf(entry); if (idx !== -1) list.splice(idx, 1); } };
 114 |     },
 115 |     once(event, callback) { if (!this._listeners[event]) this._listeners[event] = []; this._listeners[event].push({ callback, once: true }); },
 116 |     emit(event, data) {
 117 |         const list = this._listeners[event]; if (!list) return;
 118 |         for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { try { list[i].callback(data); } catch (e) { console.error(`[EventBus] Error in handler for '${event}':`, e); } if (list[i] && list[i].once) { list.splice(i, 1); } }
 119 |     },
 120 |     off(event, callback) { const list = this._listeners[event]; if (!list) return; this._listeners[event] = list.filter(entry => entry.callback !== callback); }
 121 | };
 122 | window.EventBus = EventBus;

 124 | // GameRNG (seeded PRNG)
 125 | const GameRNG = {
 126 |     _seed: 42,
 127 |     seed(s) { this._seed = s >>> 0; },
 128 |     next() { let t = this._seed += 0x6D2B79F5; t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; },
 129 |     roll(min, max) { return Math.floor(this.next() * (max - min + 1)) + min; },
 130 |     d20(modifier = 0) { return this.roll(1, 20) + modifier; }
 131 | };

 138 | let player = null;
 139 | let World = { npcs: {}, regions: {} };
 140 | let itemsReferenceData = null;
 141 | 
 142 | function resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId) {
 143 |     if (!containerId) return containerId;
 144 |     if (containerId === 'player' || containerId === 'player_inventory' || containerId === 'player_backpack') return player?.container_backpack || null;
 145 |     if (containerId === 'player_equipment') return player?.container_equipment || null;
 146 |     return containerId;
 147 | }
 148 | 
 149 | function resolveActorLocation(actorId) {
 150 |     if (!actorId) return null;
 151 |     if (actorId === 'player' && player) {
 152 |         return normalizeContainerLocation({ world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: 'player', parent_container: null, region_id: player.location || null });
 153 |     }
 154 |     if (ContainerRegistry.has(actorId)) {
 155 |         return resolveContainerLocation(actorId);
 156 |     }
 157 |     return null;
 158 | }
 159 | 
 160 | function resolveContainerLocation(containerId) {
 161 |     const resolvedId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
 162 |     if (!resolvedId) return null;
 163 |     const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedId);
 164 |     if (!cont) return null;
 165 |     const location = normalizeContainerLocation(cont.location);
 166 |     if (cont.type === 'magical_pocket') {
 167 |         return normalizeContainerLocation({ world_coords: null, parent_entity: cont.owner_id || null, parent_container: null, region_id: 'astral' });
 168 |     }
 169 |     if (location.parent_entity === 'player' || (cont.owner_id === 'player' && (cont.type === 'player_backpack' || cont.type === 'player_equipment'))) {
 170 |         location.parent_entity = 'player';
 171 |         location.region_id = player?.location || location.region_id;
 172 |     }
 173 |     return location;
 174 | }

 182 | // ============================================================================
 183 | // OldCoreInventorySystem — ПОЛНАЯ КОПИЯ из script.js (для изолированного тестирования)
 184 | // ============================================================================
 185 | 
 186 | const OldCoreInventorySystem = {
 187 |     createContainer: function(type, ownerId, maxWeight, maxSlots, locationData = null, extraData = {}) {
 188 |         const id = "cont_" + generateUUID();
 189 |         const defaultLocation = locationData || (
 190 |             ownerId === 'player' && (type === 'player_backpack' || type === 'player_equipment')
 191 |                 ? { world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: 'player', parent_container: null, region_id: player?.location || null }
 192 |                 : null
 193 |         );
 194 |         const container = {
 195 |             id: id,
 196 |             type: type,
 197 |             max_weight_kg: maxWeight,
 198 |             max_slots: maxSlots,
 199 |             owner_id: ownerId,
 200 |             location: normalizeContainerLocation(defaultLocation),
 201 |             lock_data: { is_locked: false, difficulty: 10, trap: null, ...(extraData.lock_data || {}) },
 202 |             physical_props: { health: 200, flammable: type !== 'faction_vault', ...(extraData.physical_props || {}) },
 203 |             custom_props: { ...(extraData.custom_props || {}) },
 204 |             items: []
 205 |         };
 206 |         setContainer(id, normalizeContainer(container));
 207 |         return id;
 208 |     },
 209 |     createItem: function(prototypeId, quantity, containerId, customProps = {}) {
 210 |         const proto = itemsReferenceData ? itemsReferenceData.find(i => i.id === prototypeId) : null;
 211 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
 212 |         const id = "item_" + generateUUID();
 213 |         let baseWeight = proto ? (proto.weight || 1) : 1;
 214 |         if (prototypeId === 'gold') baseWeight = 0.01;
 215 | 
 216 |         const reservedKeys = new Set(['flags', 'durability', 'slot_index', 'slot', 'state', 'created_at', 'last_moved_at']);
 217 |         const mergedCustomProps = {};
 218 |         Object.keys(customProps || {}).forEach(key => {
 219 |             if (!reservedKeys.has(key)) mergedCustomProps[key] = customProps[key];
 220 |         });
 221 | 
 222 |         const item = {
 223 |             id: id,
 224 |             prototype_id: prototypeId,
 225 |             name: proto ? proto.name : prototypeId,
 226 |             stack_size: quantity,
 227 |             container_id: resolvedContainerId,
 228 |             slot_index: customProps.slot_index ?? customProps.slot ?? null,
 229 |             state: customProps.state || "idle",
 230 |             flags: { quest_item: false, bound_to_owner: null, stolen: false, magical: false, fragile: false, ...(customProps.flags || {}) },
 231 |             durability: Number.isFinite(customProps.durability) ? customProps.durability : (proto ? (proto.durability || 100) : 100),
 232 |             custom_props: { weight_per_unit: baseWeight, name: customProps.name || proto?.name || prototypeId, ...mergedCustomProps },
 233 |             created_at: customProps.created_at ?? (player ? player.stats.turnCount : 0),
 234 |             last_moved_at: customProps.last_moved_at ?? (player ? player.stats.turnCount : 0)
 235 |         };
 236 |         ItemRegistry.set(id, item);
 237 |         if (resolvedContainerId && ContainerRegistry.has(resolvedContainerId)) {
 238 |             const targetCont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
 239 |             if (!targetCont.items) targetCont.items = [];
 240 |             targetCont.items.push(id);
 241 |         }
 242 |         return id;
 243 |     },
 244 |     getContainerWeight: function(containerId) {
 245 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
 246 |         if (!cont) return 0;
 247 |         return getContainerItems(cont).reduce((sum, itemId) => {
 248 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 249 |             return sum + (it ? (it.custom_props.weight_per_unit || 1) * it.stack_size : 0);
 250 |         }, 0);
 251 |     },
 252 |     findItemByPrototype: function(containerId, protoId) {
 253 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(containerId);
 254 |         if (!cont) return null;
 255 |         return getContainerItems(cont).find(id => {
 256 |             const it = ItemRegistry.get(id);
 257 |             return it && (it.prototype_id === protoId || it.custom_props?.aiIdentifier === protoId);
 258 |         });
 259 |     },
 260 |     moveItem: function(itemId, sourceContainerId, targetContainerId, quantity = null, options = {}) {
 261 |         if (!ItemRegistry.has(itemId)) return { success: false, error: "Item not found" };
 262 |         const actorId = options.actorId || 'player';
 263 |         const resolvedSourceId = resolveSpecialContainerId(sourceContainerId || ItemRegistry.get(itemId)?.container_id);
 264 |         const requestedTargetId = resolveSpecialContainerId(targetContainerId);
 265 |         let item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 266 | 
 267 |         if (!resolvedSourceId || !ContainerRegistry.has(resolvedSourceId)) return { success: false, error: "Source container not found" };
 268 |         if (item.container_id !== resolvedSourceId) return { success: false, error: "Item is not in the declared source container" };
 269 | 
 270 |         let actualTargetId = requestedTargetId;
 271 |         if (!actualTargetId) return { success: false, error: "No target container" };
 272 |         if (!ContainerRegistry.has(actualTargetId)) return { success: false, error: "Target container not found" };
 273 |         if (resolvedSourceId === actualTargetId) return { success: true, movedItemId: itemId, targetContainerId: actualTargetId, sourceContainerId: resolvedSourceId };
 274 | 
 275 |         const sourceContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedSourceId);
 276 |         const targetContainer = ContainerRegistry.get(actualTargetId);
 277 |         const requestedQuantity = quantity === null ? item.stack_size : parseInt(quantity, 10);
 278 |         if (!Number.isFinite(requestedQuantity) || requestedQuantity <= 0) return { success: false, error: "Invalid quantity" };
 279 |         if (requestedQuantity > item.stack_size) return { success: false, error: "Not enough quantity in stack" };
 280 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id && getContainerItems(targetContainer).length >= targetContainer.max_slots) return { success: false, error: "Target container is full (slots)" };
 281 | 
 282 |         const currentWeight = this.getContainerWeight(actualTargetId);
 283 |         const itemWeight = (item.custom_props.weight_per_unit || 1) * requestedQuantity;
 284 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id && currentWeight + itemWeight > targetContainer.max_weight_kg) {
 285 |             return { success: false, error: "Target container is full (weight)" };
 286 |         }
 287 | 
 288 |         let movingItem = item;
 289 |         let createdItemId = null;
 290 |         if (requestedQuantity < item.stack_size) {
 291 |             item.stack_size -= requestedQuantity;
 292 |             createdItemId = this.createItem(item.prototype_id, requestedQuantity, null, {
 293 |                 ...structuredClone(item.custom_props || {}),
 294 |                 flags: structuredClone(item.flags || {}),
 295 |                 durability: item.durability,
 296 |                 slot_index: item.slot_index,
 297 |                 state: item.state,
 298 |                 created_at: item.created_at,
 299 |                 last_moved_at: item.last_moved_at
 300 |             });
 301 |             movingItem = ItemRegistry.get(createdItemId);
 302 |         }
 303 | 
 304 |         if (!sourceContainer.items) sourceContainer.items = [];
 305 |         sourceContainer.items = sourceContainer.items.filter(id => id !== movingItem.id);
 306 |         if (sourceContainer.id !== targetContainer.id) {
 307 |             if (!targetContainer.items) targetContainer.items = [];
 308 |             targetContainer.items.push(movingItem.id);
 309 |         }
 310 |         movingItem.container_id = actualTargetId;
 311 | 
 312 |         const movedIntoPlayerOwned = player && (
 313 |             actualTargetId === player.container_backpack ||
 314 |             actualTargetId === player.container_equipment ||
 315 |             targetContainer.owner_id === 'player'
 316 |         );
 317 |         if (movedIntoPlayerOwned && sourceContainer.owner_id && sourceContainer.owner_id !== 'player') {
 318 |             movingItem.flags.stolen = true;
 319 |         }
 320 | 
 321 |         movingItem.last_moved_at = player ? player.stats.turnCount : 0;
 322 |         if (player && (movingItem.prototype_id === 'gold' || item.prototype_id === 'gold')) syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 323 | 
 324 |         return { success: true, movedItemId: movingItem.id, createdItemId, targetContainerId: actualTargetId, sourceContainerId: resolvedSourceId };
 325 |     },
 326 |     removeItem: function(itemId, quantity) {
 327 |         if (!ItemRegistry.has(itemId)) return false;
 328 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 329 |         const shouldSyncGold = item.prototype_id === 'gold' && item.container_id === player?.container_backpack;
 330 |         if (item.stack_size <= quantity) {
 331 |             if (item.container_id && ContainerRegistry.has(item.container_id)) {
 332 |                 const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(item.container_id);
 333 |                 if (!cont.items) cont.items = [];
 334 |                 cont.items = cont.items.filter(id => id !== itemId);
 335 |             }
 336 |             ItemRegistry.delete(itemId);
 337 |         } else {
 338 |             item.stack_size -= quantity;
 339 |         }
 340 |         if (shouldSyncGold) syncPlayerGoldFromInventory();
 341 |         return true;
 342 |     },
 343 |     destroyContainer: function(containerId) {
 344 |         const resolvedContainerId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
 345 |         const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedContainerId);
 346 |         if (!cont) return false;
 347 |         // Drop items to a ground pile (simplified — just remove them for test)
 348 |         const itemsToRemove = [...(cont.items || [])];
 349 |         itemsToRemove.forEach(itemId => ItemRegistry.delete(itemId));
 350 |         ContainerRegistry.delete(resolvedContainerId);
 351 |         return true;
 352 |     }
 353 | };

 360 | function getGoldAmountInContainer(containerId) {
 361 |     const resolvedId = resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId);
 362 |     if (!resolvedId || !ContainerRegistry.has(resolvedId)) return 0;
 363 |     const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(resolvedId);
 364 |     const physicalGold = getContainerItems(cont).reduce((sum, itemId) => {
 365 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 366 |         return sum + ((item?.prototype_id === 'gold' || item?.prototype_id === 'gold_ingot' || item?.custom_props?.aiIdentifier === 'gold') ? item.stack_size : 0);
 367 |     }, 0);
 368 |     return physicalGold;
 369 | }
 370 | 
 371 | function syncPlayerGoldFromInventory() {
 372 |     if (!player?.container_backpack || !ContainerRegistry.has(player.container_backpack)) return 0;
 373 |     const backpack = ContainerRegistry.get(player.container_backpack);
 374 |     const totalGold = getContainerItems(backpack).reduce((sum, itemId) => {
 375 |         const item = ItemRegistry.get(itemId);
 376 |         return sum + ((item?.prototype_id === 'gold' || item?.prototype_id === 'gold_ingot' || item?.custom_props?.aiIdentifier === 'gold') ? item.stack_size : 0);
 377 |     }, 0);
 378 |     player.stats.gold = totalGold;
 379 |     return totalGold;
 380 | }

 383 | // ============================================================================
 384 | // STUB PROVIDER — sendInventoryCommand без IPC
 385 | // ============================================================================
 386 | 
 387 | function sendInventoryCommand(action, args) {
 388 |     // STUB: No IPC available — always use local implementation
 389 |     return executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args);
 390 | }
 391 | 
 392 | function executeLocalInventoryCommand(action, args) {
 393 |     switch (action) {
 394 |         case 'createContainer': {
 395 |             const id = OldCoreInventorySystem.createContainer(
 396 |                 args.type, args.ownerId, args.maxWeight, args.maxSlots, args.location, {
 397 |                     lock_data: args.lock_data, physical_props: args.physical_props, custom_props: args.custom_props
 398 |                 }
 399 |             );
 400 |             return { status: 'ok', containerId: id };
 401 |         }
 402 |         case 'createItem': {
 403 |             const id = OldCoreInventorySystem.createItem(
 404 |                 args.prototypeId, args.quantity, args.containerId, args.customProps
 405 |             );
 406 |             return { status: 'ok', itemId: id };
 407 |         }
 408 |         case 'moveItem': {
 409 |             const res = OldCoreInventorySystem.moveItem(
 410 |                 args.itemId, null, args.targetContainerId,
 411 |                 args.quantity >= 0 ? args.quantity : null,
 412 |                 { actorId: 'player', ignoreAccess: false, ignoreDistance: true }
 413 |             );
 414 |             return { status: res.success ? 'ok' : 'error', ...res, feedback: res.error };
 415 |         }
 416 |         case 'removeItem': {
 417 |             const ok = OldCoreInventorySystem.removeItem(args.itemId, args.quantity);
 418 |             return { status: ok ? 'ok' : 'error', success: ok };
 419 |         }
 420 |         case 'destroyContainer': {
 421 |             const ok = OldCoreInventorySystem.destroyContainer(args.containerId);
 422 |             return { status: ok ? 'ok' : 'error', success: ok };
 423 |         }
 424 |         case 'updateContainerLocation': {
 425 |             const cont = ContainerRegistry.get(args.containerId);
 426 |             if (cont) {
 427 |                 cont.location = normalizeContainerLocation(args.location);
 428 |                 return { status: 'ok', success: true };
 429 |             }
 430 |             return { status: 'error', success: false, error: 'Container not found' };
 431 |         }
 432 |         default:
 433 |             return { status: 'error', success: false, error: `Unknown command: ${action}` };
 434 |     }
 435 | }
 436 | 
 437 | // Async wrapper (matches CoreInventorySystemAsync API)
 438 | const CoreInventorySystemAsync = {
 439 |     createContainer: async function(type, ownerId, maxWeight, maxSlots, locationData = null, extraData = {}) {
 440 |         const defaultLocation = locationData || (
 441 |             ownerId === 'player' && (type === 'player_backpack' || type === 'player_equipment')
 442 |                 ? { world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: 'player', parent_container: null, region_id: player?.location || null }
 443 |                 : null
 444 |         );
 445 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand('createContainer', {
 446 |             type, ownerId, maxWeight, maxSlots, location: normalizeContainerLocation(defaultLocation),
 447 |             lock_data: extraData.lock_data || {}, physical_props: extraData.physical_props || {}, custom_props: extraData.custom_props || {}
 448 |         });
 449 |         return res.containerId;
 450 |     },
 451 |     createItem: async function(prototypeId, quantity, containerId, customProps = {}) {
 452 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand('createItem', {
 453 |             prototypeId, quantity, containerId: resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId), customProps
 454 |         });
 455 |         return res.itemId;
 456 |     },
 457 |     updateContainerLocation: async function(containerId, locationData) {
 458 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand('updateContainerLocation', {
 459 |             containerId: resolveSpecialContainerId(containerId),
 460 |             location: locationData
 461 |         });
 462 |         return res.success;
 463 |     },
 464 |     removeItem: async function(itemId, quantity) {
 465 |         const res = await sendInventoryCommand('removeItem', { itemId, quantity });
 466 |         return res.success;
 467 |     }
 468 | };
 469 | 
 470 | async function syncPlayerContainerBindings() {
 471 |     if (!player) return;
 472 |     const playerBinding = normalizeContainerLocation({ world_coords: [0, 0, 0], parent_entity: 'player', parent_container: null, region_id: player.location || null });
 473 |     if (player.container_backpack && ContainerRegistry.has(player.container_backpack)) {
 474 |         await CoreInventorySystemAsync.updateContainerLocation(player.container_backpack, playerBinding);
 475 |     }
 476 |     if (player.container_equipment && ContainerRegistry.has(player.container_equipment)) {
 477 |         await CoreInventorySystemAsync.updateContainerLocation(player.container_equipment, playerBinding);
 478 |     }
 479 | }
 480 | 
 481 | async function ensurePlayerContainers() {
 482 |     if (!player) return;
 483 |     const needsBackpack = !player.container_backpack || !ContainerRegistry.has(player.container_backpack);
 484 |     if (needsBackpack) {
 485 |         player.container_backpack = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createContainer("player_backpack", "player", 100, 30);
 486 |     }
 487 |     const needsEquipment = !player.container_equipment || !ContainerRegistry.has(player.container_equipment);
 488 |     if (needsEquipment) {
 489 |         player.container_equipment = await CoreInventorySystemAsync.createContainer("player_equipment", "player", 50, 10);
 490 |     }
 491 |     if (needsBackpack || needsEquipment) {
 492 |         await syncPlayerContainerBindings();
 493 |     }
 494 | }

 501 | let PASS = 0;
 502 | let FAIL = 0;
 503 | let WARN = 0;
 504 | const verbose = process.argv.includes('--verbose');

 506 | function assert(condition, message) {
 507 |     if (condition) {
 508 |         PASS++;
 509 |         if (verbose) console.log(`  \x1b[32mPASS\x1b[0m: ${message}`);
 510 |     } else {
 511 |         FAIL++;
 512 |         console.log(`  \x1b[31mFAIL\x1b[0m: ${message}`);
 513 |     }
 514 | }
 515 | 
 516 | function assertEqual(actual, expected, message) {
 517 |     assert(actual === expected, `${message} (expected: ${expected}, got: ${actual})`);
 518 | }
 519 | 
 520 | function assertNotEqual(actual, expected, message) {
 521 |     assert(actual !== expected, `${message} (should not be: ${expected}, got: ${actual})`);
 522 | }
 523 | 
 524 | function assertGreaterThan(actual, threshold, message) {
 525 |     assert(actual > threshold, `${message} (expected > ${threshold}, got: ${actual})`);
 526 | }
 527 | 
 528 | function assertIncludes(arr, item, message) {
 529 |     assert(Array.isArray(arr) && arr.includes(item), `${message} (array does not include: ${item})`);
 530 | }

 556 |

 561 |     assertEqual(backpack.max_slots, 30, 'Backpack max slots is 30');
 562 |     assert(Array.isArray(backpack.items) && backpack.items.length === 0, 'Backpack starts empty');
 563 |     assertEqual(backpack.location.parent_entity, 'player', 'Backpack location parent is player');

 565 |

 581 |         { custom_props: { shop_name: 'General Store' } }

 625 | async function testGoldSystem() {
 626 |     console.log('\n--- TEST: Gold System ---');
 627 |     resetState();
 628 | 
 629 |     player = { name: 'TestHero', location: 'test_location', stats: { gold: 0, turnCount: 0 }, container_backpack: null, container_equipment: null };
 630 |     player.container_backpack = OldCoreInventorySystem.createContainer("player_backpack", "player", 100, 30);
 631 | 
 632 |     // Add 100 gold
 633 |     OldCoreInventorySystem.createItem('gold', 100, player.container_backpack, { aiIdentifier: 'gold' });

  96 | 
  97 | def iter_files(
  98 |     root: Path,
  99 |     exclude_dirs: set[str],
 100 |     exclude_files: set[str],
 101 |     include_exts: tuple[str, ...],
 102 |     max_file_bytes: int,
 103 | ) -> Iterable[Path]:
 104 |     for current_root, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
 105 |         dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in exclude_dirs]
 106 |         current_path = Path(current_root)
 107 |         for file_name in files:
 108 |             path = current_path / file_name
 109 |             rel_path = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
 110 | 
 111 |             if rel_path in exclude_files or file_name in exclude_files:
 112 |                 continue
 113 | 
 114 |             if path.suffix.lower() not in include_exts:
 115 |                 continue
 116 | 
 117 |             try:
 118 |                 if path.stat().st_size > max_file_bytes:
 119 |                     continue
 120 |             except OSError:
 121 |                 continue
 122 | 
 123 |             yield path
 124 | 
 125 | 
 126 | def scan_file(path: Path, root: Path) -> List[Finding]:
 127 |     findings: List[Finding] = []
 128 |     suffix = path.suffix.lower()
 129 |     active_rules = [rule for rule in RULES if suffix in rule.include_ext]
 130 |     if not active_rules:
 131 |         return findings
 132 | 
 133 |     try:
 134 |         text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
 135 |     except OSError as exc:
 136 |         print(f'[WARN] cannot read {path}: {exc}', file=sys.stderr)
 137 |         return findings
 138 | 
 139 |     rel_path = path.relative_to(root)
 140 |     for line_number, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), start=1):
 141 |         for rule in active_rules:
 142 |             if rule.pattern.search(line):
 143 |                 findings.append(Finding(rule=rule, path=rel_path, line_number=line_number, line=line.strip()))
 144 |     return findings
 145 | 
 146 | 
 147 | def print_report(findings: List[Finding], max_lines_per_rule: int = 20, verbose: bool = False) -> int:
 148 |     if not findings:
 149 |         print('DATA ARCH AUDIT: OK — legacy blockers were not found.')
 150 |         return 0
 151 | 
 152 |     severity_order = {'ERROR': 0, 'WARN': 1, 'INFO': 2}
 153 |     findings = sorted(findings, key=lambda f: (severity_order.get(f.rule.severity, 99), str(f.path), f.line_number, f.rule.code))
 154 | 
 155 |     severity_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
 156 |     rule_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
 157 |     grouped: dict[str, List[Finding]] = {}
 158 |

  16 | def load_json(path: Path) -> Any:
  17 |     try:
  18 |         with path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
  19 |             return json.load(f)
  20 |     except FileNotFoundError:
  21 |         raise RuntimeError(f'Missing required data file: {path}')
  22 |     except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
  23 |         raise RuntimeError(f'Invalid JSON in {path}: {exc}')

  25 | 
  26 | def load_item_database(data_dir: Path) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
  27 |     """Load all base item-like databases that can be referenced by tag_defaults."""
  28 |     item_files = [
  29 |         data_dir / 'economy_items.json',
  30 |         data_dir / 'items.json',
  31 |     ]
  32 | 
  33 |     items: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = {}
  34 |     for path in item_files:
  35 |         if not path.exists():
  36 |             continue
  37 | 
  38 |         raw = load_json(path)
  39 |         if not isinstance(raw, dict):
  40 |             raise RuntimeError(f'{path} must contain a JSON object keyed by item id')
  41 | 
  42 |         for item_id, item_def in raw.items():
  43 |             if isinstance(item_def, dict):
  44 |                 merged = dict(items.get(item_id, {}))
  45 |                 merged.update(item_def)
  46 |                 items[item_id] = merged
  47 |             else:
  48 |                 items[item_id] = {'value': item_def}
  49 | 
  50 |     return items
  51 | 
  52 | 
  53 | def get_tags(item_def: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]:
  54 |     tags = item_def.get('tags', [])
  55 |     if not isinstance(tags, list):
  56 |         return []
  57 |     return [tag for tag in tags if isinstance(tag, str)]
  58 | 
  59 | 
  60 | def iter_default_references(tag_defaults: Dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[tuple[str, str, bool]]:
  61 |     """
  62 |     Yield (semantic_tag, item_id, should_have_same_tag).
  63 | 
  64 |     String entries are canonical defaults and should normally point to an item
  65 |     that carries the same semantic tag. List entries are explicit pools/lists;
  66 |     their items only need to exist.
  67 |     """
  68 |     for semantic_tag, value in tag_defaults.items():
  69 |         if isinstance(value, str):
  70 |             yield semantic_tag, value, True
  71 |         elif isinstance(value, list):
  72 |             for item_id in value:
  73 |                 if isinstance(item_id, str):
  74 |                     yield semantic_tag, item_id, False
  75 |

  77 | def validate(root: Path, strict_tags: bool = False) -> List[ContractFinding]:

  79 |     manifest_path = data_dir / 'runtime_manifest.json'
  80 |     tag_defaults_path = data_dir / 'tag_defaults.json'
  81 | 
  82 |     raw_manifest = load_json(manifest_path)
  83 |     if not isinstance(raw_manifest, dict):
  84 |         raise RuntimeError(f'{manifest_path} must contain a JSON object')

  86 |     schema_version = raw_manifest.get('schemaVersion')

 148 |         print('DATA CONTRACT: OK — tag_defaults references are valid.')
 149 |         return 0
 150 | 
 151 |     counts: Dict[str, int] = {}
 152 |     for finding in findings:
 153 |         counts[finding.severity] = counts.get(finding.severity, 0) + 1
 154 | 
 155 |     print('DATA CONTRACT: findings')
 156 |     print('=======================')
 157 |     print('Summary: ' + ', '.join(f'{severity}={count}' for severity, count in sorted(counts.items())))
 158 |     print()
 159 |

 161 |         print(f'[{finding.severity}] {finding.code}: {finding.message}')

 165 |         print()

 171 |     return 0

 387 | function main() {
 388 |   checkUiRuntime(readJson('data/ui_runtime.json'));
 389 |   checkElectronRuntime(readJson('data/electron_runtime.json'));
 390 |   checkPromptRuntime(readJson('data/prompt_runtime.json'));
 391 |   checkGameplayRuntime(readJson('data/gameplay_runtime.json'));
 392 | 
 393 |   if (warnings.length > 0) {
 394 |     console.log('Runtime config warnings:');
 395 |     warnings.forEach(warning => console.log('[WARN]', warning));
 396 |   }
 397 | 
 398 |   if (errors.length > 0) {
 399 |     console.error('Runtime config validation failed:');
 400 |     errors.forEach(error => console.error('[FAIL]', error));
 401 |     process.exit(1);
 402 |   }
 403 | 
 404 |   console.log('runtime config contracts OK');
 405 | }

 247 |     function escapeHtml(value) {
 248 |       return String(value).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, (ch) => {
 249 |         const map = { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', "'": '&#39;', '"': '&quot;' };
 250 |         return map[ch];
 251 |       });
 252 |     }
 253 | 
 254 |     function slugify(text) {
 255 |       return text.toLowerCase().replace(/[`*_#]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zа-яё0-9]+/gi, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 80) || 'section';
 256 |     }
 257 | 
 258 |     function inlineMarkdown(text) {
 259 |       let safe = escapeHtml(text);
 260 |       safe = safe.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
 261 |       safe = safe.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
 262 |       return safe;
 263 |     }
 264 | 
 265 |     function renderMarkdown(md) {
 266 |       const lines = md.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
 267 |       const out = [];
 268 |       let inCode = false;
 269 |       let codeLines = [];
 270 |       let inList = false;
 271 |       function closeList() { if (inList) { out.push('</ul>'); inList = false; } }
 272 |       for (const line of lines) {
 273 |         if (line.trim().startsWith('```')) {
 274 |           if (!inCode) { closeList(); inCode = true; codeLines = []; }
 275 |           else { out.push('<pre><code>' + escapeHtml(codeLines.join('\n')) + '</code></pre>'); inCode = false; }
 276 |           continue;
 277 |         }
 278 |         if (inCode) { codeLines.push(line); continue; }
 279 |         const heading = line.match(/^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$/);
 280 |         if (heading) {
 281 |           closeList();
 282 |           const level = heading[1].length;
 283 |           const text = heading[2].trim();
 284 |           const id = slugify(text);
 285 |           out.push(`<h${level} id='${id}'>${inlineMarkdown(text)}</h${level}>`);
 286 |           continue;
 287 |         }
 288 |         const bullet = line.match(/^\s*-\s+(.+)$/);
 289 |         if (bullet) {
 290 |           if (!inList) { out.push('<ul>'); inList = true; }
 291 |           out.push('<li>' + inlineMarkdown(bullet[1]) + '</li>');
 292 |           continue;
 293 |         }
 294 |         if (line.trim() === '---') { closeList(); out.push('<hr>'); continue; }
 295 |         if (line.trim() === '') { closeList(); continue; }
 296 |         closeList();
 297 |         out.push('<p>' + inlineMarkdown(line) + '</p>');
 298 |       }
 299 |       if (inCode) out.push('<pre><code>' + escapeHtml(codeLines.join('\n')) + '</code></pre>');
 300 |       closeList();
 301 |       return out.join('\n');
 302 |     }

 304 |     function extractPatchCards(md) {
 305 |       const matches = [...md.matchAll(/^###\s+(.+)$/gm)];
 306 |       return matches.map((match, index) => {
 307 |         const title = match[1].trim();
 308 |         const start = match.index;
 309 |         const end = matches[index + 1] ? matches[index + 1].index : md.length;
 310 |         const block = md.slice(start, end);
 311 |         const statusMatch = block.match(/\*\*Статус:\*\*\s*([^\n]+)/i);
 312 |         const riskMatch = block.match(/\*\*Риск:\*\*\s*([^\n]+)/i);
 313 |         const status = statusMatch ? statusMatch[1].trim() : 'статус не указан';
 314 |         const risk = riskMatch ? riskMatch[1].trim() : '';
 315 |         const isSuccess = /успеш|применён успешно|успешно/i.test(status);
 316 |         const hasRisk = /средн|высок|риск/i.test(risk);
 317 |         return { title, id: slugify(title), status, risk, isSuccess, hasRisk, block };
 318 |       });
 319 |     }

 321 |     function highlight(html, query) {
 322 |       const q = query.trim();
 323 |       if (!q) return html;
 324 |       const escaped = q.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
 325 |       return html.replace(new RegExp(escaped, 'gi'), (m) => `<mark>${m}</mark>`);
 326 |     }
 327 | 
 328 |     function extractMigrationProgress(md) {
 329 |       if (!md || !md.trim()) return { total: 0, done: 0, percent: 0, phases: [] };
 330 |       const lines = md.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
 331 |       const phases = [];
 332 |       let current = null;
 333 |       let total = 0;
 334 |       let done = 0;
 335 | 
 336 |       for (const line of lines) {
 337 |         const phaseMatch = line.match(/^##\s+((?:Phase\s+\d+\s+—\s+.+)|Full migration mandate)$/i);
 338 |         if (phaseMatch) {
 339 |           current = { title: phaseMatch[1].trim(), total: 0, done: 0 };
 340 |           phases.push(current);
 341 |           continue;
 342 |         }
 343 | 
 344 |         const taskMatch = line.match(/^\s*-\s+\[([xX ])\]\s+(.+)$/);
 345 |         if (!taskMatch) continue;
 346 |         total += 1;
 347 |         if (current) current.total += 1;
 348 |         if (taskMatch[1].toLowerCase() === 'x') {
 349 |           done += 1;
 350 |           if (current) current.done += 1;
 351 |         }
 352 |       }
 353 | 
 354 |       const percent = total > 0 ? Math.round((done / total) * 100) : 0;
 355 |       return { total, done, percent, phases };
 356 |     }
 357 | 
 358 |     function findCurrentPhaseProgress(md, phases) {
 359 |       const currentLine = (md || '').split(/\r?\n/).find(line => line.startsWith('**Текущая фаза:**')) || '';
 360 |       const currentTitle = currentLine.replace('**Текущая фаза:**', '').trim();
 361 |       const phaseNumber = (currentTitle.match(/Phase\s+(\d+)/i) || [])[1];
 362 |       let phase = phaseNumber
 363 |         ? phases.find(item => item.title.toLowerCase().includes(`phase ${phaseNumber}`))
 364 |         : null;
 365 | 
 366 |       if (!phase && /full\s+data-driven\s+migration/i.test(currentTitle)) {
 367 |         phase = phases.find(item => item.title.toLowerCase() === 'full migration mandate');
 368 |       }
 369 | 
 370 |       return { currentTitle, phase };
 371 |     }

 374 |     function updateMigrationProgress(md) {
 375 |       const progress = extractMigrationProgress(md);
 376 |       const percentExact = progress.total > 0 ? (progress.done / progress.total) * 100 : 0;
 377 |       const percent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, percentExact));
 378 |       el('migrationPercent').textContent = percent.toFixed(1) + '%';
 379 |       el('migrationFill').style.width = percent + '%';
 380 | 
 381 |       if (!progress.total) {
 382 |         el('migrationMeta').textContent = 'План миграции не загружен. Открой viewer через tools/open_worklog_viewer.bat.';
 383 |         el('currentPhaseTitle').textContent = 'Текущая фаза';
 384 |         el('currentPhasePercent').textContent = '0%';
 385 |         el('currentPhaseFill').style.width = '0%';
 386 |         el('currentPhaseMeta').textContent = 'Нет данных по текущей фазе.';
 387 |         el('phaseList').innerHTML = '';
 388 |         return;
 389 |       }
 390 | 
 391 |       const remaining = Math.max(0, progress.total - progress.done);
 392 |       el('migrationMeta').textContent = `${progress.done}/${progress.total} пунктов закрыто, осталось ${remaining}. Общий процент большой миграции меняется медленно, поэтому ниже показан отдельный прогресс текущей фазы.`;
 393 | 
 394 |       const current = findCurrentPhaseProgress(md, progress.phases);
 395 |       if (current.phase) {
 396 |         const phasePercent = current.phase.total > 0 ? (current.phase.done / current.phase.total) * 100 : 0;
 397 |         el('currentPhaseTitle').textContent = current.currentTitle || current.phase.title;
 398 |         el('currentPhasePercent').textContent = phasePercent.toFixed(1) + '%';
 399 |         el('currentPhaseFill').style.width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, phasePercent)) + '%';
 400 |         el('currentPhaseMeta').textContent = `${current.phase.done}/${current.phase.total} пунктов закрыто в текущей фазе. Этот бар должен двигаться заметнее, чем общий.`;
 401 |       } else {
 402 |         el('currentPhaseTitle').textContent = current.currentTitle || 'Текущая фаза';
 403 |         el('currentPhasePercent').textContent = '—';
 404 |         el('currentPhaseFill').style.width = '0%';
 405 |         el('currentPhaseMeta').textContent = 'Не удалось сопоставить текущую фазу с чеклистом ниже.';
 406 |       }
 407 | 
 408 |       el('phaseList').innerHTML = progress.phases.map((phase) => {
 409 |         const phasePercent = phase.total > 0 ? Math.round((phase.done / phase.total) * 100) : 0;
 410 |         return `<div class='phase-row'><strong>${escapeHtml(phase.title)}</strong><span>${phase.done}/${phase.total}</span><div class='mini-bar'><div class='mini-fill' style='width:${phasePercent}%'></div></div></div>`;
 411 |       }).join('');
 412 |     }

 415 |     function updateStats(cards, md) {
 416 |       el('patchCount').textContent = cards.length;
 417 |       el('successCount').textContent = cards.filter(c => c.isSuccess).length;
 418 |       el('riskCount').textContent = (md.match(/\*\*Риск:\*\*/g) || []).length;
 419 |       el('todoCount').textContent = (md.match(/Следующ|TODO|нужно|надо/gi) || []).length;
 420 |     }

 422 |     function renderPatchList(cards) {
 423 |       const q = el('searchInput').value.trim().toLowerCase();
 424 |       const filtered = cards.filter((card) => {
 425 |         const textOk = !q || card.block.toLowerCase().includes(q) || card.title.toLowerCase().includes(q);
 426 |         const filterOk = activeFilter === 'all' || (activeFilter === 'success' && card.isSuccess) || (activeFilter === 'risk' && card.hasRisk) || (activeFilter === 'todo' && /следующ|todo|нужно|надо/i.test(card.block));
 427 |         return textOk && filterOk;
 428 |       });
 429 |       el('patchList').innerHTML = filtered.map(card => {
 430 |         const statusClass = card.isSuccess ? 'status-ok' : 'status-warn';
 431 |         const riskLine = card.risk ? `<small>Риск: ${escapeHtml(card.risk)}</small>` : '';
 432 |         return `<a class='patch-card' href='#${card.id}'><strong>${inlineMarkdown(card.title)}</strong><small class='${statusClass}'>${escapeHtml(card.status)}</small>${riskLine}</a>`;
 433 |       }).join('') || `<p class='muted'>Ничего не найдено.</p>`;
 434 |     }

 436 |     function renderAll() {
 437 |       const cards = extractPatchCards(rawMarkdown);
 438 |       renderedHtml = renderMarkdown(rawMarkdown);
 439 |       el('rendered').innerHTML = highlight(renderedHtml, el('searchInput').value);
 440 |       updateStats(cards, rawMarkdown);
 441 |       updateMigrationProgress(rawPlanMarkdown);
 442 |       renderPatchList(cards);

 445 |     async function loadPlanDefault() {
 446 |       try {
 447 |         const response = await fetch(DEFAULT_PLAN_PATH, { cache: 'no-store' });
 448 |         if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
 449 |         rawPlanMarkdown = await response.text();
 450 |       } catch (error) {
 451 |         rawPlanMarkdown = '';
 452 |       }
 453 |     }

 455 | 
 456 |     async function loadDefault() {
 457 |       try {
 458 |         const response = await fetch(DEFAULT_WORKLOG_PATH, { cache: 'no-store' });
 459 |         if (!response.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.status);
 460 |         rawMarkdown = await response.text();
 461 |         await loadPlanDefault();
 462 |         el('sourceLabel').textContent = 'Открыт: docs/AI_PATCHER_WORKLOG.md + docs/DATA_DRIVEN_MIGRATION_PLAN.md';
 463 |         renderAll();
 464 |       } catch (error) {
 465 |         el('sourceLabel').textContent = 'Авто-загрузка не сработала. Открой .md вручную или запусти tools/open_worklog_viewer.bat.';
 466 |         await loadPlanDefault();
 467 |         renderAll();
 468 |       }
 469 |     }

 471 |     function loadFile(file) {
 472 |       const reader = new FileReader();
 473 |       reader.onload = () => {
 474 |         rawMarkdown = String(reader.result || '');
 475 |         el('sourceLabel').textContent = 'Открыт вручную: ' + file.name;
 476 |         renderAll();
 477 |       };
 478 |       reader.readAsText(file, 'utf-8');
 479 |     }

 486 |     el('printBtn').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());

 490 |       el('sourceLabel').textContent = 'Markdown скопирован в буфер.';
 491 |     });

 493 |     document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach((chip) => {

 495 |         document.querySelectorAll('.chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
 496 |         chip.classList.add('active');
 497 |         activeFilter = chip.dataset.filter;
 498 |         renderAll();
 499 |       });
 500 |     });
 501 |     const dropzone = el('dropzone');
 502 |     ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(name => {

 507 |     });

 510 |         event.preventDefault();
 511 |         dropzone.classList.remove('drag');
 512 |       });
 513 |     });
 514 |     dropzone.addEventListener('drop', (event) => {

 516 |       if (file) loadFile(file);

  31 |     : process.platform === 'darwin'
  32 |       ? `open "${url}"`
  33 |       : `xdg-open "${url}"`;
  34 |   exec(command, () => {});
  35 | }
  36 | 
  37 | const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  38 |   try {
  39 |     const parsed = new URL(req.url, `http://${HOST}:${PORT}`);
  40 |     let pathname = decodeURIComponent(parsed.pathname);
  41 |     if (pathname === '/') pathname = '/tools/worklog_viewer.html';
  42 | 
  43 |     const requested = path.resolve(ROOT, '.' + pathname);
  44 |     if (!requested.startsWith(ROOT + path.sep) && requested !== ROOT) {
  45 |       return send(res, 403, 'Forbidden');
  46 |     }
  47 | 
  48 |     fs.readFile(requested, (error, data) => {
  49 |       if (error) return send(res, 404, 'Not found: ' + pathname);
  50 |       const type = MIME[path.extname(requested).toLowerCase()] || 'application/octet-stream';
  51 |       send(res, 200, data, type);
  52 |     });
  53 |   } catch (error) {
  54 |     send(res, 500, error.message);
  55 |   }
  56 | });
  57 | 
  58 | server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
  59 |   const url = `http://${HOST}:${PORT}/tools/worklog_viewer.html`;
  60 |   console.log('AI Patcher Worklog Viewer');
  61 |   console.log('Root:', ROOT);
  62 |   console.log('URL:', url);
  63 |   console.log('Close this window to stop the viewer.');
  64 |   openBrowser(url);
  65 | });

--- шпаргалка git.md (Markdown, 78 lines, ~506 tokens) ---
   1 | Вот обновлённая шпаргалка, дополненная шагами для **связывания локальной папки с новым удалённым репозиторием** и первой отправки файлов.
   2 | 
   3 | ---
   4 | 
   5 | ### 🚀 Git-шпаргалка (расширенная)
   6 | 
   7 | #### 1️⃣ Начало работы: связать пустой репозиторий на GitHub с папкой на ПК
   8 | 
   9 | ```bash
  10 | # Перейти в нужную папку с проектом
  11 | cd путь/к/папке
  12 | 
  13 | # Превратить папку в Git-репозиторий
  14 | git init
  15 | 
  16 | # Добавить все файлы в отслеживание
  17 | git add .
  18 | 
  19 | # Сделать первый коммит
  20 | git commit -m "Первый коммит: все файлы проекта"
  21 | 
  22 | # Добавить удалённый репозиторий (ссылка с GitHub)
  23 | git remote add origin https://github.com/ваш_логин/имя_репозитория.git
  24 | 
  25 | # (опционально) Переименовать основную ветку в main, если нужно
  26 | git branch -M main
  27 | 
  28 | # Отправить всё на GitHub (в первый раз с ключом -u, чтобы запомнить связь)
  29 | git push -u origin main
  30 | ```
  31 | 
  32 | #### 2️⃣ Ежедневная работа
  33 | 
  34 | **Просмотр состояния**  
  35 | ```bash
  36 | git status
  37 | ```
  38 | 
  39 | **Добавить все новые/изменённые файлы**  
  40 | ```bash
  41 | git add .
  42 | ```
  43 | 
  44 | **Сохранить изменения локально (коммит)**  
  45 | ```bash
  46 | git commit -m "описание того, что сделано"
  47 | ```
  48 | 
  49 | **Отправить коммиты на GitHub**  
  50 | ```bash
  51 | git push
  52 | ```
  53 | 
  54 | **Забрать последнюю версию с GitHub (если работаете с кем-то или с другого ПК)**  
  55 | ```bash
  56 | git pull
  57 | ```
  58 | > ⚠️ Перед `pull` обязательно закоммитьте свои локальные изменения, иначе возможны конфликты.
  59 | 
  60 | **Посмотреть историю коммитов**  
  61 | ```bash
  62 | git log
  63 | ```
  64 | 
  65 | ---
  66 | 
  67 | ### 🔁 Типичный сценарий «нулевой репозиторий → всё на GitHub»
  68 | 
  69 | 1. Создаёте **пустой репозиторий** на GitHub (без README, .gitignore, лицензии).
  70 | 2. На ПК в папке с проектом выполняете:
  71 |    ```bash
  72 |    git init
  73 |    git add .
  74 |    git commit -m "Initial commit"
  75 |    git remote add origin <ссылка_на_GitHub>
  76 |    git push -u origin main
  77 |    ```
  78 | 3. Готово! Все файлы загружены. Далее работаете через `add`, `commit`, `push`, `pull`.
